Summary: Microsoft Entra ID is adding risk-based CAPTCHA verification for SMS and voice first-factor sign-ins to reduce automated abuse. Rollout began mid-October 2026. Some users may encounter this step based on behavior. Organizations should prepare help desks, review network requirements, and encourage phishing-resistant methods like passkeys.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio cost controls are expanding to Cost Management in the Microsoft 365 admin center
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use the expanded cost controls for Cost Management for Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center in Power Platform. This feature will reach general availability by November 20, 2026. How does this affect me? This update gives administrators a centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spending across supported usage-based AI workloads while retaining broader Copilot Studio administration in the Power Platform admin center. This enterprise-ready management...

Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting October 28th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New email submissions data in Advanced Hunting
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will add two new Advanced Hunting tables—SubmissionEvents and SubmissionResults—providing enhanced visibility into email submission activity. Public Preview starts mid-November 2026; General Availability begins late November 2026. No immediate action or compliance concerns are required.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Summarize sales for leaders Copilot skill
Summary: Microsoft PowerPoint will introduce a new Copilot skill, "Summarize sales for leaders," by early November 2026, enabling users to quickly create executive sales summary presentations focused on performance, outlook, risks, and decisions. No admin action or changes to data handling are required.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Prepare customer review deck Copilot skill
Summary: A new Copilot skill in PowerPoint will help users create customer review decks focused on business goals and outcomes. Rolling out worldwide from late October to early November 2026, it requires no admin action and does not change data handling or introduce new AI interactions.

Title: Microsoft Contact Center AI: Insights and quality
Summary: Gain visibility into AI interactions, conversation trends, and customer engagement​

Title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Universal connector for self-service omnichannel agents
Summary: Bring Microsoft AI to the contact center platform of your choice with the Universal Connector. Organizations can now integrate Microsoft self-service voice and chat agents with virtually any contact center using a simple API-based approach. The Universal Connector enables seamless handoff from AI agents to human representatives while preserving the full conversation context, ensuring a connected and personalized customer experience across every interaction.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Reroute conversations to the right queue automatically
Summary: Service representatives can reroute a live voice or messaging conversation when they realize they aren't the right person to help. The representative updates the conversation details, or the details of a linked case, contact, or account, and then selects Reroute. The conversation goes back through classification and route-to-queue rules and is assigned to the right queue automatically, so representatives don't need to know routing rules or choose a queue themselves. The customer stays connected...

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Historical analytics
Summary: Contact Center historical analytics provides out-of-box historical reporting for Dynamics 365 Contact Center, built on a shared analytics foundation. It moves reporting from heavier workload-specific Power BI models toward a shared analytics foundation with conformed facts, shared dimensions, pre-built aggregations, and common definitions across conversations, sessions, agents, queues, channels, CSAT, handle time, and operational KPIs. Customers can continue using out-of-box Power BI reports whi...

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics for historical reporting
Summary: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent mobile app
Summary: The Expense Agent mobile app for Dynamics 365 Business Central extends expense capture to iOS and Android mobile devices by enabling employees to submit receipts directly from their phone or using native share functionality.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Start side conversations during meetings
Summary: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Start and continue one-to-one or small-group conversations directly from a meeting to ask questions, coordinate next steps, share information, and collaborate in parallel while staying engaged in the conversation, reducing context switching and helping teams stay focused and productive.

Title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Preserve actual booking End Time when completion is recorded later
Summary: Business value

Title: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization on Teams Pro Management portal
Summary: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. For utilization analytics to be enabled, a desk needs to have one or more peripheral device associated, and the desk needs to be licensed with Teams Shared Space license or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
Summary: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations
Summary: Bullseye routing with user groups enables a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible representatives as conversation wait time increases. Rather than assigning from a fixed pool or waiting for overflow rules to trigger, this approach progressively widens availability in concentric rings—starting with the best-fit representatives and expanding outward as needed.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
Summary: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
Summary: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
Summary: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData. This helps improve coverage by detecting and protecting sensitive data in these locations.

Title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
Summary: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Enhanced Policy Conditions
Summary: Three updates are coming to enhance policy conditions. First, our updated policy conditions enable the detection of messages sent and received both to and from external email addresses, allowing you to identify specific instances of information being shared with external contacts. Secondly, with the new OR condition capability, you can combine multiple conditions within the same policy, creating custom logic to suit your unique compliance requirements. Lastly, to make policy creation and updates...

Title: OneDrive: Updated placement of the Create or upload button for Web
Summary: OneDrive for the web is updating the placement of the Create or upload button to provide a more consistent file experience across OneDrive and SharePoint. The button will move from the left navigation pane to the right side of the page, bringing familiar navigation from SharePoint document libraries to OneDrive.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Analyze project plans with what-if scenarios
Summary: What if scenario modeling enables you to simulate changes to a project plan and evaluate their impact before committing to them. Available for both Project Operations core and Project Operations connect with ERP deployment types, this capability can be enabled through Feature Control and allows you to: - Create and manage multiple versions of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). - Modify key planning variables, including schedule, scope, effort, and resources. - Analyze the impact of changes acro...

Title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Tools
Summary: Tools are building blocks that let your agent interact with external systems. Tools expand what your agent can do, and your agent can perform various actions in response to user requests or autonomous triggers. Title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Draft proposal response Copilot skill
Summary: Microsoft PowerPoint is introducing a new Copilot skill, Draft proposal response, to help users create customer-specific proposal drafts. It will roll out worldwide from late October to early November 2026 on Windows, Mac, and web. No admin action is needed, and it does not change data handling or AI interaction methods.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Review sales pipeline Copilot skill
Summary: Microsoft PowerPoint will introduce a new Copilot skill, Review sales pipeline, by early November 2026. It helps users create or update pipeline and forecast presentations focused on opportunity movement, risks, and next actions. No admin action is needed, and it does not change data handling or AI interaction methods.

Title: Frontier expands to include public previews in Microsoft Teams, new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, and SharePoint
Summary: Starting November 2026, Microsoft Frontier expands to offer public preview features in Teams, new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, and SharePoint, alongside Copilot. Admins manage enrollment centrally, choosing users for early access, while others remain on Standard or Deferred release schedules. Frontier simplifies preview management and preparation.

Title: Microsoft Windows: Updates to address compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys
Summary: Microsoft is updating Windows, Edge, and WebView2 to block eight compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys by late October 2026. Organizations must allow automatic updates, manage disconnected devices, and replace certificates chaining to these keys to maintain trust and security.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Final reminder to replace MemberOf rule operator configurations by November 3, 2026
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the MemberOf rule operator by November 3, 2026. Organizations using MemberOf in dynamic groups, administrative units, or entitlement policies must replace it to avoid outdated memberships, access, and licensing issues. Action is required before this date to maintain proper functionality.

Title: Copilot Code is rolling out in Frontier
Summary: Copilot Code, an AI-powered coding tool in Microsoft Copilot, is rolling out in the Frontier program starting late October 2026. It enables users with licenses and spending policies to build, refine, and publish apps using natural language, with admin-controlled usage-based billing and optional local coding on PC.

Title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on Microsoft Copilot Harness
Summary: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports to manage metered consumption costs for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (preview)
Summary: Microsoft 365 admin center introduces a preview usage report for managing metered costs of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing. It shows message consumption by tenant, user, and agent, with alerts for over 2000 messages. Rollout starts end of April 2027, no admin action needed.

Title: Announcing: Migrate Azure Container Apps logging destination from Log Analytics to Azure Monitor
Summary: The Log Analytics logging destination for Azure Container Apps is now a legacy logging option. Existing environments configured with the Log Analytics logging destination will continue to function normally. However, we recommend planning a migration to the Azure Monitor logging destination. This recommendation is driven by the underlying HTTP Data Collector API used by the Log Analytics logging destination. Support for the legacy HTTP Data Collector API ended on September 14, 2026 and will now o...

Title: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
Summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will protect sensitive files in previously excluded Windows folders (e.g., AppData) during egress actions starting late February 2027. Admins must update policies, deploy anti-malware client 4.18.26051+, and educate users. Audit mode logs actions; block mode enforces restrictions.

Title: Public Preview: Cross Tenant Restore with Azure Backup
Summary: Cross-Tenant Restore (CTR) helps organizations establish an independent recovery path by enabling Azure VM backups to be restored into a separate Azure tenant. It strengthens cyber resilience while using the existing backup copy, without requiring customers to maintain and manage duplicate backup data. Learn more .

Title: The October 2026 Windows non-security preview update is now available
Summary: The October 2026 non-security preview update is now available for Windows 11, versions 26H2, 26H1, and 25H2. Information about the contents of this update is available in the release notes, which are accessible from the Windows 11 update history page. To learn more about the different types of monthly quality updates, see Understanding Windows monthly updates. Title: Microsoft Viva: Targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard
Summary: Microsoft Viva introduces targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard, allowing authorized users (CxO or delegates) to send Viva Pulse surveys to predefined Copilot user groups based on dashboard data. The feature, enabled by default for eligible organizations, rolls out from mid-August to mid-December 2026, with admin controls available.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Prepare for Microsoft to disable unused or unsuccessful SMS first-factor sign-in
Summary: Microsoft will disable SMS first-factor sign-in in Microsoft Entra tenants with no successful or only unsuccessful SMS sign-ins in the past 30 days, starting mid-September to November 2026. SMS for MFA and password reset remains unaffected. Admins should review usage, notify users, and ensure alternate sign-in methods.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization in Teams Pro Management portal
Summary: Microsoft Teams Pro Management portal will add desk utilization analytics, showing usage, reservations, occupancy, and peak patterns. Requires desks with peripheral devices and Teams Shared Space licenses. Rollout starts early December 2026, completing by mid-January 2027, aiding workplace space planning without compliance issues.

Title: Microsoft Purview | DLM: Legacy Teams retention policies that cover Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
Summary: Starting mid-January 2027, legacy Microsoft Teams retention policies will apply only to Teams data, excluding Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. Organizations must create separate retention policies for Copilot to maintain compliance. Existing Teams retention behavior remains unchanged, but action is required to cover Copilot data.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Initiate side conversations within the meeting chat window
Summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to start or continue private side conversations within the meeting chat window, rolling out globally from January 2027. No admin action is needed, chat history is preserved, and users can disable the side-chat tab if desired. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Generally Available: Marketplace private offer enhancements
Summary: Private offers through Microsoft Marketplace help you optimize your spending power with pricing and terms aligned to your organization’s needs, including flexible billing, custom contract lengths, and more. For eligible private offers, we are simplifying the private offer purchase experience for customers. Previously, customers needed to first “accept” the private offer and then “purchase” individual products. Now, customers simply purchase all included products with one easy step for eligible p...

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center – Boost contact center efficiency with Real Time Streaming Analytics
Summary: We are introducing Real-Time Streaming Analytics in the new Contact Center supervisor workspace application, providing supervisors with near real-time visibility into Dynamics 365 Contact Center performance without requiring dashboard refreshes. This feature will be generally available starting Oct 30th with a phased rollout across all regions through November 9, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables supervisors to monitor contact center performance and take action from a single ex...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will allow two presenters to share screens simultaneously in meetings starting late November 2026. This feature enhances collaboration by displaying both shared contents at once. Tenant admins can control this setting, and meeting organizers can enable or disable it per meeting. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: SharePoint Server access through the mobile apps will be retired
Summary: SharePoint Server access via the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android will be retired starting November 27, 2026. These apps will support SharePoint Online only. Organizations should notify users and update documentation accordingly before this change.

Title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
Summary: Microsoft Teams will support external presenters in event group chat for meetings with the "Enable Green room" option. Rollout starts November 2026. External collaboration must be enabled. External presenters can read and post messages, with tenant IDs updated accordingly, enabling cross-tenant communication.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Retirement of selected Search Analytics capabilities
Summary: Selected Search Analytics capabilities for Microsoft/Bing, Teams, Outlook/WXP, Windows Search Work results, and Microsoft365.com will retire in late 2026. Summary, User/Query, and Answer Analytics in Microsoft 365 admin center will be removed, but search functions and other analytics remain unaffected. Administrators should review and export needed data.

Title: Join button will require HTTPS meeting links
Summary: Starting late November 2026, Outlook's Join button will only appear for meetings with HTTPS join URLs. Meetings with HTTP-only URLs will not show the button. Organizations should ensure their meeting providers and integrations generate HTTPS links to avoid impact. No action is needed if HTTPS URLs are already used.

Title: Microsoft Authenticator: Improved backup and restore experience for Android
Summary: Microsoft Authenticator for Android will improve backup and restore with clearer setup guidance and support for passkeys starting mid-January 2027. Users must enable Google One backup and screen lock. Work/school accounts aren’t backed up, and backup works only in the Android personal profile. No admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
Summary: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone enables natural language editing and task continuation outside the app. Rolling out worldwide from late October to November 2026, it enhances mobile Excel use with secure Microsoft 365 integration, allowing quick data insights, edits, and formula updates without compliance concerns.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Reminder to migrate from Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID will retire Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication starting February 1, 2027. Organizations must migrate users to passkeys or other methods, or configure a customer-managed telecom provider before then to avoid sign-in disruptions. SMS and voice are vulnerable to attacks; passkeys are recommended.

Title: Outlook: Microsoft Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachments
Summary: When composing an email in Outlook for Mac, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels can be automatically applied or recommended based on the sensitivity labels of attached files. This helps users consistently protect sensitive information, reduces manual labeling effort, and supports organizational compliance requirements by aligning email protection with the sensitivity of attached content.

Title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
Summary: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
Summary: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
Summary: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
Summary: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

Title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: Knowledge
Summary: Knowledge sources ground your agent's responses in enterprise data. When you add knowledge sources, agents can use enterprise data from Power Platform, Dynamics 365 data, websites, and external systems. By using knowledge sources, your agents can provide relevant information and insights for your customers.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in DoD
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to the Microsoft 365 Department of Defense (DoD) environment, providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the DoD environment.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Decline a call with a message on Mobile
Summary: Users can quickly decline an incoming Teams call and send a predefined message to the caller at the same time. From the incoming call screen, users can select a message such as letting the caller know they're unavailable or will call back, providing helpful context without having to answer the call or separately open a chat.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Allow users to translate PDF documents into their preferred language
Summary: Users will be able to translate full PDF documents directly within the native PDF viewer in Microsoft Edge. The translated document opens in a new tab, making it easier to access content in their preferred language. Admins can control availability to this feature using the TranslateEnabled policy.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot app mode handoffs
Summary: The Chat experience in the Copilot app will suggest a better-fit mode based on the user's prompt, if applicable. For example, it will suggest Cowork or other supported modes as they become available. Users will see a suggestion card after they send a prompt in Chat, with an explanation of the better-fit mode and an option for the user to switch to the suggested mode. Their chat conversation will be attached to the prompt in the new mode to maintain context.

Title: Power Pages: Track Power Pages performance and usage with monitor hub
Summary: Power Pages is integrated into the monitor hub. This integration empowers site owners, makers, and administrators to access performance and usage insights directly within the monitor hub of the Power Platform admin center.

Title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Improve rental operations and fulfillment
Summary: As organizations expand beyond one-time asset sales to rental, leasing, and servitization business models, new rental management capabilities help them manage and monetize the assets they build, own, and operate throughout the rental lifecycle. In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, organizations can manage availability and reservations, fulfillment, delivery and pickup, inspections, and returns. These capabilities can help improve fleet utilization, reduce idle time, and streamline the moveme...

Title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
Summary: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Suggested References in Copilot Notebooks
Summary: Users can now quickly enrich their Copilot Notebook with relevant Suggested References based on recent user work activity. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with list form in Workflows
Summary: Starts a workflow with a form to collect the information you need to run the rest of your workflow.

Title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook for Mac
Summary: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on Mac devices.

Title: Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
Summary: Use the new PAYGO consumption-based meter to pay for your extra SharePoint storage needs. This reduces the operational overhead associated with purchasing extra storage packs and more seamlessly integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive.

Title: Power Automate: AI-assisted UI Automation repair
Summary: A new agentic debug run feature will be available in the flow designer. The UI automation repair interface launches while the flow is running, validating each selector used in the flow. It then proposes a new selector in case an existing one does not work as expected, after the user captures the respective element for reference.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
Summary: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

Summary: Now Copilot Search can return matching people for your broader people search queries. Allowing you to discover, disambiguate, and explore known and new people to contact. Title: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
Summary: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
Summary: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

Title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
Summary: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. Title: OneDrive: Manage access to the OneDrive Photos Desktop experience
Summary: OneDrive is adding administrative controls for the Photos experience on Windows. Organizations can manage whether users sign in with personal Microsoft accounts. These controls help IT teams align OneDrive Photos with their access, data governance, and device-management requirements.

Title: Outlook: Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachment for iOS and Android
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview sensitivity label inheritance from attachments. When users attach files with sensitivity labels, Outlook can automatically apply or recommend an email sensitivity label based on organizational policy settings. This helps organizations maintain consistent data classification and protection while reducing manual labeling effort.

Title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Outlook mobile apps
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors
Summary: Microsoft Entra will recognize Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors starting early November 2026, allowing users to satisfy MFA without additional passkeys. No configuration changes are needed, but organizations should update onboarding and MFA registration guidance accordingly.

Title: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
Summary: OneDrive for Business will improve Windows desktop sync error messages for paths exceeding the 520-character limit, guiding users to rename or move items without stopping sync. This update, rolling out January 2027, aims to reduce confusion and support tickets with no admin action required.

Title: Generally Available: Higher limit of Azure Blob Storage accounts per region per subscription
Summary: Higher Azure Storage account resource quotas are now generally available, supporting up to 1,000 storage accounts with standard endpoints per region, per subscription, up from the default of 250. Title: Windows updates are available for 2026 time zone changes in Canada
Summary: Windows updates support 2026 time zone changes in Manitoba, Alberta, and British Columbia, effective November 1, 2026, when clocks won't be set back. Install updates before then and select the new region-specific time zones to ensure correct local time on devices. Guidance for Outlook and Microsoft 365 is provided.

Summary: Microsoft Purview will retire DSPM classic and DSPM for AI classic by late January 2027, unifying capabilities into a single DSPM experience. Organizations using the classic versions must transition to the current DSPM experience for data security posture management, reporting, and investigations.

Summary: Microsoft Foundry now brings Claude models into Azure Cost Management alongside the rest of your Foundry spend, generally available. Until now, Claude charges appeared under SaaS rather than under the Foundry resource used to deploy them, and Claude deployments lacked the tags enterprises rely on for showback and chargeback, leaving finance and platform teams to reconcile costs by hand. Title: Generally Available: Azure Front Door profile and route level WAF policies
Summary: Announcing the general availability of profile and route level policies for Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) on Azure Front Door Premium. WAF policies are no longer limited to individual domains: you can now apply broad baseline protection across an entire Azure Front Door profile and use targeted policies for the routes that need different controls. Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Use Microsoft Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
Summary: Microsoft 365 now supports Microsoft Agent 365 agents using the Agent2Agent protocol as connected agents in declarative agents, expanding integration options. Administrators manage and approve these agents via the Microsoft 365 admin center. This update enables new AI interactions and requires review of data compliance and governance.

Title: Microsoft Dataverse - Custom connector definition access update
Summary: Beginning October 15, 2026, users assigned the Dataverse Basic User security role lose access to custom connector definitions they do not own or that have not been explicitly shared with them. How does this affect me? Users who rely on this access may no longer be able to view the affected connector definitions. This update makes no change to connector functionality. Title: Planner: Capacity view
Summary: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer name in Calendar View on Teams Panels
Summary: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels. Admins can toggle the "Show organizer name" setting ON or OFF in the Pro Management portal or on the panel device. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown in the calendar view on the panel device. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.

Title: Planner: Conditional Coloring
Summary: Conditional Coloring highlight tasks based on selected criteria, making priorities, status, and important task details easier to spot.

Title: Planner: Task History
Summary: Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax. Create richer, more readable messages while staying in the Markdown authoring experience.

Title: PowerPoint: Clear view-only messaging
Summary: When you open a presentation you don't have permission to edit, PowerPoint now shows a clear "Viewing Only" message bar. It explains that the file is view-only, shows who created it, and tells you to contact the owner if you need more access.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Boost contact center efficiency with real-time streaming analytics
Summary: Real-time streaming analytics is built into the new supervisor application. An advanced streaming engine keeps metrics up to date with near-instant updates, allowing supervisors to view the latest data without refreshing the dashboard.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint Site Builder
Summary: This feature enables users to easily create new SharePoint sites with Copilot. Users can review and confirm a clear site plan before Copilot builds the site.

Title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
Summary: Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh without having to build it yourself. Depending on the data source, authentication may be required.

Title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Support trade counter sales in POS
Summary: Trade Counter POS is a collection of capabilities for Dynamics 365 Commerce Point of Sale. Businesses can adopt the capabilities individually to support their trade counter operations rather than enable a single, all-or-nothing experience.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
Summary: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered int...

Title: Outlook: Reply with a Template in Rules
Summary: You can now create a rule that automatically replies to incoming messages with a template you've set up. Set the conditions you care about and pick the template, and Outlook handles the response for you. It's a simple way to send consistent replies without typing the same thing over and over. #newoutlookforwindows

Title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Optimized Customer data entities
Summary: Dynamics 365 Finance introduces a set of optimized customer data entities that provide more focused options for integrating customer information. Instead of relying on a single broad customer entity, organizations can work with purpose-specific entities for core customer information, extended customer attributes, postal addresses, electronic contact information, and customer associations.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Configure actions on task grid
Summary: This feature extends Task Grid View Templates so administrators can configure both task columns and the visibility of supported task-grid actions in one place. Administrators can show or hide individual actions across task-grid views, the toolbar, row-level controls, and the task context menu.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sustainability: Restate previously calculated emissions
Summary: Organizations can recalculate previously calculated emissions using a new restatement capability in Dynamics 365 Sustainability. Users can create a new calculation result while preserving the original result, helping maintain traceability between the original and restated emissions.

Title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Expand localization in LATAM countries for Argentina
Summary: With the release of Argentina, we are finalizing the LATAM expansion. Out-of-the-box localization is now available for 14 countries in the region through the cross-LATAM localization framework, in addition to Brazil and Mexico.

Title: Power Pages: First Class Support for Connector APIs in Power Pages
Summary: Native connectors support through Power Pages will allow organizations to securely connect their websites/portals directly to enterprise systems such as SQL, SAP, and Oracle, without building or maintaining custom integration layers.

Title: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
Summary: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
Summary: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

Title: Outlook: Multiple Intune Accounts in Outlook for Android
Summary: Multiple MAM (Mobile Application Management) Intune Accounts will now be supported in Outlook for Android. Only one MDM (Mobile Device Management) account will be supported at a time per device.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
Summary: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

Summary: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge. Title: Microsoft Viva: Import HRIS data in Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center
Summary: Customers will be able to use various connectors to HRIS tools to import HRIS data into Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
Summary: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning iss...

Title: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
Summary: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

Title: Microsoft 365: Companion apps - Copilot prompts in the Files app now available for Copilot Chat users
Summary: The Files companion app, part of the Microsoft 365 companion apps suite on the Windows taskbar, now surfaces AI-powered Copilot file prompts for Copilot Chat users. Previously available only to Microsoft 365 Copilot licensees, this update extends contextual file prompts to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users, enabling them to discover and interact with relevant files through intelligent suggestions. Users can find their most relevant files faster and take action on them directly from the Files app....

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Supercharge your workflows with computer use
Summary: Add resilient, AI-powered UI automation directly into your workflows with computer use tools. Makers can build reusable, goal-oriented automations that adapt dynamically to website or app changes, while admins maintain governance through access controls, hosted browser management, and environment-level permissions. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management– Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
Summary: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications...

Title: Microsoft Teams Default meeting template
Summary: Default meeting templates let IT admins set organization-wide meeting options for Teams meetings scheduled via Outlook or Teams calendar, ensuring consistency and protection. Rolling out worldwide in November 2026, only Teams Premium licensed organizers can use them. Admins create and assign templates; some meeting types are excluded.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Manage authoritative sources for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
Summary: Admins with Global admin or reader roles can manage up to 100 authoritative SharePoint Online sites in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search via the admin center, enhancing search relevance. This AI-driven feature rolls out worldwide in late September 2026 and includes centralized governance and bulk import/export capabilities.

Title: Change Optics Report
Summary: The Change Optics report for Exchange Online is now generally available worldwide, helping admins identify email traffic affected by upcoming service changes. Accessible in the Exchange Admin Center, it highlights onmicrosoft.com external traffic and Direct Send traffic to aid investigation and remediation. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
Summary: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, offering easier access and AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins mid-November 2026 worldwide, with no changes to licensing or admin settings. No action is required, but user communication is recommended.

Title: Outlook: Change the organizer of meetings
Summary: Microsoft is enabling Outlook users to transfer meeting organizer roles within their organization, improving meeting continuity during role changes or leave. The rollout begins November 2026 for non-online meetings, with phased support for Teams meetings and artifacts. The feature requires acceptance by the new organizer and preserves meeting content.

Title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Export Improvements
Summary: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update will enhance export capabilities in Inventory and Cloud Update views, adding more device and update details, filtered exports, and new columns like Cloud Update Status. Rollout starts November 2026. No action or compliance changes are needed.

Title: AI Builder credits retirement: Prepare to use Copilot Credits
Summary: Microsoft is retiring AI Builder credits by November 1, 2026, replacing them with Copilot Credits. Organizations must plan and purchase Copilot Credits before AI Builder credits expire to avoid service interruptions. AI Builder features continue, but licensing and credit management require admin action.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Malicious QR code detection in messages
Summary: Microsoft Teams will detect malicious QR codes in messages, providing warnings for phishing or fraud threats starting November 2026. This applies to chats and channels, with QR code blurring for external senders. The feature is enabled by default via Malicious URL protection, requiring no admin action.

Title: Audio Overview Updates
Summary: Microsoft is enhancing Audio Overview with topic-based episodes for easier navigation, support for more content types (OneNote, Loop, emails, Teams chats/meetings, .txt files), and sensitivity label inheritance when saving to OneDrive. The update rolls out globally from early to late November 2026 with no admin action needed.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Microsoft Teams messages
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 introduces a new MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Teams messages, enabling authorized security analysts to query message snippets and metadata for threat investigations. Rollout is from late September to mid-November 2026. Access requires specific permissions and may impact security procedures.

Title: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
Summary: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting mid-October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can reveal images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and update related guidance. The feature applies across all Teams platforms automatically.

Title: Copilot Studio - Information regarding the end of support for selected AI models
Summary: We are announcing the end of support for selected AI models on the Standard and GitHub Copilot harnesses in Copilot Studio. Beginning on each models' applicable migration date, the selected models will no longer be available in Copilot Studio, and agents will automatically migrate to a replacement model. How does this affect me? Agents configured with retiring models will be automatically migrated to a supported replacement model. The planned replacement model and migration date depends on both...

Title: Microsoft Entra: Users can register a passkey or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method
Summary: Microsoft Entra will allow users to register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method, removing the prior requirement to set up alternate MFA methods first. The phased rollout begins November 2026, aiming to simplify strong authentication adoption and reduce registration friction.

Title: Update to MC1510951: Canada 2026 time zone changes — Microsoft 365 impact and required admin actions
Summary: On November 1, 2026, certain Canadian regions will not change clocks, affecting Microsoft 365 scheduling. Admins must update Windows, Outlook time zones, review meetings, update Teams Rooms, and keep apps current. Testing and support case submission with #Canada Time-Zone are advised.

Title: Microsoft Purview: permissions audit log improvements
Summary: Microsoft Purview is enhancing audit logging for role-based access control, adding two new audit operations to improve transparency and troubleshooting of access checks. This update, rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, requires no action and provides administrators better visibility into access evaluations.

Title: Outlook: Reply With a Template in Rules
Summary: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules to auto-reply with saved templates, automating repetitive responses. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by late December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is required before rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
Summary: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow allowing admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. Rolling out mid-August 2026, it enhances data risk management and compliance without affecting user workflows unless configured by admins.

Title: Enhanced M365 Copilot Memory - Copilot is now personalized with work data
Summary: M365 Copilot now uses Microsoft 365 data to provide personalized work responses, rolling out worldwide from early October to November 2026. Users can disable this via settings, and admins can control it with enhancedPersonalizationSetting. No admin action or compliance issues are required.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams: Bilingual consecutive interpretation mode with Interpreter agent
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams introduces a new Consecutive Interpretation mode, enabling structured, turn-by-turn multilingual meetings. Rolling out from May to December 2026, it requires a Copilot license, needs no admin setup, and enhances interactive discussions without changing existing Interpreter features.

Title: Retirement notice: MDE and XDR Advanced Hunting APIs retiring; migrate to Microsoft Graph Security API
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting APIs by February 1, 2027. Organizations must manually migrate workflows to the Microsoft Graph Security API by January 31, 2027, to ensure continued functionality and improved security integration.

Summary: Row summaries are expanding to supported US Government clouds, giving users in regulated environments access to AI-generated insights that help them understand model-driven app records at a glance. This release brings the row summary experience available to commercial customers to supported government environments while meeting their applicable compliance and data-boundary requirements.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use overflow actions to protect customer experience for direct inward calls
Summary: Overflow for direct inward dialing leverages conversation orchestration to detect key direct inward dialing-related events—such as the representative being busy, offline, rejecting the call, or failing to answer—and apply administrator-defined fallback actions.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policies on email attachments
Summary: This feature extends governance capabilities to evaluate email attachments, closing a critical gap where sensitive or non-compliant information may exist outside the email body.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Manage policy strictness to enforce governance policies
Summary: This feature introduces policy strictness control, enabling organizations to define how rigorously each governance policy evaluates and flags potential violations in outgoing emails. Governance policies serve as real-time guardrails, ensuring communications adhere to business, legal, and compliance standards before they are sent to customers.

Title: Microsoft Teams Mobile: Ask Copilot from Search
Summary: Microsoft Teams mobile will let users ask Copilot directly from the search box on iOS and Android, with suggestions appearing after typing two words and an Ask Copilot button on search results. This feature rolls out worldwide from mid to late November 2026, requiring no admin action.

Title: Alternate text parameter for ODSP attached images in Teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams will support adding alt text to OneDrive/SharePoint-hosted images shared in chats, enhancing accessibility with screen reader descriptions. This feature rolls out worldwide from early to mid-December 2026, requires no admin action, and allows users to add or edit alt text without changing the original image files.

Title: Viva Insights: GitHub Copilot metrics will be on by default, and the public preview opt-in setting is being retired
Summary: GitHub Copilot metrics will be enabled by default in the Viva Insights Consumption dashboard starting mid-November 2026, retiring the public preview opt-in setting. Eligible tenants will see these metrics automatically, with existing access controls remaining. No admin action is required, but reviewing access and updating documentation is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Move email messages to quarantine with a new remediation action
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 introduces a new "Move to Quarantine" remediation action allowing admins to move suspicious emails from user mailboxes to Defender quarantine for safer investigation and management. It rolls out worldwide from November to December 2026, requiring no user action but recommended policy reviews and training updates.

Title: Teams admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
Summary: AI-powered meeting quality insights in Teams admin center provide proactive detection of issues by analyzing historical data, highlighting hotspots, root causes, and affected users with recommended actions. Rolling out worldwide and GCC from mid-November 2026. No configuration needed; accessible to designated Teams admins.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
Summary: Non-channel Microsoft Teams meeting notes, including Loop and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer’s OneDrive for Business starting mid-November 2026. This ensures consistent ownership without changing the collaboration experience. No configuration is needed, but update governance processes accordingly. Channel meeting notes storage remains unchanged.

Title: Teams Phone Agent is rolling out to general availability on Sept 30, 2026
Summary: Teams Phone Agent, an AI-powered calling solution for Microsoft Teams, will be generally available worldwide starting late September 2026. Usage-based billing with Copilot Credits requires admins to configure spending policies and security groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center to avoid default auto attendant settings.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Personalize outreach emails generated by Sales Qualification Agent
Summary: Define outreach scenario/goal in natural language.

Summary: Segment-specific qualification: Each agent operates with its own ideal customer profile, knowledge sources, templates, and consent settings, ensuring qualification conversations reflect the nuances of each product, region, or team.

Summary: Customize your view: choose a Contact or Lead view from the new view picker to define which columns appear in the segment members table.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Manage overnight shifts as a single continuous schedule
Summary: Supervisors can now create and manage overnight shifts that span across midnight while maintaining a single continuous shift experience. Shift plans support start and end times that extend into the next day, allowing organizations to accurately model overnight operations such as contact centers, support teams, healthcare services, and other 24x7 environments.

Title: Power Pages: Administration and governance - Configure site analytics and server logging
Summary: Gain insights into your Power Pages site with integrated telemetry and analytics. Use Application Insights to monitor page views, form interactions, session details, and client-side analytics. Detect server-side errors, performance issues, and access logs to resolve problems and optimize your site.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Modify and override submitted evaluations
Summary: This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired. While completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity, supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified, such as incorrect AI predictions or errors in manual assessments.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: IVR capabilities - Equip voice agents with custom voice
Summary: Secure a voice talent that will represent the voice of your brand. After obtaining explicit consent, gaining Limited Access approval through Microsoft's Responsible AI practices, and building a custom voice model, it's time to integrate with Dynamics 365 Contact Center.

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
Summary: AI agents in Business Central

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policy
Summary: Create and enforce policies that prevent risky or noncompliant customer communications.

Title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Digital commerce - Streamline multioutlet access for B2B web storefronts
Summary: The multioutlet B2B web storefront introduces a unified sign-in system that allows buyers to access all their associated organizations and outlets using a single account. The storefront UI is updated to display an organization selector during sign-in and provides outlet-specific navigation and catalog views. Buyers can place, track, and manage orders for multiple outlets within a single session, with real-time visibility into order status, inventory, and account information.

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup
Summary: You can now configure and run multiple Sales Order Agent instances in a single company. Each instance operates independently with its own mailbox, folder settings, email signature, and processing rules.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Resolve customer emails autonomously with AI
Summary: Autonomous email resolution delivers end-to-end handling of customer emails without manual intervention or default case creation. When an email arrives, the system analyzes the request, identifies the underlying intent, and determines whether the information and actions needed to resolve it are available.

Title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Planning - Protect confirmed CTP dates with Planning Optimization
Summary: Planning Optimization is the new high-performance planning engine for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. With this feature, Planning Optimization now protects material and capacity allocated to sales order lines with delivery dates confirmed through capable to promise (CTP). You prevent reallocation of resources to newer orders, so your confirmed delivery dates stay reliable, and customer commitments are honored.

Title: Power Pages: Administration and governance - Manage external authentication providers with granular controls
Summary: Power Pages now lets you manage external authentication providers with environment-level governance controls and optional site-level exceptions. You can centrally enforce which identity providers (IDPs) are allowed across all sites in an environment, while still enabling site-specific flexibility when needed. Makers will only see and select from the approved IDPs when setting up authentication, ensuring consistent governance and alignment with enterprise security policies.

Title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Omnichannel commerce - Add support for multiple outlet B2B ordering via CSU
Summary: Available for B2B scenarios in Dynamics 365 Commerce (including headless Commerce), this feature enables retailers to configure unified sign-in in Commerce headquarters and integrate third‑party storefronts using CSU APIs. The organization selector and related capabilities are exposed via CSU endpoints so that third-party sites can consume identities, organizational context, and ordering workflows without relying on native UI components.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Speaker attribution now  “On” by default in BYOD rooms with enhanced admin controls
Summary: New PowerShell setting (SpeakerAttributionBYOD in csTeamsAIPolicy), enabled by default, gives IT admins more control over speaker attribution in BYOD (bring your own device) meeting rooms. This enhances the experience for users by enabling clear speaker labels and richer in-meeting and post-meeting insights with Microsoft 365 Copilot. Users just enroll profiles via Teams Settings to be recognized.

Title: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
Summary: OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

Title: Outlook: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
Summary: Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot Chat takes on screen. When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
Summary: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365):  JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
Summary: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Default meeting templates
Summary: Default meeting templates enable IT admins to automatically apply their organization’s preferred meeting settings whenever users schedule a Teams meeting through Outlook or Teams calendar. This helps organizations apply meeting settings (including protection settings) at scale, and reduce the need for organizers to manually configure meeting options. Only organizers with a Teams Premium (T-Pre) license assigned can use Default Meeting Templates.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
Summary: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

Title: Planner: Custom Views for plans
Summary: Custom views lets users save a custom view of a plan and return to it later without re-applying filters, sorting, grouping, and other view customizations. A team can reuse saved views for triage, prioritization, work tracking, and more.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Explicit consent for recording & transcription in one-to-one PSTN calls
Summary: Microsoft Teams will support explicit consent for participants connected through the public switched telephone network (PSTN) in one-to-one calls. When explicit consent is required, PSTN participants will hear an audio prompt when recording or transcription is started. They can use their phone keypad to consent or decline. Participants who decline can remain in the call but stay muted. This capability extends the existing Teams calling policy for explicit consent to one-to-one PSTN calls.

Title: Power Apps: Use Power Platform connectors in generative pages
Summary: Makers can bring data from Power Platform connectors into generative pages. After creating and authenticating a connection and adding a connection reference to the environment, you select the connector data and describe how the generated page should use it. Connector data can be incorporated while working in the Maker Studio generative page designer or through the generative pages AI plugin.

Title: Power Apps: Expand model access and Maker Studio availability for generative pages via GitHub
Summary: Connect your GitHub account to access additional model options for the built-in gen page coding agent directly in the generative page designer in Maker Studio. Makers can use the agent to create and refine generative pages without leaving the Power Apps authoring experience.
