Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
Summary: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. The process includes readiness analysis, import execution, and reporting. Rollout begins mid-October 2026 (public preview) and late January 2027 (worldwide). It supports compliance via existing retention and audit tools.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: New integration with Adaptive protection
Summary: Microsoft Purview is introducing a public preview of Adaptive protection integration with Data Lifecycle Management, automatically retaining deleted content from elevated risk users for 120 days. Rollout begins late June 2024, with general availability in late December 2026. Admins can enable this via the Purview compliance portal.

Title: Generally Available: ABFS Vectored Read for Azure Data Lake Storage
Summary: ABFS Vectored Read helps compatible analytics engines reduce request overhead for selective reads in Azure Data Lake Storage. By combining nearby file ranges into fewer storage requests and executing reads asynchronously, it can reduce network round trips for workloads such as selective Parquet queries. Compatible Spark workloads can enable the capability through configuration, without rewriting queries or migrating data. Learn more .

Title: Insights Agent V2 Frontier
Summary: Insights Agent V2 is now available in Frontier, providing M365 admins tenant-level visibility into agent adoption and control over user feedback sharing. Feedback sharing is off by default and can be enabled in the Microsoft 365 admin center. No compliance issues identified. Public preview rollout is complete.

Title: Outlook: Copilot Prioritize feature will be retired
Summary: The Copilot Prioritize feature in Outlook will be retired starting October 26, 2026, with removal completed by March 2027. It will be removed from all Outlook clients without requiring opt-in. No admin action is needed, but users should be notified and support materials updated accordingly.

Title: Migrate your offline or signed-out devices to the Pro Management Portal for administration
Summary: Microsoft is transitioning Teams Android device management from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal by October 2026. Devices must run a supported Admin Agent version, updated automatically if online. Offline or outdated devices require manual updates to maintain management functionality. Administrators should verify updates and complete the transition steps promptly.

Title: New SharePoint Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
Summary: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android will roll out a redesigned home with a personalized Discover experience by late October to November 2026. It features improved site browsing, file previews, refreshed news, search, dark mode, and better performance, with no admin action required.

Title: Viva Engage: Email updates for users without a routable mailbox
Summary: Starting mid-October 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to users without valid mailboxes or routable email destinations, reducing email system load and improving delivery. Users with supported mailboxes and Teams notifications remain unaffected. No action is required, but review mailbox configurations and update support accordingly.

Title: End-of-support Android devices may not be manageable through the Pro Management Portal
Summary: Microsoft is transitioning Teams Android device management from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal by October 2026. Supported devices will auto-update to a required Admin Agent version, while end-of-support devices may lose manageability. Administrators should verify device updates and readiness for PMP.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will support certified third-party synthetic audio and video detection in meetings starting mid-November 2026. Organizations can integrate these solutions to enhance security against AI-generated media threats. Admins must deploy provider apps, grant permissions, and configure meeting policies. Detection is performed by third parties, with Microsoft Teams enabling integration.

Title: Power Platform – Update for read access to custom connector definitions for Basic User role
Summary: In October 2026, we are updating read access for custom connector definitions in Power Platform. Users assigned the Dataverse Basic User security role will no longer be able to read solution custom connector definitions unless the connector is owned by that user or explicitly shared with them. What action do I need to take? Please take the actions listed below:Review environments where users with the Basic User role need to read custom connector definitions. Create and assign a custom security r...

Title: Filter Messages by Events on Outlook Mobile
Summary: Outlook Mobile will add an "Events" filter to quickly find calendar invitations and event-related messages. Rolling out worldwide and in GCC environments from late August to late September 2026. No admin action needed; users can better manage meeting invites and RSVPs.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Phishing detection for messaging
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection starting November 2026, focusing on external first-contact chats and additional protection for mobile users in China. It identifies suspicious behavior without retaining message content, requires no admin action, and aims solely for security protection.

Title: Intelligent Call Delegation in Teams
Summary: Intelligent Call Delegation in Teams uses AI to answer calls, gather context, and schedule follow-ups via Microsoft Bookings, helping users focus on important conversations. Rolling out from November 2026 (preview) to January 2027 (general availability), it requires appropriate licensing and admin configuration. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Teams Rooms on Android with Teams Rooms Pro license will gain access to a private presenter chat in green room-enabled meetings/events when joined as organizers. This backstage chat appears as "Event group" or "Planning group." Rollout starts August 2025 (preview) and completes November 2026 (general availability). No admin action needed.

Title: Projects in Copilot
Summary: Projects in Copilot unify related chats, Cowork tasks, files, and context in one place, reducing repeated explanations. Available now in Cowork-tab (Windows, Mac, Web), with rollout to Chat and Cowork on Frontier soon. Files remain in OneDrive with existing permissions; no action or compliance concerns required.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Choose your own telephony provider for SMS and voice authentication
Summary: Starting October 30, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID allows organizations to choose a supported third-party telephony provider for SMS and voice authentication via Microsoft Security Store. Microsoft-provided SMS/voice authentication retires by February 1, 2027, except for some users until July 1, 2027. Organizations manage provider relationships directly.

Title: Microsoft 365 apps: Updated Brand Kit management experience
Summary: Microsoft 365 apps updated the Brand Kit management experience to simplify setup, streamline asset management, and improve workflows for Brand Managers. The update is available worldwide with no action required, helping organizations efficiently maintain on-brand content and scale creation using Copilot.

Title: New Outlook for Windows: All Accounts view brings email into a single inbox view
Summary: The new Outlook for Windows introduces an All Accounts view, a unified inbox showing emails from multiple accounts separately without merging. It supports AI-assisted workflows and search, rolling out globally by late October 2026. No admin action is needed now; controls will be available later.

Title: Microsoft OneNote: JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
Summary: Microsoft OneNote now supports using JPG and PNG images as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enabling Copilot to extract and use visual content for generating outputs. The feature is globally available since October 2026, requires no admin action, and affects users with Copilot Notebook access.

Title: Microsoft OneNote: CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
Summary: Microsoft OneNote now supports using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enhancing content generation with structured data. The feature is globally available since mid-October 2026, requires no user action, and automatically enables for tenants with existing CSV/TSV Copilot permissions.

Title: Power Apps: Monitor generative pages with out-of-the-box Application Insights telemetry
Summary: Admins and developers can monitor published generative pages with Application Insights. When an administrator configures Application Insights data export for an environment, Power Apps automatically exports completed page loads, unhandled errors, supported Data API operations, and navigation initiated from generative pages without requiring telemetry code, the Application Insights JavaScript SDK, or a connection string on the page.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Restrict task assignments to project team members
Summary: This feature strengthens assignment governance by limiting the resources displayed in the Assigned to column to members of the current project team. Project managers can assign tasks only to resources who have already been added to the project, instead of selecting from the organization’s complete resource list.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Glint - Teams notification customization
Summary: Viva Glint admins can now customize the Microsoft Teams notifications sent for surveys. Admins can edit the title, message, and button label in each survey language and see their changes in a live preview. Teams and email messages stay consistent and match your organization's voice, which helps more employees see the survey and take part.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Integration with Entra GSA Internet Access to enable sensitive file filtering at the network layer
Summary: Extend Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies to filter sensitive files at the network layer by integrating with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect files at the network layer and enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policy conditions. It helps prevent sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, apps, APIs, add-ins, and more - including generative AI platforms, clou...

Title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
Summary: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Extend Purview data security to the network layer via Entra GSA integration
Summary: Extend Microsoft Purview data security controls to the network layer to detect and protect sensitive data in text and prompts by integrating with Entra Internet Access. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policies, and detect risky user activity through Insider Risk Management. It helps prevent sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, app...

Title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
Summary: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done i...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification messages for recording and transcription in calls
Summary: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Audio announcement for recording and transcription

Title: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
Summary: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

Title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Keep Project Staffing and Field Service Scheduling Aligned
Summary: Deliver consistent scheduling outcomes across Dynamics 365 Project Operations and Field Service, regardless of where scheduling begins. When a project task includes resource assignments and planned effort, that demand is represented on the related work order with the same role, resource, duration, and scheduling window. Users can therefore schedule the same demand from either application and receive consistent availability and booking results. When multiple assignments exist, dispatchers can sel...

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense reports per trip automatically
Summary: Expense Agent can automatically create expense reports based on identified business trips. You just need to configure the feature on the Expense Agent Setup page. Instead of manually collecting and organizing individual expense entries, you can use the agent to group relevant expenses and generate a dedicated expense report for each trip. Key capabilities include:

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - SLA Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
Summary: Out-of-box MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA Alert Reporting dashboard showing past trends, Top SITs getting exposed via DLP alerts generated. Customers can define their custom SLAs for high, med and low severity alerts and get access to dashboard showing operational performance and SLA metrics.

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use Expense Manager role center
Summary: The Expense Manager Role Center is updated to provide a more focused and efficient experience for managing vendor and expense-related activities. The enhancements align the workspace with typical expense management workflows, ensuring that key information and actions are readily accessible. Where relevant, other Role Centers are also updated to include access to expense management features.

Title: Power Apps: Use Dataverse custom APIs in generative pages
Summary: Makers can have a generative page call a Dataverse custom API to run server-side business logic, such as approving an order, recalculating a price, or validating a transaction. From either the Maker Studio generative page designer or the generative pages AI plugin, makers select a prepared API and describe when the page should call it, which input values to provide, and how to use the response.

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add an interim approver when you submit an expense report
Summary: This feature introduces support for a simple interim approval scenario for expense reports. When someone submits an expense report, organizations can designate an interim approver to review and approve expenses before the final approver can review and approve. Interim approver must review expense reports to confirm whether they're complete and compliant before final approver.

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Use approvals with fixed asset journals
Summary: Organizations can use approval workflows with Fixed Asset Journals, which gives them the same level of control and oversight for fixed assets that's available for other journals in Business Central.

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Use batch totals for payment journals
Summary: The Batch Total field on the Payment Journal page enhances payment processing by enabling you to work with and review a cumulative total for a payment journal batch. By surfacing batch-level totals directly in payment journals, organizations gain better control over outgoing payments and can streamline review and approval processes.

Title: Power Apps: Form fill assistance supports more field types
Summary: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to support lookup, rich text, and multi-select choice fields, helping users complete more of their forms with AI-powered suggestions and less manual entry.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Simplified Energy Saver
Summary: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options. Edge will now support and recommend users to use the BatterySaverModeAvailability policy to manage the energy saver feature. The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged. The default will be for energy saver to be enabled on low battery. Energy saver will now have one mode. Users set to Balanced savings will be mapped to h...

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent is now available
Summary: Autonomous agent that researches, qualifies, engages with leads, scaling sales capacity 24/7.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Support Approver Comments for Expense Reports in Expense Management Mobile app
Summary: Approvers using the Expense Management Mobile App currently have limited options to provide context when approving or rejecting expense reports. Approval decisions may require comments to provide justification, request clarification, document additional information, or communicate feedback to employees. Without this capability in the mobile experience, approvers may need to switch to the web application to complete the approval process.

Title: Power Apps: Form fill assistance in apps can provide suggestions for existing values
Summary: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to suggest updates to fields that already contain values—not just empty fields. This helps users update existing information with ease using AI-powered skills in their apps.

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting October 21st, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this lat...

Title: Announcing: Choose Your Own Telephony (CYOT) for Microsoft Entra
Summary: What and why Starting October 30, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will make the Choose Your Own Telephony Provider experience available. This feature enables organizations to use a supported third-party telecommunications provider for SMS and voice authentication. Organizations select a supported provider through Microsoft Security Store and manage their commercial relationship directly with the provider. Microsoft recommends phishing-resistant authentication methods, such as passkeys, instead of SMS o...

Title: Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation
Summary: Safe Key Rotation for Azure Cosmos DB is now generally available. You can view timestamp metadata showing when each account key was last used, helping you identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials. This visibility helps reduce the risk of service disruptions caused by disabling keys that are still in use. It also gives you actionable insights to improve credential management, maintain application continuity, and support modern security and compliance practices. Learn more .

Title: Microsoft Publisher: Reminder that support ends in October 2026
Summary: Microsoft Publisher support ends October 1, 2026, and it will be removed from Microsoft 365 Apps via updates starting November 2026. Users should convert or migrate .pub files to Word, PowerPoint, or Microsoft Create before then, as Publisher will no longer open or edit files after this date.

Title: Microsoft 365 settings enabled by default for newly created Engage communities
Summary: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. Rollout completes by November 2026. Community owners can adjust settings via the My Account portal. No admin action is required. Existing communities update later this fall.

Title: Microsoft Copilot: UBB models in Chat and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint via the model selector
Summary: Usage-based billing (UBB) models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, will be available in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint starting November 2026. Access requires enabling UBB, assigning credits, and a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Admins manage billing and credit allocation.

Title: Copilot Studio - Enhanced support for Copilot Chat agents
Summary: We are announcing the enhancement to improve support for building Copilot Chat agents, also known as declarative agents, that provide authoritative answers and standardized content in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on October 26, 2026. How does this affect me? Copilot Studio users will see the following capabilities when building Copilot Chat agents: Topics for deterministic conversational flows Connected agents to delegate work Evaluations to improve agent quality...

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio - Improvements to agent Evaluations experience
Summary: We are enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior in Microsoft Copilot Studio. This feature is now available. How does this affect me? The improvements will bring new capabilities that help makers identify quality issues more quickly, understand why evaluations succeed or fail, compare results across runs, and create higher quality evaluation datasets with less manual effort. Additional validation and guidance will help makers resolve configu...

Title: Microsoft Copilot - Admin controls to manage Business Applications in Work IQ
Summary: We are announcing the public preview of admin controls for managing Business Applications in Work IQ. This feature enables business applications data to help ground AI experiences alongside Microsoft 365 productivity data, while providing layered controls over which experiences, environments, apps, and data can participate. This feature will reach public preview by November 17, 2026. How does this affect me? Your organization will be able to make business applications data available to Work IQ e...

Title: Clipchamp/ Copilot 'Create a video' experience is going to have an admin control available
Summary: Microsoft Clipchamp will add an admin policy control to manage user access to the AI-powered "Create a video" feature, rolling out worldwide from late November to early December 2026. Admins can enable or restrict this feature via Microsoft 365 admin center policies. No user action is needed if access is allowed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce an onboarding workflow to automatically connect new members to relevant channels, improving engagement and onboarding speed. Rollout starts November 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by mid-December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is needed; inform team owners accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
Summary: Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
Summary: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Can Join Channel Meetings
Summary: Facilitator can now join meetings set up in Teams channels. Facilitator helps participants run more effective meetings through the ability to take live notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and capture tasks.

Title: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable semantic data understanding for agentic use
Summary: Give AI agents and Copilot a true understanding of your business data — not just raw schema — so they can answer questions accurately with less manual configuration.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
Summary: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. Available in the Viva Engage app and Viva Engage in Teams mobile, the hub highlights top and sponsored campaigns, enables users to browse active and completed campaigns, and makes it easy to view campaign details and follow the campaigns that matter to them.

Title: OneDrive: Sync support for up to 1 million items on macOS
Summary: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. This preview requires the Insiders ring and that devices meet minimum hardware and configuration requirements. Devices that don't meet these requirements continue to sync at the existing 300,000-item supported limit with no disruption.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
Summary: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

Title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
Summary: Cloud Update is expanding rollback options for devices on Monthly Enterprise Channel. Administrators will be able to roll back devices to a release from two versions prior, with the latest available security updates for that release, and keep devices in the rolled-back state across subsequent releases until they are ready to resume updates. This provides additional time to investigate and resolve compatibility issues while maintaining security coverage and centralized control through the Microso...

Title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
Summary: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

Title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric
Summary: Connect Business Central to Microsoft Fabric to make business data available for analytics, reporting, and data integration.

Title: Outlook: Teams Meeting Options
Summary: When you add a Teams meeting to an event in Outlook for Mac, the join link and dial-in details now appear in the invite while you're still writing it. A new Meeting Options button lets you change the Teams meeting settings right away, before you send.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Simplify the creation of recurring expenses
Summary: This feature enables employees to automatically generate expense entries for predictable, repeatable business expenses (for example, monthly mobile bills, internet charges, parking, and subscriptions) without manual re-entry each period. It reduces repetitive effort, improves compliance, and ensures timely and accurate expense submission, while respecting organizational expense policies and approval workflows.

Title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Multi-grader comparison
Services: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration
Summary: Multi-grader comparison enables makers to compare the results of multiple graders applied to the same evaluation.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support permission sync missed in incremental crawl
Summary: Earlier, permissions were synced only in the periodic full crawl which generally ha a default frequency of 1 day for most of the connectors. Now, we have support for doing permission syncs more frequently in an incremental way.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Organize and merge PDF files in the built-in PDF reader
Summary: Users can organize and merge PDF files in the Microsoft Edge built-in PDF reader. They can select pages to extract, delete, rotate, or reorder, and save the result as a new PDF file. They can also merge the open PDF file with other PDF files that are open in Microsoft Edge tabs or stored on their device, to create a single PDF file. Files are processed on the device, and the original files aren't modified. Admins can manage this feature using the PdfOrganizeAndMergeEnabled policy.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-View-only access to device onboarding with the View-Only Device Management role
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is introducing more granular, role-based access to the Devices page under Settings → Device Onboarding. Previously, viewing or managing device onboarding required broad administrative roles (such as Compliance Administrator, Global Administrator, or Security Administrator). With this update, organizations can grant access using least-privilege Purview role-based access control (RBAC) roles scoped specifically to device operations.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS. Updated October 20, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Manage intraday operations with AI agent

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
Summary: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

Title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Enhanced Rollout Waves
Summary: New improvements are coming to the rollout wave functionality for Cloud Update. These enhancements will allow organizations to continue leveraging Microsoft Entra ID groups to set up rollout waves, with increased flexibility to configure more than the current limit of three waves. Additionally, admins will be able to assign custom delays between each wave, streamlining phased deployments and offering greater control over update distribution.

Title: Microsoft 365: Backup Activity Logs
Summary: In product monitoring logs to track all activities related to backup policy configuration & restore related tasks. This will help admins with troubleshooting, monitoring, reporting and auditing capabilities.

Title: Microsoft 365 apps: Introducing Update Repair in Inventory
Summary: Update Repair in Inventory helps admins identify and fix Windows devices with outdated or problematic Microsoft 365 apps via the admin center. It enables remote Online Repair for eligible devices, rolling out from October to November 2026. Admins must enable Inventory and notify users before repairs.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will automatically provide AI-generated intelligent summaries starting November 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. No configuration is needed, existing permissions remain, and there is no user impact. Organizations can notify teams or update documentation if desired.

Title: Public Preview: Disable VNet peering route
Summary: Announcing the public preview of disable VNet peering route, a route-table capability that gives you more control over traffic between peered virtual networks. DPR suppresses system-generated peering routes on subnets associated with the route table while preserving the peering connection itself. In large hub-and-spoke networks, you can pair this feature with a summarized user-defined route to direct traffic through a network virtual appliance, such as Azure Firewall, instead of maintaining a se...

Title: Dataverse - Prompt columns support multiple lines of text output
Summary: We are announcing the ability to store multiple lines of text as prompt column output to enable makers to save longer and more detailed AI-generated insights in Dataverse tables. This feature will reach general availability on November 16, 2026. How does this affect me? Once available, new prompt columns will include multiple lines of text as an output option. Existing prompt columns will continue to work as expected but will not have this option. What action do I need to take? This message is f...

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: OneDrive sync supports up to 1 million items on macOS
Summary: OneDrive sync on macOS will increase its item limit from 300,000 to 1 million per device, starting with a Public Preview in mid-October 2026 for Insiders ring users. Devices not meeting hardware requirements will remain at the current limit, with no disruption expected.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Copilot actions in the File Explorer context menu are being retired
Summary: Microsoft is retiring several OneDrive Copilot actions from the File Explorer context menu by early December 2026, simplifying usage. Users can still access Copilot features via right-click "Ask Copilot," the File Explorer Home icon, or the OneDrive activity center. No admin action is needed.

Title: Generally Available: Service tag match condition for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
Summary: Announcing the general availability of the service tag match condition for Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) custom rules on Azure Front Door Premium. Service tags represent groups of IP address prefixes used by Azure services, and Microsoft updates them automatically as addresses change. Custom rules can now match a HTTP request's source IP address against service tags, so you can control traffic from Azure services without building and maintaining lists of IPs. With service tag matching, yo...

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
Summary: OneDrive for the web will adopt the modern SharePoint document library experience, featuring improved navigation and enhanced filtering across views. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, completing by late October. Changes are enabled by default, with no impact on permissions or policies; no user action required.

Title: Generally Available: Keyless TLS on Application Gateway with Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
Summary: Azure Application Gateway now supports keyless TLS termination using certificates whose private keys stay in Azure Key Vault Managed HSM. Each TLS handshake signature is performed inside the HSM, and the private key is never exported to the gateway. This integration helps you: Maintain private key custody within a dedicated HSM boundary. Use managed identities and role-based access control for key access. Monitor signing operations through Managed HSM diagnostic logs. Obtain cryptographic eviden...

Title: Microsoft Viva - Copilot Analytics: Export agent data from the Agent Dashboard
Summary: Microsoft Viva will add a new export feature in the Agent Dashboard by mid-November 2026, allowing eligible users with at least 50 Copilot licenses to download de-identified Copilot agent usage data for up to six months. Admins can manage or disable this feature via Viva Feature Access Management.

Title: Generally Available: Advanced platform metrics for Azure Monitor
Summary: Advanced platform metrics for Azure Monitor are now generally available. Advanced platform metrics provide finer-grained signals that help customers more quickly and accurately identify changes and trends within their resources. With this release, customers can enable advanced platform metrics directly from the Azure portal, with an in-product banner prompting enablement for subscriptions where the feature is not yet enabled. Advanced platform metrics are also now available in Fairfax and Moonca...

Title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Permission changes for select App Governance Entra roles
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps will update App Governance permissions for select Microsoft Entra roles starting mid-November 2026. Changes include role-based access control alignment with Defender XDR, affecting Cloud App Security, Compliance Administrator, and Compliance Data Administrator roles. Admins should review and update role assignments accordingly.

Title: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
Summary: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy will replace EWS by October 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid service disruption; Gov rollout is paused. Hybrid/on-premises scenarios are excluded.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will allow adding Facilitator to channel meetings starting early February 2027, enabling note-taking, agenda management, Q&A, and task management. The rollout is delayed from November 2026, requires no action, and affects organizations with Facilitator enabled and licensed users.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS

This ensures that aggregates can be reliably traced back to original inputs.

Summary: When employees receive cash advances in one currency and settle expenses in another (or on different dates), foreign exchange rate differences arise. This feature detects, calculates, and posts realized exchange rate variances between the advance issue rate and the settlement or report rate, ensuring accurate reimbursement amounts, GL impact, and auditability without manual adjustments.

Summary: The improvements to project quote provide usability enhancements designed to modernize and streamline the experience. The goal is to reduce unnecessary complexity, improve clarity, and enable users to work more efficiently when creating and managing quotes.

Summary: This feature provides a standard framework for integrating the Warehouse management module in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management with external labor management systems. With this framework, you can connect warehouse execution data to a third-party LMS. This connection gives you advanced capabilities for labor planning, scheduling, and performance tracking. Summary: Get the next best actions for leads right on your Dynamics 365 leads grid, and navigate to see Sales Qualification Agent's research and pregenerated email suggestions. The actions show a preview of the lead, a summary of why it's a hot or high-intent lead, and the topic that the lead is interested in.

Summary: Microsoft Teams will send separate event invites for Attendees, Presenters, and Co-organizers, helping organizers manage town hall invites distinctly. Rollout starts early December 2026, completing by mid-January 2027, with no admin action needed. Users should be notified and documentation updated accordingly.

Summary: Private network gateway for Azure Databricks is now in Public Preview, enabling serverless compute to connect to resources in your virtual network (VNet) and transitively connected networks through a single managed gateway. Summary: External key management for Azure Key Vault Managed HSM is now generally available in all Azure public regions. Managed HSM delegates key wrap and unwrap operations through a customer-operated proxy; the extern...

Title: Microsoft Copilot: Additional content safety protections for students under 18
Summary: Microsoft Copilot will automatically enable additional content safety protections for users aged 13-17, identified by the teen ageGroup in Entra ID, starting mid-October 2026. This ensures a safer, age-appropriate experience with no required configuration changes. Organizations should inform users and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Publish and unpublish controls for official brand kits
Summary: Microsoft PowerPoint will introduce publish and unpublish controls for Official Brand Kits in mid-October 2026, allowing Brand Managers to temporarily remove or restore brand assets without deleting them or changing permissions, enhancing brand content management and availability within organizations. No action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Customize file extensions blocked by Weaponizable File Protection
Summary: Microsoft Teams will allow admins to customize file extensions blocked by Weaponizable File Protection starting November 2026. Organizations can use the default Microsoft list or create a custom list, with the option to revert to the default for automatic updates. User experience remains unchanged. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for Android: Multi-select and bulk actions in search results
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for Android will add multi-select and bulk actions in search results starting mid-October 2026, allowing users to manage multiple emails at once. This feature, already on iOS, improves efficiency without requiring admin action; users should be informed and keep the app updated.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal plugins in Word and Cowork
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces legal plugins in Word and Cowork to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline documents using Microsoft 365 context and third-party sources. Rollout occurs from April to December 2026. Admins can enable or disable these plugins; no setup is required.

Title: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and additional apps ended on October 13, 2026
Summary: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and related apps ended on October 13, 2026, with no more security updates or support. Organizations should upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office LTSC 2024 to maintain security, compliance, and support. Admins must identify and update affected devices promptly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced channel meeting experience
Summary: Microsoft Teams will enhance channel meetings, allowing scheduling from Teams calendar and Outlook, easier discovery for channel members, and delegate scheduling. Rollout starts November 2026, completing by September 2027 across environments. No admin action needed; informing users is recommended. No compliance issues identified.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Browser-native XSLT will be disabled by default
Summary: Microsoft Edge will disable browser-native XSLT by default starting mid-December 2026 to reduce security risks. Organizations should identify and migrate affected applications before Edge Stable 159. A temporary XSLTEnabled policy will be available but removed by Edge 176 in Summer 2027.

Title: Intune ending support for Windows MDM-only enrollment CNAME auto-discovery
Summary: Starting January 15, 2027, Intune will end support for DNS CNAME auto-discovery in Windows MDM-only enrollment. Organizations using this must have users manually enter the Microsoft enrollment server URL. Existing devices and other enrollment methods remain unaffected. Update enrollment procedures accordingly.

Title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive/SharePoint web viewer
Summary: We're enabling PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. With this update, users who have the appropriate usage rights can annotate these protected PDFs in place in their browser while preserving the file's sensitivity label, encryption, and usage rights when changes are saved.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Full-screen mode on task grid
Summary: Task grid full-screen mode enables project managers and team members to expand the task grid to use the available screen space. By minimizing surrounding page elements, users gain a larger workspace for viewing and managing task hierarchies, schedules, assignments, dependencies, and other task details.

Title: SharePoint: Copilot Search in SharePoint and OneDrive
Summary: Copilot Search brings AI-powered, natural-language search to SharePoint and OneDrive, combining relevant results, AI-generated summaries with source references, intuitive filters, and a seamless handoff to Copilot.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Watermarking Protection
Summary: Watermarking Protection in Microsoft Edge helps organizations visibly reinforce data protection policies by overlaying a persistent watermark on sensitive content viewed in the browser. This feature is designed to deter unauthorized sharing, support compliance efforts, and increase user awareness when handling confidential information.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
Summary: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

Title: Microsoft Edge: v.154 - Sign in to Edge with a Google account
Summary: Users can now sign in to Microsoft Edge using a Google account in addition to the Microsoft account from the profile menu and Edge sign-in screen. Available for Windows and macOS devices. Admins can control availability to this feature using the NonMicrosoftAccountSignInEnabled policy.

Title: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame people labels in Teams Rooms on Windows
Summary: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants and provide a hover-over contact card using voice and face profiles on intelligent cameras and in the cloud. Available with Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

Title: Excel: Excel canvas
Summary: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

Title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Microsoft Copilot in Field Service Mobile app
Summary: Microsoft Copilot in the Dynamics 365 Field Service mobile app brings conversational AI chat capabilities directly to frontline workers. Once enabled, technicians can ask natural-language questions about Dynamics 365 Field Service data and receive contextual answers based on the app experience and their organization’s Dataverse data. Title: Microsoft Teams: Admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
Summary: Gain proactive visibility into meeting quality across your organization with AI-powered insights in the Teams admin center that identify emerging patterns, highlight impacted users and locations, and surface likely causes with recommended actions. This helps IT administrators detect and address issues earlier, improve meeting quality, and stay ahead of potential disruptions.

Title: Microsoft Dataverse: Prompt column values in bulk for existing records (backfill)
Services: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration
Summary: Prompt columns can now generate AI values for records that already exist in your table, not just new or updated ones. Makers can choose to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk, optionally filtered to just the rows they need, so historical data gets the same AI-generated insights as incoming data, without touching each record one at a time.

Title: Power Apps: Prompt Columns - multiple lines of text output
Summary: Prompt columns can now store multilple lines of text as prompt output, enabling longer and detailed AI-generated insights to be stored in your tables.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
Summary: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
Summary: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

Title: Access: Rounded corners on Access form controls
Summary: We’re making it easier to give your Access apps a polished, up-to-date feel. With the new CornerRadius property, you can add rounded corners to form controls—bringing a softer, more modern look to your designs.

Title: Viva Engage: Community feeds improvements
Summary: Viva Engage communities will default to viewing conversations by recent posts instead of recent activity starting October 2026. Users can still choose their preferred feed and sort order, with settings saved across communities. Unread indicators will appear in both new and all feeds. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels by late January 2027, automatically displaying enrolled in-room participants’ names and contact cards to remote attendees, enhancing hybrid meeting clarity. The feature requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, voice and face recognition enrollment, and can be managed via Teams meeting policies.

Title: Microsoft Planner: Capacity view
Summary: Microsoft Planner's new Capacity view, launching late October 2026, shows a live staffing timeline from existing task data for Plan 3 licensed users on web and desktop (Teams, Outlook). It helps spot workload distribution without extra reports. No admin action needed; users should keep task details updated.

Title: Microsoft Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
Summary: Planner Agent chat is being added to Microsoft Planner basic plans, enabling users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to interact via natural language for plan management, insights, and task updates. Rollout begins September 2026, with admin controls to enable or block access.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Video sharing from OneDrive in Teams events
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon allow event organizers and producers to share videos directly from OneDrive during Teams events using "Manage what attendees see," enabling smoother, higher-quality playback without screen sharing. Rollout begins November 2026; no action is required, but informing organizers and updating guidance is recommended.

Summary: Azure Files customers can now copy and synchronize file share data across storage accounts, Azure regions, and subscriptions within the same tenant using Azure Storage Mover. Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will localize the default "Mark and notify" email template based on users' Outlook language settings, improving clarity in user-reported message notifications. Title: Generally Available: Standard service endpoint
Summary: Standard service endpoint, a new capability in the Azure Private Link family, provides a scalable and secure approach for connecting Azure IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services. Title: Calls popout into a new window on the browser to support multi-tasking and collaboration during a meeting
Summary: Microsoft Teams for Web will introduce a Picture-in-Picture Call Monitor allowing users to manage meetings in a separate window while multitasking in other browser tabs. The rollout starts mid-October 2026 for supported browsers like Edge and Chrome, requiring no admin action but user awareness and supported browser versions.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams introduces Facilitator, an AI feature that detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings by providing relevant answers via web search in the chat. Available from December 2026, it requires Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) and must be manually enabled. Admin controls and user opt-out are supported.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Improved file sharing experience in external chats
Summary: Microsoft Teams is enabling default file attachment (paperclip and drag-and-drop) in external chats, storing files in the sender’s OneDrive with automatic permission assignment per existing OneDrive/SharePoint policies. Organizations can opt out via Teams PowerShell. Existing sharing restrictions remain unchanged. User training and policy review are recommended.

Summary: Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets is now generally available. This feature continuously monitors scale sets deployed across availability zones and automatically redistributes VM instances when zonal imbalances occur. This helps reduce the risk that a single-zone outage disproportionately affects an application. Title: Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. Rollout starts early November 2026, completing by mid-November. Users can enable, disable, and reorder these sections; no admin action is needed.

Summary: Microsoft is introducing a default-on public preview of a data export feature in the Copilot Dashboard for users with full company-level access. It enables export of de-identified, weekly Copilot usage metrics from the past six months to analyze adoption and optimize licensing. Requires 50+ Copilot licenses.

Summary: On October 14, 2026, the Word Online (Business) connector will remove its dependency on temporary, pre-authorized download URLs. Summary: Beginning with the October 2026 security update, Windows 11, versions 26H2, 25H2, and 24H2, along with Windows Server 2025 enforce restrictions on generating NTLMv1-derived credentials for Single Sign-On by default. Title: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Sensitivity labels for Microsoft Entra security groups
Summary: Microsoft Purview will enable sensitivity labels for Microsoft Entra cloud security groups starting mid-November 2026, allowing administrators to apply and enforce governance policies on these groups. Labels can be assigned via multiple platforms, cannot yet be changed once applied, and require separate tenant configuration from Microsoft 365 groups.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Count of labeled documents condition for Exchange Online
Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP introduces a new Exchange Online condition to detect emails with a high count of sensitivity-labeled attachments, enhancing data protection. Available from November 2026, it allows admins to set thresholds for labeled files in emails, combining volume and content signals for better DLP policy enforcement.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription options align with admin policies
Summary: Microsoft Teams will update meeting options to show only automatic recording and transcription settings allowed by assigned policies, adding a new "Record only" option. This change, rolling out November-December 2026, improves policy compliance and reduces confusion. No admin action is needed; communication to organizers is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Excel: Changes to Get Data from Web (Legacy) experience
Summary: Microsoft Excel will phase out the legacy Get Data from Web experience starting January 2027, encouraging use of the newer version with enhanced features. Existing legacy queries will still refresh, but new or edited legacy queries will be disabled. Users should update training and consider migrating queries to the new experience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Phishing Detection in Teams Messaging
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing AI-powered phishing detection that uses conversation context to identify phishing and social engineering in higher-risk messaging scenarios, primarily external first-contact chats. Additional protection may apply in certain regions or scenarios. The capability is used only for security protection, and users may see warnings when suspicious activity is detected.

Title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot response personalization - Memory citations
Summary: When Copilot Chat uses memory to personalize a response, users can now see what informed the answer. Select Sources beneath the response, then open the Personalization tab to view the custom instructions, saved memories, memories learned from conversations, and past chats that shaped the response. From there, users can return to a cited chat to pick up where they left off or review and delete saved memories. Memory citations appear only when memory is turned on.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality evaluation - One-Time Evaluation Frequency
Summary: Quality evaluation plans now support a Once frequency type for both case evaluations and conversation evaluations. When creating an evaluation plan, users can select Once from the Frequency type dropdown to run the evaluation a single time instead of on a recurring schedule or trigger-based cadence.

Title: Planner: Planner Agent in Copilot V2 Improvements
Summary: Planner Agent brings Planner’s intelligent work management directly into Copilot Chat, enabling users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared basic plans without switching context. Integrated across Microsoft 365, it provides insights into priorities, deadlines, and at-risk work, along with interactive task cards to help users stay organized and keep work moving.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
Summary: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Out of the box real time translation on digital channels
Summary: With this feature, users get an out-of-the-box solution for translation services, so they don't need to bring their own web resources.
