Summary: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting memory files capturing key meeting insights to enhance Microsoft 365 Copilot and Facilitator responses. These files, stored securely in tenant-owned SharePoint, are enabled by default with admin controls and configurable retention. Rollout starts November 2026, requiring no immediate action but admin review.

Title: Microsoft Copilot: New ways to work across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365
Summary: Microsoft Copilot updates include a new Home experience, enhanced Office integration, Code and Autopilot features with usage-based billing, Copilot Managed Runtime for enterprise code, and general availability in SharePoint and OneDrive. Admins must configure spending policies and manage access via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Channel agent orchestration with GitHub, Asana, and Jira via Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Summary: Microsoft Teams' Channel Agent integration with GitHub, Asana, and Jira via Model Context Protocol (MCP) rollout is paused. This feature enables task orchestration across tools within Teams, requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and will be previewed with admin enablement when resumed.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales - Information regarding the retirement of the Dynamics 365 Sales Insights standalone add-on
Summary: Starting November 1, 2026, Dynamics 365 Sales Insights as a standalone add-on will have reached end of support. Sales Insights is a legacy offering whose capabilities are already included in Sales Premium. Sales Premium delivers the Sales Insights capabilities at the same price as the Sales Enterprise + Sales Insights combination. It also includes Copilot Credits, additional Dataverse storage capacity, and access to new Sales Premium capabilities. This change is intended to reduce licensing comp...

Title: Microsoft 365 Backup: Full workload backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange
Summary: Microsoft 365 Backup introduces Full Workload Backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange, enabling admins to protect entire workloads with one policy. It automatically covers all existing and new artifacts, reduces admin effort, and supports enterprise data protection. Rollout begins July 2026; admin configuration is required to enable.

Title: Whiteboards created in Teams channels will now be stored in SharePoint
Summary: Microsoft planned to store Teams channel Whiteboards in SharePoint for better access and compliance but decided not to proceed with this change. No action is required from admins, and existing storage in users' OneDrive remains. Compliance and access policies continue as before.

Title: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
Summary: Microsoft Teams meetings can now be linked to existing Microsoft Planner plans, allowing tasks to be tracked in one place instead of multiple plans. This feature, rolling out late December 2026 to January 2027, is enabled by default and supports automated or manual task creation via Facilitator.

Title: Unified management of app and agent availability and installation in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
Summary: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers. Availability unification began in September 2025 in phases, with automatic unification planned. Installation unification starts late September 2026, synchronizing settings without admin action for eligible tenants.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Skills in Copilot Chat
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat now supports customizable skills for task-specific instructions, usable by end users and deployable by admins. Skills integrate with plugins, are discoverable in the Agent Store, and work across Copilot Chat and Cowork. Rollout begins October 2026, with Information Barriers support in November.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for Android and iOS: Send Availability functionality restored
Summary: The Send Availability feature is restored in Microsoft Outlook for Android and iOS, allowing users to share their meeting availability easily while composing emails. iOS users can also access it via the keyboard and VoiceOver. The update is available worldwide with no action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
Summary: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

Title: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection in Teams messaging
Summary: Microsoft Teams will provide additional protection for QR codes shared by external users in messages. Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require users to reveal them before viewing or scanning. This helps reduce the risk of phishing and fraud by encouraging more deliberate interaction with QR code content.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
Summary: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

Title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
Summary: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

Title: Outlook: Improved SharePoint file experience in file picker in Outlook mobile apps
Summary: Users can more easily work with SharePoint files in Outlook by saving email attachments directly to SharePoint and searching across SharePoint sites for files from the file picker.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover and use shared plugins in Copilot Studio
Summary: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities. This integration provides a more consistent way to extend agents with capabilities across Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

Title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Improved Matrix visual performance for large table
Summary: Business Performance Planning introduce Virtualization to optimizes how the Matrix visual renders large planning datasets. Rather than loading and displaying the entire dataset at once, the visual progressively renders the rows and columns needed as users scroll, expand, collapse, and navigate through the Matrix. This reduces the amount of data processed by the browser at any one time and helps maintain visual responsiveness at scale.

Title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Customize the Procurement Agent supplier follow-up criteria
Summary: Organizations often use business-specific data and criteria to determine when suppliers require follow-up on purchase orders. The Procurement Agent will enable buyers to extend supplier follow-up criteria using related standard, extended, and custom table data. Buyers can add table joins and use fields from those tables as filter conditions, providing greater flexibility to determine which purchase order lines qualify for supplier follow-up based on their organization’s processes and data.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Pro Management portal Analytics & Reports Design Refresh
Summary: We are refreshing the way we organize the Analytics & Reports area in the Pro Management portal to make it more user-friendly.

Title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Choose the data sources AI-powered Data Enrichment uses, including CRM notes
Summary: AI-powered Data Enrichment now lets admins choose which data sources the agent uses to enrich records. Outlook emails, Teams meetings, and the new CRM notes source each have their own control toggle, and the agent keeps running as long as at least one source is toggled on. Admins no longer need to connect every permission before they create the agent. With CRM notes, the agent extracts insights from manual notes added to supported records and uses them to enrich those records, with no tenant adm...

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Import task - Public API support
Summary: Public APIs for the Import tasks capability enable customers and partners to programmatically import tasks from one project into another. Organizations can call these APIs from custom applications, integrations, or automated workflows instead of requiring a user to initiate each import manually.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Viva Engage - Community Agent
Summary: Community Agent helps members get answers to questions in Viva Engage communities using community knowledge and connected sources. Community admins can choose to require human review before answers are posted or allow automatic posting.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
Summary: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
Summary: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.

Title: Universal Print: Universal Print Portal
Summary: You can release your secure print jobs by scanning a QR code at any printer and access your print workflows from a browser on any device, all signed in with your Microsoft 365 account.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Optical character recognition (OCR) support for endpoint
Summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data on your Windows endpoint devices. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP and PDF (image only PDF).

Title: SharePoint: Governance Reviews Dashboard for Site Owners
Summary: Site owners have a critical role to play in ensuring accuracy of site information, including the site's necessity, its owners, members, permissions, and sharing settings. We’re introducing the Governance Reviews Dashboard in Private Preview, a centralized view where site owners can see all pending site governance reviews (inactivity, ownership, attestation) across the sites they own.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplifying Content in the Input Box
Summary: When users insert content in a prompt using 'Add Work Content' under the Plus menu, the content will only appear as a pill in the Input Box UI and will not be repeated as part of the user's prompt. This helps to simplify the Input Box and reserve it for prompt creation. Updated April 22, 2026: We are moving this item back to In Development and will be relaunching after further updates. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Enterprise New Tab Page experience
Summary: A modern experience for the New Tab Page (NTP) on Microsoft Edge for Business.

Title: SharePoint: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
Summary: Users will be able access an AI generated audio summary of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams (Viva Connections).

Title: Microsoft Graph: New tenant controls for retirement of non-standard file API tokens
Summary: Microsoft will retire pre-authenticated (tempauth) URLs in SharePoint Online and OneDrive by April 1, 2027. New tenant controls will allow admins to test updated Microsoft Graph URL behavior using Microsoft Entra ID authentication. Apps must stop relying on embedded auth URLs and HTTP 302 redirects. Validation before the deadline is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Planner: Introducing Local Custom Fields
Summary: Microsoft Planner introduces Local Custom Fields, allowing users with Planner Premium licenses to add up to 10 customizable fields (Text, Number, Date, Yes/No, Choice) to tasks for tailored workflows. Microsoft 365 users have read-only access. The rollout begins late October 2026, with no admin setup required. Custom fields integrate with existing compliance and audit features.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Themes by Copilot retirement
Summary: Themes by Copilot in Microsoft Outlook will be retired worldwide from mid- to late October 2026. Users with a Copilot license will lose the ability to select or revert to these themes, though current themes remain until changed. No action is required.

Title: Retirement: Azure Key Vault Secrets Provider Extension for Azure Arc enabled Kubernetes clusters
Summary: The Azure Key Vault Secrets Provider Extension for Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes will be retired on October 9, 2027. Customers currently using the extension should plan to migrate to the Azure Key Vault Secret Store Extension before the retirement date. The Azure Key Vault Secret Store Extension provides equivalent functionality for accessing and synchronizing secrets from Azure Key Vault for workloads running on Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes clusters. In addition, the Azure Key Vault Secret Store...

Title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
Summary: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option for presenters, alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes. This update, rolling out from September to November 2026, enhances flexibility and accessibility without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action is needed.

Title: 30-Day Reminder: Windows 11, version 23H2 Enterprise and Education editions reach end of updates on November 10, 2026
Summary: On November 10, 2026, Windows 11, version 23H2 Enterprise and Education editions will reach end of updates. The November 2026 Windows security update will be the last update available for these editions. After this date, devices running these editions will no longer receive monthly security updates containing protections from the latest security threats. We recommend updating eligible devices running Windows 11, version 23H2 to a supported version of Windows 11. If you have an eligible device, y...

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Administrative Units support for DLP policies for Microsoft Copilot
Summary: Microsoft has decided not to proceed with extending Microsoft Entra Administrative Units support to Microsoft Purview DLP policies for Microsoft Copilot. No changes will occur, and no action is required. Existing DLP policies and enforcement remain unchanged.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Removing Copilot from the chat list
Summary: Updated October 8, 2026: After additional consideration we have decided not to proceed with this change. You can safely disregard this message. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Improved feature discoverability within Contact Center Admin Center
Summary: We are announcing improvements for discovering the latest features and news about capabilities in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach public preview on October 23, 2026. How does this affect me? With these discoverability improvements, administrators can more easily discover what's new, understand the value of key capabilities, and take the next step toward adoption. This feature connects administrators to relevant learning and adoption resources with two new experiences: A What...

Title: Microsoft Outlook: New event duplication capability
Summary: Microsoft Outlook is adding a "Duplicate event" feature allowing users to quickly create new events from existing ones without re-entering details. The rollout began in late September 2026 and will complete by late October 2026. No action or compliance concerns are required.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows: Improved slide contextual menu consistency
Summary: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows will update the slide contextual menu for better consistency and organization, removing the low-usage Photo Album command from the menu but keeping it in the Insert tab. The rollout starts in October 2026, requires no action, and affects all users.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac: Improved slide contextual menu consistency
Summary: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac will update slide contextual menus for consistency, removing the Zoom command and Cut/Copy from the slide menu but keeping them elsewhere. Layout and Reset Slide commands will appear in both slide and thumbnail menus. The change rolls out worldwide in October 2026, enabled by default with no impact on compliance or licensing.

Title: Microsoft API Hub: Zendesk OAuth tokens will require expiration and automatic refresh
Summary: Microsoft API Hub will update Zendesk OAuth tokens to expire after 48 hours with refresh tokens expiring after 90 days, supporting automatic refresh. Existing connections must be reauthorized by early 2027 to avoid failures. Organizations should identify and reauthorize affected connections and inform developers.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: 'Clarify my thinking' skill for desktop
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint on desktop introduces the "Clarify my thinking" skill, helping users refine ideas and improve presentations. Rolling out worldwide from October 8, 2026, it requires no admin action but may need user communication and training updates. Existing Copilot controls and licensing apply.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: 'Clarify my thinking' skill for web
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint on web introduces the "Clarify my thinking" skill, helping users refine ideas and improve presentations. Rolling out worldwide from October 8, 2026, it requires no admin action but may need user communication and training updates. Existing Copilot controls and licensing apply.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: 'Clarify my thinking' skill for Mac
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint on Mac introduces the "Clarify my thinking" skill to help users refine ideas and improve presentations. Rolling out worldwide from October 8, 2026, it requires no admin action but may need user communication and training updates. Existing controls and licensing apply.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows: Smarter Keep Source Formatting slide pasting experience
Summary: PowerPoint for Windows now imports only necessary slide masters and layouts when pasting slides with Keep Source Formatting, reducing file size and improving performance. Users can revert to the old behavior via a setting. Rollout began September 2026, completing by October 2026. No action required.

Title: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac: Smarter Keep Source Formatting slide pasting experience
Summary: PowerPoint for Mac now imports only necessary slide masters and layouts when pasting slides with Keep Source Formatting, reducing file size and improving performance and collaboration. Users can revert to the old behavior via settings. Rollout began late September 2026, completing by late October 2026. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
Summary: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

Title: Outlook: Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot available in Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac
Summary: We will be adding declarative agents support in Copilot Chat in Outlook. This roadmap item tracks availability in Outlook for Mac.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Review financial dimensions when approving expenses on mobile
Summary: Approvers need access to the financial information behind an expense to make accurate approval decisions without leaving the approval experience. Dynamics 365 expense management mobile app will surface relevant financial dimensions directly within expense report approvals in the mobile app. Approvers can review financial coding in context before making a decision, helping reduce unnecessary navigation and keep expense approvals moving.

Title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
Summary: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat. Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

Title: Outlook: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
Summary: The first updates will focus on visual details, such as icons, spacing and alignment. Users of classic Outlook for Windows will begin seeing refinements to familiar mail and calendar surfaces. The initial visual updates are intended to improve clarity and consistency without changing how users perform their tasks.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for Network Device Interface (NDI) Sources
Summary: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
Summary: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Track mileage expenses using kilometers
Summary: Organizations operating across different regions need to record mileage expenses using the units of measure appropriate for their employees and local requirements. Dynamics 365 Project Operations will support kilometers (km) as a configurable unit of measure for mileage expenses, in addition to miles. Organizations can configure the appropriate mileage unit for their business, helping employees record mileage expenses accurately using the measurement standard relevant to their regional requireme...

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Cancel packing slips for stocked item requirements
Summary: This feature supports controlled returns and packing slip cancellations for stocked item requirements originating in Finance and Supply Chain Management. You can open the Packing slip journal from the Item requirements page and cancel packing slips for eligible independent item requirements. Packing slip posting performs the physical inventory update while deferring the financial update, allowing cancellation before invoicing or finalization. Cancellation reverses the project cost, returns the i...

Title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard
Summary: Customers can now view reporting for agents from third-party platforms in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). This expanded coverage provides a more comprehensive view of agent activity across their organization.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
Summary: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Tenant-level dashboard for Interpreter
Summary: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. Admins now have a dedicated dashboard in the Teams Admin Center to view Interpreter usage across their organization. Track adoption and usage trends in one place to better understand how Interpreter is being used.

Title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
Summary: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Securi...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
Summary: Meeting organizers can now easily delete meeting generated content including recording, transcript, AI summary, and notes through the new delete button in recap page. Shared files in the meeting won't be deleted.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
Summary: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

Title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
Summary: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.

Title: New Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service experiences across Teams, Copilot, and Outlook
Summary: Microsoft is launching new Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service experiences integrated with Teams, Copilot, and Outlook, enabling seamless access to customer data and workflows. Key features include Sales and Service skills, Teams Channel Agent, and Sales Development Agent, with phased rollout starting October 8, 2026, requiring admin activation and licensing.

Title: Generally Available: Managed StandardV2 NAT Gateway for AKS
Summary: AKS will now provision and manage a StandardV2 NAT Gateway for clusters using an AKS-managed virtual network. StandardV2 is now the default managed NAT Gateway SKU for new clusters in supported regions when using the managedNATGateway outbound type. StandardV2 NAT Gateway provides zone redundancy by default, higher bandwidth and throughput, and IPv6 support. Existing AKS clusters can migrate from a managed Standard NAT Gateway or load balancer to a managed StandardV2 NAT Gateway. Learn more .

Title: Take action to prevent RD Web Access rendering failures
Summary: The Remote Desktop Web Access (RD Web Access) experience included with Windows Server relies on Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformations (XSLT) to render its web interface. Chromium-based and other browsers are disabling XSLT support in the short term. As browsers disable this feature, the RD Web Access experience included with Windows Server will no longer render as expected. Microsoft has published KB5130994 with workarounds for organizations that continue to use this experience. Rollout...

Title: Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server in East US 3
Summary: Now you can deploy Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server in the East US 3 Azure region. Learn more .

Title: Allow connections to copilot.cloud.microsoft before the Copilot URL redirect
Summary: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. Organizations must allow connections to *.cloud.microsoft in network and security controls to avoid Copilot access disruptions. Validate connectivity, update allow lists, and coordinate with security teams before the redirect.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Pages and Notebooks Creation in OneDrive
Summary: Starting mid-October 2026, new Microsoft 365 Copilot Pages and Notebooks will be stored in OneDrive for Business, enabling existing OneDrive governance, compliance, data protection, retention, and lifecycle management features to apply. Existing Copilot content remains unchanged; no user action is required.

Title: Retirement: Microsoft Dev Box will be retired on September 18, 2028
Summary: Microsoft Dev Box will retire on September 18, 2028. Beginning on September 14, 2026, Microsoft Dev Box will begin the closing-down process. After retirement, Microsoft Dev Box will no longer be available. Microsoft Dev Box is currently in maintenance mode, and Microsoft’s investments for developer cloud environments are focused on Windows 365. Existing Microsoft Dev Box usage remains supported during the transition period, and we recommend that you begin planning your migration now to avoid dis...

Title: Retirement: Azure Deployment Environments will be retired on February 22, 2027
Summary: Azure Deployment Environments will retire on February 22, 2027. Beginning on September 14, 2026, Azure Deployment Environments will begin the closing-down process. After retirement, the service will no longer be available. To help avoid disruption, we recommend that you begin assessing your current usage and planning your transition now. Review the environments, templates, and workflows in your organization that depend on Azure Deployment Environments and identify the replacement approach that b...

Title: Generally Available: Exceptions in WAF for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door
Summary: Announcing the general availability of exceptions for Web Application Firewall on Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door. Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) helps protect your web applications from common threats and attacks. In some cases, WAF may block requests that are safe and expected for your application. Existing exclusions help reduce false positives by omitting specific request attributes, such as headers, cookies, query string arguments, or body fields, from WAF evaluation wh...

Title: Public Preview: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management
Summary: The integration between Microsoft Agent 365 and Azure API Management is now available in public preview, helping organizations connect centralized governance with runtime enforcement for MCP servers and tools. With this integration, organizations can: Discover Azure API Management gateways and MCP servers in Agent 365 , creating a centralized inventory of gateway-managed tools. Control access to MCP servers from Agent 365, with enforcement applied by Azure API Management at runtime. Apply tool-l...

Title: Prepare for Windows Update certificate rotation in 2027
Summary: What and whyCertificates that help devices establish trusted connections to Windows Update will expire on May 17, 2027, and June 19, 2027. Devices must contain the replacement certificates to continue connecting to Windows Update and receiving updates after the applicable expiration date. Microsoft has delivered the replacement certificates through Windows security updates. Most devices running an in-support version of Windows require no additional action if they are current with monthly Windows...

Title: Windows Office Hours: October 15, 2026
Summary: If you are an IT admin with questions about managing and updating Windows, we want to help. Every third Thursday of the month, we host a live chat-based event on the Tech Community called Windows Office Hours. Members of the Windows, Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Windows Autopatch, and Windows 365 engineering teams will be standing by to answer your questions. Want to attend the October 15 session of Office Hours? Add it to your calendar and select Attend on the event page to let us know...

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID will support passkey registration and sign-in for B2B users, enabling phishing-resistant MFA in resource tenants starting late October 2026. Internal guest users get Microsoft Authenticator app passkeys; external users do not. The feature is enabled by default, intersecting with SMS/voice retirement policies. No action required, but administrators should review policies.

Title: Announcing: Multiparty private offers in Microsoft Marketplace expands to Hong Kong
Summary: Multiparty private offers give Microsoft partners a way to procure third-party cloud and AI solutions for customers through Marketplace. Software companies can expand into new markets by working with partners that bring established customer relationships, while customers rely on their trusted partners to manage their cloud and AI initiatives.

Title: Outlook for iOS and Android: Automatically apply email sensitivity labels from labeled attachments
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will automatically apply or recommend email sensitivity labels based on attached files with Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels starting mid-November 2026. This enhances consistent data protection, reduces manual labeling, and supports compliance without requiring admin action. Organizations should review label policies accordingly.

Title: Create interactive slides in PowerPoint with Copilot skill (Windows and Mac)
Summary: PowerPoint's new Copilot skill "Create interactive slide" enables users on Windows, Mac, and web to easily create interactive, full-slide visuals for complex concepts, timelines, and data. Attendees can interact independently in PowerPoint Live for Teams. Rollout begins mid-October 2026; a Copilot license is required.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Adding contextual nudges to the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon
Summary: Edge for Business will soon help users quickly take contextual action on their open pages using contextual nudges attached to the Copilot icon in the toolbar

Title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls. Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for surfacing...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
Summary: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

Title: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
Summary: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

Title: Excel: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel
Summary: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. Users can review how Copilot intends to complete the task, see which data or capabilities may be used, and adjust the plan as needed—ensuring edits are intentional, transparent, and aligned with their goals before they’re applied. This makes it easier to tackle multi step or high impact tasks while staying in control of every chan...

Title: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
Summary: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Updated horizontal tab appearance
Summary: Microsoft Edge is introducing an updated horizontal tab-strip appearance on Windows and macOS. The treatment uses rounded tabs with revised spacing and aligns related tab-strip controls with the refreshed browser-frame design. Tab behavior and enterprise data handling remain unchanged. Note: We have made the decision to cancel this planned release. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
Summary: Apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups to extend the classification and governance you already use for Microsoft 365 groups. The same labels you publish in the Microsoft Purview portal and configure for groups and sites apply automatically to cloud security groups, with no separate label configuration required.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
Summary: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Overview of recent comments and changes in Word
Summary: Use Copilot to see a summary of the latest comments and changes made to your Word files using the Copilot chat pane.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s)
Summary: Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s).

Title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
Summary: Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
Summary: A new export functionality will be introduced in two locations: the Data Loss Prevention > Policies page and the Information Protection > Label publishing policies page. This feature will allow users to export their existing DLP configurations and label policies, including schema, as a downloadable ZIP file. The exported file can be attached to support tickets to accelerate troubleshooting.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
Summary: Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.

Title: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
Summary: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android starting November 2026. Users can rate audio, video, and screen-sharing quality after meetings. Feedback helps improve Teams services. No admin action is required before rollout; updating the app and informing users is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Retiring legacy sign-in implementation on Windows
Summary: Microsoft Edge on Windows will retire its legacy direct-WAM sign-in in version 157, fully adopting the OneAuth library to standardize authentication. Rollout starts and completes in November 2026. Admins should identify unmigrated profiles, test transitions, and prepare for possible user sign-in prompts.

Title: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management: Private preview for selected developer package vulnerability coverage
Summary: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management is privately previewing expanded vulnerability coverage for selected Node.js, Python, and Java packages on Windows devices. It integrates with existing workflows, APIs, and exports, with rollout planned from September to December 2026. Organizations should prepare for increased data volume and validate integrations before enabling.

Title: Education Insights for Reading Progress: Challenge Assignments retirement
Summary: The Challenge Assignments feature in Education Insights for Reading Progress will retire on December 31, 2026. Educators can still create follow-up assignments based on challenging words directly in Reading Progress. Phonics rule-based assignments will be discontinued. No data will be deleted, and no admin action is needed.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Post-delivery protection for malicious QR codes in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 extends Teams URL protection to detect malicious URLs in QR codes post-delivery, warning users and enabling security teams to investigate via Advanced Hunting. Rolling out worldwide from October to November 2026, no user action is required, but admins should review related settings and processes.

Title: 'Record A Skill' Capability in PowerPoint Copilot
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot will introduce a "Record a Skill" feature in October 2026, allowing users to record and reuse workflows for common tasks. This enhances efficiency and consistency without requiring admin action. Organizations should inform support teams and users about this new capability.

Title: Microsoft 365: Targeted Release retirement
Summary: Microsoft 365 Targeted Release will retire in January 2027, replaced by Frontier, Standard, and Deferred release options. Administrators must update user enrollments and release preferences by November 2026, when Targeted Release management ends and a unified release preferences experience launches in the admin center.

Title: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
Summary: Microsoft 365 introduces a third-generation sharing experience with a single "hero link" for files and folders, simplifying access control and updates. Rolling out worldwide from October to November 2026, it affects SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 sharing, with no required user action before rollout.

Title: Interim guidance for Manitoba time zone changes
Summary: What and why:A time zone change affects Windows devices in Manitoba, with Windows releasing a fix in October 2026. Manitoba is permanently moving to UTC-5 and will not set its clocks back on November 1, 2026. Microsoft recommends a temporary workaround for devices that can't be updated in time. For the workaround steps and full guidance, visit the Daylight Saving Time & Time Zone Blog. Rollout schedule:October 2026 – The Manitoba time zone will be included with the October 2026 Windows security...

Title: Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
Summary: Microsoft planned to make 11 profile card properties visible by default in Microsoft 365 but decided not to proceed with this change as of October 7, 2026. Administrators can manage visibility using Microsoft Graph APIs, with no automatic rollout occurring at this time.

Title: Generally Available: Anyscale on Azure
Summary: Anyscale on Azure is now Generally Available. Anyscale on Azure is a managed platform for running distributed Python workloads on Ray. It deploys directly onto your Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster and integrates with the Azure services your team already uses. Unlike other processing engines which either only support one hardware type (e.g. CPUs) or focus on a single workload (e.g. inference), Ray turns a heterogeneous cluster of CPUs and GPUs into a single Python runtime composing data pr...

Title: Generally Available: Enabling the Bulk admin role for SQL Server on Linux
Summary: Starting with SQL Server 2025 CU9 and SQL Server 2022 CU27, SQL Server on Linux supports the bulkadmin fixed server role and the ADMINISTER BULK OPERATIONS permission for performing bulk data import operations without requiring users to be members of the sysadmin fixed server role. This capability enables you to use operations such as BULK INSERT and OPENROWSET(BULK...) while following a least-privilege security model. Previously on SQL Server on Linux, these operations required sysadmin members...

Title: Teams device management begins transitioning from Teams admin center to Teams Rooms Pro management portal
Summary: Teams device management is transitioning from Teams Admin Center (TAC) to Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal (PMP), with TAC deprecation extended to October 2026. Admins must complete migration steps to avoid management disruptions, ensuring devices meet prerequisites and appear in PMP for full functionality.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal agent available in Frontier worldwide
Summary: Copilot for Legal is now in Public Preview worldwide for Frontier users, expanding beyond the U.S. It helps legal professionals review contracts, identify risks, compare clauses, and generate tracked changes. No separate installation is needed; access requires Frontier enrollment and Copilot licenses.

Title: Transitioning Teams Android Device Management from Teams admin Center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
Summary: Teams Android device management is transitioning from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal by July 2026, consolidating management of all Teams devices into one portal. Deprecation of device management in TAC will begin October 2026, with phased rollouts and migration guidance provided.

Title: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
Summary: Starting mid-October to mid-December 2026, new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will roll out an automatic spell check before sending emails. Users can enable this feature if Connected Experiences are on. Organizations should review privacy policies and update training accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Improved setup and Intune multi-admin approval support for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
Summary: Starting November 2026, Microsoft Purview DLP will improve setup and support Intune multi-admin approval for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business, offering clearer status, detailed errors, and task coordination between Purview and Intune admins without changing existing policies or enforcement.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Link preview retirement
Summary: The Link Preview feature in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web has been retired due to the deprecation of the browser service needed for previews. Links remain clickable, no action is required, but users should be informed that preview cards will no longer appear.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New layout when sharing content for Teams events
Summary: Organizers and presenters who have access to production tools will see updated layout options when sharing content in the "Manage what attendees see" experience for Teams events. The available layouts are "Speaker focused", "Content focused", and "Content only". The new Speaker focused layout prioritizes presenter video alongside shared content for greater visibility. This feature is available for Teams events organizers with a Teams Enterprise license. This feature is available on Teams for Win...

Title: Power Automate: Build and visualize desktop flows using Flowchart mode
Summary: Flowchart mode introduces a new visual authoring experience in Power Automate for desktop that allows makers to create, view, and edit desktop flows using a flowchart representation. Actions are displayed as connected nodes and execution paths are represented visually, making it easier to understand, build, and maintain complex automations that include conditions, loops, and branching logic. Makers can create new flows directly in Flowchart mode or switch existing flows between Sequence mode and...

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports custom Case-like records evaluation
Summary: Quality evaluation now supports on-demand evaluations for case-like custom entities in public preview. Organizations can extend evaluation capabilities beyond the standard case entity to supported custom Dataverse entities that follow a case-like service workflow. This enables teams to evaluate additional business records using the quality evaluation framework, while giving admins flexibility to configure evaluation entry points for their custom scenarios.

Title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Capture project expenses directly from Field Service Work Orders
Summary: Technicians can create, update, and submit project-related expenses directly from a Work Order in Field Service web and mobile when the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled. Expenses remain connected to the related project and follow the standard Project Operations approval process, helping teams capture field costs with less context switching and better financial traceability.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
Summary: Microsoft Purview is upgrading inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business. The experience integrates with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access grant control and simplifies configuration while removing current Purview policy restrictions. Admins can now use expanded conditions and condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, configurable alerts and notifications, and rule match activities are visible in activity explorer.

Title: Outlook: Right-click to customize the classic ribbon
Summary: You can now customize the classic ribbon in New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the Web by right-clicking the ribbon and choosing which commands and groups appear on the Home and View tabs. #newoutlookforwindows

Title: Microsoft Teams: Identify custom apps that need updates for Teams private and shared channels
Summary: Admins will be able to view in Teams Admin Center a list of custom apps in their tenant that need to be updated to work in private and shared channels. This experience will help admins identify impacted apps, understand which apps require developer action, and coordinate updates so users can continue using custom apps across all supported channel types.

Title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
Summary: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
Summary: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Prevent presence transition to "Do not disturb" setting when screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
Summary: We're introducing a setting that allows users to opt-out of transitioning presence automatically to Do Not Disturb when presenting or screen sharing. This ensures that they can continue to receive calls, keeping them connected and responsive without manual presence adjustments.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Collection and DLP Policies for Intune-Policy Managed Apps
Summary: We are introducing a new integrated Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capability for Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps, enabling organizations to apply content‑aware protection policies to sensitive data on mobile devices. This integration ensures that clipboard actions in managed mobile apps are evaluated against Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed, helping reduce data leakage, insider risk, and exposure to advanced threats across mobile work...

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Optical character recognition (OCR) support for SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business
Summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data in SharePoint Online and OneDrive. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, and PDF (image-only PDF).

Title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
Summary: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

Title: Outlook: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Policy Tips & Override in Outlook for Mac
Summary: Outlook for Mac now supports Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips, helping users avoid accidental data leaks. When sensitive content is detected, users are alerted with inline tips or pop-ups, based on admin-configured rules.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Use sensitivity labels to block all connected experiences that analyze content in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Summary: In Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, the ‘Prevent some connected experiences that analyze content’ label setting now prevents files in these apps from being sent to all Microsoft connected experiences for analysis, rather than a subset of these connected experiences.

Title: Outlook: Choose to Show Unread or Total Count for Each Folder
Summary: You can now pick whether each folder in your folder pane shows the unread count or the total item count. Until now, Outlook only displayed unread counts, but sometimes you need to see how many items are in a folder overall. Just right-click any folder and choose whether to show the total or unread count. It gives you more control over how you keep track of your email without changing how anything else works. #newoutlookforwindows

Title: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
Summary: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dataverse data connected to Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: Let people search and query Dataverse business data from Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Enhanced user profile in IRM alerts
Summary: We’re enhancing the User section within Insider Risk Management alerts to provide investigators with more contextual user profile and risk attributes directly within their workflow. With this update, analysts can now view key user details such as employee type, office location, start date, policy inclusion, priority user group status, and last working day—helping them build a more complete understanding of the user during investigations without navigating away from the alert experience. This fea...

Title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Expanding note capabilities across alerts & cases
Summary: We’re introducing a new collaboration capability in Insider Risk Management that enables analysts and investigators to add notes directly within alerts. With this feature, users can document investigation progress, share findings, and capture key context throughout the triage process. In addition to manually added notes, system‑generated notes will automatically record updates such as alert status changes or user assignments — helping teams maintain a clear and auditable investigation timeline....

Title: Power Automate: Schedule desktop flows directly with Scheduled Triggers
Summary: Scheduled triggers enable makers to run desktop flows on a recurring schedule directly from the Power Automate automation center, eliminating the need to create and manage intermediary scheduled cloud flows. Users can configure daily, weekly, monthly, hourly, or custom recurrence patterns, select the execution machine or machine group, and monitor upcoming scheduled runs from a centralized experience. Scheduled Triggers simplify desktop automation management and provide a more intuitive scheduli...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
Summary: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractions.

Title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (iOS)
Summary: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (iOS) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Increase in expansion limit for auto-expanding archive beyond 1.5 TB
Summary: Previously, auto-expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archives beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

Title: Microsoft Purview:  Permissions audit log improvements
Summary: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

Title: Microsoft Viva Insights: New Power BI report publishing capabilities for leaders
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights is expanding Power BI report publishing to leaders, allowing them to publish and distribute reports directly. The "Analyst report publish" setting is renamed "Report publish," managed by admins and on by default. Rollout begins November 2026, with no action required but governance review recommended.

Title: Microsoft 365 Backup: Activity Logs
Summary: Microsoft 365 Backup will introduce activity logs by mid-October 2026, enabling administrators to monitor backup and restore activities across SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Exchange Online. Logs include detailed metadata, filtering, search, export options, and role-based access within the Microsoft 365 admin center. No action required.

Title: Microsoft Brand Kit: Duplicate an existing Brand Kit
Summary: Microsoft now allows Brand Managers and Brand Kit owners to duplicate existing Brand Kits to create new ones, simplifying setup for different brands or regions. This feature is available worldwide with no action required, aiming to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency in Brand Kit management.

Title: Microsoft Create: Improved sharing controls for Brand Kits
Summary: Microsoft Create now allows Brand Kit owners to modify sharing permissions after sharing, including changing user access between view and edit or removing access. This feature is available worldwide with no action required, helping organizations better manage Brand Kit access as collaboration needs evolve.

Title: Retirement: Pod name dimension in AKS pod platform metrics
Summary: Beginning September 30, 2027, support for the pod name dimension on the following Azure Monitor platform metrics is retiring, and these metrics are transitioning to aggregate pod counters: Number of pods by phase (kube_pod_status_phase) Number of pods in Ready state (kube_pod_status_ready) After this change: Metric names remain unchanged. Aggregate pod counts remain available. Namespace-level monitoring scenarios remain supported. The pod name dimension will no longer be available for filtering,...

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: New pay-as-you-go storage billing option
Summary: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing option for additional OneDrive storage, allowing admins to let selected accounts exceed licensed quotas with automatic usage-based billing. Public preview is available now for commercial tenants, with general availability starting November 2026. No action is needed if unused.

Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting October 6th, 2026 (PST). Summary: Microsoft Agent 365 will support observability for third-party agents from Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude, enabling unified monitoring of runs, sessions, and exceptions. Rollout begins late October 2026 with admin controls for enabling data collection and platform-specific setup requirements.

Existing supported deployments can continue to run and upgrade to the latest available release until retirement. Title: Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 will end on September 1, 2027
Summary: On September 1, 2027 support for Java 8, 11 and 17 will end. Your apps that are hosted on App Service will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service for Java 8, 11 and 17. Required action To avoid potential security vulnerabilities and minimize risk for your App Service apps, follow the steps to upgrade your app to Java 25 before September 1, 2027. Learn more .

Summary: We are announcing the ability to assign task level calendar for precise planning in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. Title: [Outlook Mac] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
Summary: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events starting mid-November 2026, helping organizations prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. Existing DLP policies will automatically apply, requiring no admin action, enhancing consistent compliance across email and calendar.

Title: [Outlook Mobile] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events starting mid-November 2026, helping prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. No admin action is needed; existing DLP policies will automatically apply, enhancing compliance across email and calendar.

Title: [Outlook Mac] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
Summary: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies starting mid-November 2026, allowing organizations to enforce DLP evaluations before sending emails. This enhances data protection by controlling wait times for policy checks, improving compliance and user experience. Administrators should review and configure policies accordingly.

Title: [Outlook Mobile] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
Summary: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies starting mid-November 2026, allowing organizations to enforce DLP evaluations before sending emails. Administrators can configure wait times to enhance policy compliance and balance security with user productivity. Review and enable as needed.

Title: Outlook for Mac: Sensitivity label recommendations and auto-labeling from attachments
Summary: Outlook for Mac will auto-apply or recommend Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels for emails based on attached files' labels, enhancing consistent information protection. Rollout begins mid-November 2026. No admin action is required, but organizations should review label policies and inform relevant teams.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Word: Document summarization experience moving
Summary: Starting September 2026, Microsoft Word's document summarization will move from the Top of Doc experience to other Copilot surfaces, maintaining AI-powered summaries accessible via Copilot prompts. No admin action is needed, but user communication and training updates are recommended.

Title: Retirement: Always Encrypted with Intel SGX Enclaves

Databases running on DC-series compute tiers should be migrated to supporte...

Title: Microsoft Purview Data loss prevention: debug tools activity now visible in managed app rules
Summary: Microsoft decided not to proceed with making debug tools activity visible in managed app DLP rules for Microsoft Edge for Business. The protection blocking developer tools remains enforced by default, with no changes to enforcement or user experience. No action is required from administrators.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app for users with multi-line calling, organizing call activity by phone line. The rollout begins early November 2026, with no action required. This update affects desktop and web Teams and simplifies managing multiple phone lines.

Title: Microsoft Excel: Excel canvas
Summary: Excel canvas, a new Copilot feature in Microsoft Excel, creates dynamic reports with visualizations and insights that update automatically with data changes. Available worldwide by late October 2026, it supports natural language interaction for report customization. No action is required; notify users and update training materials as needed.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Generate smart tables of contents for PDFs on the web with Copilot
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot users can generate AI-created, hierarchical, clickable tables of contents for PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web starting December 2026. The feature is user-initiated, respects permissions, supports saving by editors, and may have inaccuracies, especially with scanned PDFs.

Title: Public Preview: AKS on bare metal now on Ubuntu
Summary: Running Kubernetes on-premises often means adding a virtualization layer, adapting to unfamiliar infrastructure, or giving up control over the hardware and software your applications depend on. For AI workloads, these tradeoffs can limit access to local data, reduce available compute capacity, and restrict your choice of GPUs, drivers, and runtimes. AKS on bare metal Ubuntu, now in public preview, brings the AKS experience directly to customer owned Ubuntu infrastructure. Deploy a complete Kuber...

Title: New Outlook for Windows becomes available for GCC High and DoD
Summary: New Outlook for Windows will be available in GCC High and DoD environments starting Public Preview July 30, 2026, has rolled out. It remains off by default and opt-in, allowing admins control via policies and registry keys. Migration from COM to web add-ins is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Add alternate text to images shared from OneDrive and SharePoint
Summary: Improve accessibility by adding alternate text to images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint, helping users better understand visual content

Title: OneDrive: Presentation mode for PDFs in the iOS app on iPad
Summary: Microsoft OneDrive is introducing presentation mode in the OneDrive iOS app for users on iPad devices. Users select a new Presentation button in the PDF viewer to enter a focused, view-only experience that prevents free gesture scrolling between pages, reducing accidental page changes while presenting without moving the file to another app. The feature is not available on iPhone.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Adding support for viewing Sensitivity labels applied to a Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) Protected PDF
Summary: Enterprise customers can view sensitivity labels applied to MIP protected PDF to be well informed of the data classification to enable them to handle such sensitive documents. This change will be available in the new PDF viewer on Microsoft Edge.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
Summary: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

Title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
Summary: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
Summary: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Windows console
Summary: With Teams Rooms on Windows consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
Summary: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Specifically, the experience enables administrators to leverage the organization-supported logo already managed in the Microsoft Admin Center theming settings and display it in the footer of the Chat screen, paired with a fixed label: “Approved by”.

Title: SharePoint: Advanced Management - Inactive files policy
Summary: SharePoint administrators can use the Inactive files policy in SharePoint Advanced Management to automatically archive files based on when they were last accessed. The public preview is available through PowerShell only. Admins can set an inactivity threshold from 6 to 48 months, scope policies to all SharePoint sites or selected sites, include or exclude file types and sites, and use What-If mode to review impact before activation. Eligible files move to the Microsoft 365 Archive cold-storage t...

Title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
Summary: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

Title: Outlook: Improved PDF Preview on iOS
Summary: MIP-label protected PDFs are now supported in the PDF previewer along with a built-in control's toolbar for easier navigation.

Title: Outlook: New Outlook for Windows for GCC-H and DoD
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook for Windows will be available for US Government clouds (GCC-H and DoD sovereign environments).

Title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
Summary: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
Summary: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality evaluation - Recurring conversation evaluations
Summary: Quality Evaluation now supports recurring frequency for conversation evaluations. Previously, only event-based trigger evaluations were supported, meaning evaluations were created only when a conversation closed.

Title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Add multiple items to a transaction using bulk entry
Summary: Associates can trigger the Bulk add operation from the button grid on the transaction screen in Store Commerce. A drawer-based dialog opens where associates can paste or enter multiple item number and quantity pairs, with one pair specified per line.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
Summary: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

Title: Microsoft Edge: PDF Viewer Performance Improvement and Minor Visual Updates
Summary: The PDF Viewer in Microsoft Edge is enhancing responsiveness and introducing a series of subtle visual upgrades aimed at improving overall usability and utility. This migration ensures UI coherence with the rest of the browser while maintaining the same user experience.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
Summary: A new feature will be introduced on the main Classification page, allowing users to test files against all available classifiers to identify the presence of sensitive information. Users will have the option to select a single classifier or run tests across all classifiers. This capability is designed to help users identify sensitive content within files and troubleshoot classification issues more efficiently.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support for Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will support breakout rooms, allowing meeting organizers to assign and move these devices between breakout and main rooms. This feature, improving coordination and feature parity with Windows, will roll out worldwide from mid to late November 2026. No action is required.

Title: Private tasks now stored in your private plan in Planner
Summary: Starting November 2026, private tasks in Microsoft Planner will be stored in users' private Planner plans instead of Microsoft To Do, enabling richer features while remaining private. Existing tasks stay visible in Planner. No admin action is needed, but organizations should update documentation and compliance processes accordingly.

Title: Updated My Task experience in Planner
Summary: Microsoft Planner's My Tasks experience will be redesigned for clearer navigation, better task organization, and streamlined task creation, enhancing productivity. The update rolls out worldwide from early to late November 2026, requires no user action, and preserves existing tasks and settings.

Title: Microsoft Word for Android: Agent Mode
Summary: Microsoft Word for Android will gain Copilot Agent Mode by late September 2026, enabling users to draft, reason, and refine content with AI assistance. No admin action is needed, but organizations should update guidance and review policies to align with this new task-oriented Copilot experience.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Update to default blocked file types in OwaMailboxPolicy
Summary: Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows will block .msix and .msixbundle file types by default in OwaMailboxPolicy starting November 2026 to enhance security. Organizations using these file types should whitelist them beforehand; no action is needed if not used.

Summary: Evaluation details now include a scoring breakdown at the overall, section, and question level.
