Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Optimizations for passkey registration experience
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID is optimizing passkey registration to better align with administrator policies, prioritize local device passkeys, and improve successful registrations without UI changes. The rollout begins late August 2026, completing by mid-September. No action is required; organizations should continue promoting passkey adoption.

Title: Microsoft Teams: RTMP-In port and domain changes required
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating RTMP-In port and domain requirements to improve streaming reliability. Admins must allow outbound access to ports 50118, 50119, and domain *.rtmpingest.mcr.teams.cloud.microsoft by January 31, 2027. Existing RTMP-In events work until end of 2026; new events require updates to avoid failure.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Agent flexible query in Analytics Workbench
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights Analytics Workbench will add a flexible query feature in late September 2026, enabling analysts to explore Microsoft 365 Copilot agent usage with customizable queries. This automatic update requires no admin action and supports data-driven decisions for organizations with over 50 Copilot licenses.

Title: Call Quality Dashboard Custom Detailed Reports
Summary: Call Quality Dashboard will get a refreshed interface with enhanced accessibility and features like dark mode. Public preview starts mid-August 2026; general availability begins early September 2026. No action is needed, and users can revert to the old experience during rollout.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Pages: Access existing Pages from the "/" menu in chat
Summary: Starting late August 2026, users can access existing Pages via the "/" menu in Copilot chat, while the "Edit in Pages" menu will focus on creating new Pages. This update streamlines referencing Pages without affecting existing content or permissions. No action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with List Form in Workflows
Summary: Microsoft Teams Workflows will add a new trigger, "A form is submitted," for automating actions based on SharePoint list–backed form responses. Rolling out September–October 2026, it enables posting responses in Teams, uses existing SharePoint governance, requires no admin action, and respects current permissions and policies.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Reducing reply notification volume in email
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will reduce email reply notifications by only sending alerts for direct replies, @mentions, and new posts, cutting down on broader conversation notifications. This change, rolling out from September to October 2026, requires no user action and keeps existing settings unchanged.

Title: Microsoft Secure Score: New AI-readiness recommendations for device security
Summary: Microsoft Secure Score will add four new AI-readiness recommendations for device security in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, focusing on TPM 2.0, VBS, HVCI, and LAPS. These will help identify and remediate devices lacking key protections, rolling out from early to late September 2026 with no action required to receive them.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
Summary: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
Summary: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

Title: [Updated Date] Power Platform - Information about SharePoint file thumbnail changes
Summary: Beginning September 18, 2026, SharePoint triggers and actions that are currently returning a thumbnail URL are being updated. The new Get file thumbnail action will return an image instead of a URL, and existing flows that rely on the current thumbnail URL will otherwise return an invalid URL that may cause subsequent flow actions to fail. How does this affect me? Existing flows that use SharePoint triggers or actions such as Get items or Get file items and rely on the thumbnail URL dynamic cont...

Title: Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network Manager IPAM in additional Azure regions
Summary: Azure Virtual Network Manager IP address management is now generally available in additional regions: US Gov Virginia, US Gov Texas and US Gov Arizona, and China North 3 and China East 3. In complex network environments, managing IP addresses effectively is essential. This feature centralizes IP planning and allocation, allowing users to automatically assign non-overlapping addresses and prevent conflicts between Azure, on-premises, and multi-cloud address spaces. It also provides clear insights...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Rule-based enablement of Microsoft 365 third-party apps in the Teams admin center
Summary: Microsoft Teams will enable rule-based management of Microsoft 365 certified third-party apps via org-wide settings in the Teams admin center, enhancing security and customization. This feature, included in update MC796790, requires no admin action before rollout and will be disabled by default.

Title: Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery support for Linux Azure VMs with NVMe disk controllers.
Summary: Azure Site Recovery now supports replication and disaster recovery for Linux Azure Virtual Machines running on NVMe-enabled Generation 2 VM families, such as the Da/Ea/Fa v6-series and Ebsv5/Ebdsv5 in the Azure-to-Azure scenario. This support is limited to RHEL 9, SLES 15 and Ubuntu 24 distros of Linux. This enhancement allows customers to enable disaster recovery and replication for their Azure VMs running high-performance, I/O-intensive workloads (limited to ASR churn support) with the NVMe di...

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center- Use data masking to protect customer data
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use data masking to protect customer data in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, customer service representatives can select individual messages from the customer and redact them, so the customer's PII isn't stored in your repository. This feature complements the existing automatic data masking rules with both automatic and manual masking. What action do I nee...

Title: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Web)
Summary: PowerPoint for the web will roll out an "Explain this presentation" skill in September 2026, providing users with an impartial summary of slides, charts, notes, key takeaways, numbers, visuals, and open questions to help understand presentations faster. A Copilot license is required.

Title: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Mac)
Summary: PowerPoint for Mac will roll out the "Explain this presentation" skill in September 2026, providing users with an impartial summary of slides, charts, notes, and key data to help understand presentations faster. No action is required, but a Copilot license is needed.

Title: Frontier: Skills] 'Sharpen slide titles' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Desktop)
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot's "Sharpen slide titles" skill will roll out in early September 2026 for Windows desktop users, rewriting slide titles as clear takeaways to enhance impact. No admin changes are needed, but a Copilot license is required. Inform help desks and update training accordingly.

Title: Frontier: [Skills] 'Sharpen slide titles' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Mac)
Summary: PowerPoint for Mac will get the "Sharpen slide titles" skill in early September 2026, rewriting slide titles as clear takeaways to enhance impact. No admin changes needed, but a Copilot license is required. Inform help desks and update training materials accordingly.

Title: Frontier: [Skills] 'Sharpen slide titles' built in skill in PPT Copilot (web)
Summary: PowerPoint for the web will get a new Copilot skill, "Sharpen slide titles," in early September 2026, which rewrites slide titles as clear takeaways. No admin changes are needed, but a Copilot license is required. Inform help desks and update training materials accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce centralized channel notification settings, allowing users to manage all channel notifications from one location. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide in October 2026, preserves existing settings, requires no admin action, and aims to simplify notification management.

Title: Project Online Essentials reaches End of Life on October 1, 2026: Action required
Summary: Project Online Essentials will reach end of life on October 1, 2026. Organizations must transition users to supported licenses like Project and Planner Plan 1 or Plan 3 before then to maintain access and licensing rights for Project Online, Project Server, and Planner Premium capabilities.

Title: Microsoft Planner: New Planner usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center
Summary: A new Planner usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center, launching September 2026, provides admins with tenant-level and user-level Planner activity data, including active users and usage trends for basic and premium plans. It includes identifiable user info, requires no action, and supports compliance and reporting needs.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a concern" feature in meetings by late 2026, allowing users to report suspicious behavior like phishing or scams. Reports, including meeting metadata, will be accessible to administrators via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center for investigation and response. This feature is enabled by default.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
Summary: Digital signage can now be displayed on idle Teams panel devices, similar to digital signage support for Microsoft Teams Rooms front of room displays. Signage source and settings can be configured in the Pro Management portal. Available with Teams Rooms Pro or Shared space-licensed spaces.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Slash commands for apps
Summary: You can now interact with your favorite apps directly from Teams chat and channels compose box using slash commands. Type / and start interacting with Apps and Agents, invoke workflows and more.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
Summary: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a...

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience
Summary: Copilot Studio is evolving to an app-first agent creation experience. Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs. This update brings tools and knowledge into a more unified experience, simplifying how agents are created and configured.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
Summary: Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. Admins configure the feature per queue via Teams admin center or PowerShell, with controls for recording, transcription and agent access to recordings. Recordings are stored in SharePoint and available through the Queues app call history. Note: Queues app requires a Teams Premium license.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting recap app
Summary: The meeting recap app brings all your meeting recaps into one place, making it easier to find, filter, and catch up. Quick filters help you surface the right meetings instantly, while audio recap lets you efficiently review multiple meetings at once. You can also browse and revisit any recap from the past 30 days.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
Summary: Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Support human interpreter listening mode in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows now supports human interpreter listening mode in meetings where organizers enable language interpretation in Meeting options, allowing room participants to select a language and hear interpreter audio.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
Summary: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Town hall media optimization for VDI attendees
Summary: What’s new

Title: Microsoft Teams: Chat panel open by default in the gallery view on Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join. Admins can configure this default device behavior, and users can close the panel in one tap during meetings.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced bookable desk experience with Teams panel-based desk dock devices
Summary: Users have better experiences in flexible work environments with Microsoft Teams panel-based desk dock devices coming later this year. The Teams panel app now enables devices, such as the Yealink Linkhub, to enhance bookable desk experiences by indicating at-a-glance availability and letting visitors book directly on the device. Each device requires a Teams Shared Space license.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter is disabled by default for captions
Summary: We are updating the default profanity filter setting for live captions from On to Off across Teams meetings, calls, events, and Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) devices to improve accessibility and align with EU requirements. This change will only affect users who have never configured their live captions profanity filter preference. Users who have already set their preference will keep their current setting. As a result, some users may begin seeing unfiltered profanity in live captions by default af...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items from unread-only view
Summary: Teams chat and channel lists can be filtered to show unread items only. When this filter is applied, hovering over a section reveals an eye icon next to the section name. Selecting the eye icon opens a list of read chats or channels within that section, allowing you to open them without leaving the unread-only view.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors
Summary: Microsoft is announcing the General Availability (GA) of federated Copilot connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Copilot to popular third‑party sources and retrieve data in real time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). These connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft services; access occurs in real time using the user’s identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 adm...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files
Summary: Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft Excel files now open in a standardized preview in Teams on Android and iOS, delivering faster performance, improved reliability, and a more consistent viewing experience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: One-stop admin portal for Teams devices with Teams Rooms Pro Management
Summary: Admins now have a one-stop portal for inventory, health monitoring, management, and analytics for both Windows and Android devices with the Pro Management portal. Management of all Android Teams rooms, panels, and phone devices are transitioning to this portal from the Teams admin center, enabling easy, consistent, and secure management of Teams devices across all operating systems and manufacturers.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Meeting Prepare from Up Next
Summary: Get timely reminders in Outlook mobile to prepare for your meetings with Copilot. The Up Next card now offers a Prepare option so you can get ready with one tap.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New room optimization mode user experience in Teams desktop
Summary: Users can more easily use their laptop for meetings and collaboration in spaces like focus or huddle rooms that don’t yet have a Teams Rooms system. The new room optimization mode replaces shared display mode, has a new location, and enables or disables room-specific features. When room peripherals are connected, Teams can automatically select audio and video devices, enable speaker recognition and shared display, and disable voice isolation.

Title: Co-organizer experience updates in Teams Webinars and Townhalls
Summary: Co-organizers in Teams Webinars and Townhalls can now fully manage events, including editing details, publishing, and canceling, achieving parity with organizers. Rollout starts mid-January 2025 for targeted release and mid-June 2026 for general availability, with no preparation needed.

Title: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Microsoft Teams will improve copy-paste support for @mentions and shared contacts by preserving interactive tags when valid in the destination. If invalid, tags revert to plain text with original display. Rollout occurs May to mid-September 2026 across platforms, requiring no admin action and enhancing messaging consistency.

Title: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
Summary: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams enables quick voice profile registration for enhanced features like speaker recognition and improved transcripts. Rolling out mid-June to mid-September 2026 for commercial tenants (excluding EDU), it is ON by default but can be managed or disabled by admins via PowerShell settings.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Prepare custom apps for private and shared channel compatibility
Summary: Microsoft Teams will roll out a feature by mid-September 2026 to help admins identify custom line-of-business apps needing updates for private and shared channel compatibility. Updating these apps ensures business continuity, reduces support issues, and maintains app access across evolving channel experiences.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app update: Simpler Copilot access
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot app is updating to a unified app for personal and work accounts with clearer visual cues, a simpler name and icon, and a new web URL (copilot.cloud.microsoft). Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to security, compliance, or enterprise controls.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Structured document generation with Forms
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot enables structured document generation in SharePoint via Forms, requiring a Copilot license. Public preview started mid-February 2026; general availability begins October 2026. It ensures consistent, compliant documents with template governance, requires no admin action, and applies existing SharePoint permissions.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Prompt injection protection for email
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will introduce prompt injection protection for email, detecting and quarantining malicious content targeting AI assistants. Rolling out from July to October 2026, it affects organizations with Defender Plan 2 or Microsoft 365 E5, enabling automatic high-confidence threat quarantine by default with no required action.

Title: Public Preview: Azure Front Door profile and route level WAF policies
Summary: Azure Front Door’s Web Application Firewall (WAF) now supports profile and route level WAF policy associations in public preview. This gives you more flexibility to apply broad baseline protection across an Azure Front Door profile while using targeted policies for specific applications, domains, or routes that need different controls. With this update, you can associate WAF policies at the profile, domain, or route scope. For example, you can use a profile level policy for common protections ac...

Title: SharePoint: AI citations analytics for documents and pages
Summary: SharePoint will add AI copilot citation analytics for documents, pages, and news posts, showing how often content is referenced by Microsoft 365 Copilot chat. Available to tenants with over 50 Copilot licenses, rollout starts end of August 2026. No admin action is needed; site owners get new usage insights.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Manage overnight shifts as a single continuous schedule
Summary: We are announcing the ability to manage overnight shifts as a single continuous schedule in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 2, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, supervisors can now create and manage overnight shifts that span across midnight while maintaining a single continuous shift experience. Activities, breaks, meals, and ad-hoc work can be scheduled anywhere within the overnight shift and remain part of a single continuou...

Title: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
Summary: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting September 1st, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this la...

Title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app
Summary: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI integration in M365 Copilot
Summary: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers.

Title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live Light theme support
Summary: Presenting PowerPoint slides in Teams just got better. PowerPoint Live now supports light mode, giving presenters the option to present in light, dark, classic, or high contrast mode based on their preferences and system settings.

Title: Planner: Task Details Side Pane experience
Summary: The Task Details Side Pane lets you view and edit task details in a side pane while keeping your Board, Grid, or My Tasks view visible. Update tasks without losing context or switching back and forth from modal dialogs.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Block all identified external bots automatically from joining your meetings
Summary: Extending the admin controls provided for managing external AI bots and regulating their access to your meetings, we are adding the option to automatically block all identified bots.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
Summary: We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
Summary: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced cross-platform join via SIP for Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Enable Teams Rooms on Android to join third-party meetings via SIP, delivering seamless cross-platform interoperability. This capability ensures users can connect to external meeting services directly from Teams Rooms, maintaining a consistent and reliable meeting experience across diverse environments. Available on Teams Rooms Pro license.

Title: Outlook: Share Word, Excel, and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
Summary: When working in an open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file, users will now be able to send a copy of the locally stored file by email through the new Outlook for Windows. #newoutlookforwindows

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updates to Memory and Personalization in Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: Copilot now uses chat history to provide more relevant, contextual responses. Updated settings make it easier to view and manage what Copilot remembers and your personalization preferences.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Domain exclusion for web grounding
Summary: This feature will allow admins to specify a limited set of sites to exclude from web grounding in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat #copilotcontrolsystem

Title: Microsoft Places: Microsoft Places Support to GCC cloud
Summary: Microsoft Places features will now be available in GCC cloud

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
Summary: We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot
Summary: The Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot expedites answers for the most common workplace policy-related questions and takes action on key HR and IT related tasks, connecting employees to authorized knowledge bases and HR/IT systems of record for faster resolution time and a streamlined employee experience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Security Detection Report in Teams Admin Center
Summary: A new Security Detection Report in the Teams admin center provides a centralized view of messaging security detections, including impersonation, malicious URLs, and weaponizable file types. Admins can review detection activity in one place and export detailed data to support investigation and response. This capability helps consolidate security signals for Teams messaging scenarios.

Title: SharePoint: Admin Center - detailed report on Everyone except external user permissions
Summary: The new report provides SharePoint Advanced Management admins complete item level details of permissions granted to Everyone except external user and Everyone special SharePoint groups.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.

Title: Microsoft 365: Organizational Data Service is now available in GCC-High
Summary: We’re excited to announce that Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is now available in the GCC-High (GCC-H) environment! Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service enables rapid ingestion of organizational/HR data through connectors from multiple HRIS systems using a single unified ingestion point. This service also provides organizational data for use across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 apps to power various features with robust data quality framework that detects, communicates, and...

Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC-High
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the GCC High environment.

Title: SharePoint: PowerShell support for brand fonts deletion
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing PowerShell support for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint Brand Center. With the new Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet, SharePoint administrators can remove brand font files that are no longer approved, licensed, or needed across their organization in SharePoint.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online in the event of classification failure
Summary: Default protection controls for Exchange Online is available in public preview. This release gives administrators fine-grained control to create DLP policies based on specific classification or text extraction failure types — such as timeout, throttling and other scan errors — rather than one blanket policy for all failure conditions.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Enhanced Security Accounts Manager (sAM) Account Name support for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
Summary: Enhanced support for synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) with Microsoft Entra Domain Services is now in Public Preview. This feature allows sAMAccountName to be populated from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute in Microsoft Entra ID. Existing managed domains can enable the new synchronization behavior, while it is enabled by default for new managed domains. When enabled, existing hybrid users are updated during synchronization; cloud-only users without a...

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
Summary: The updated identity timeline provides security teams with a single chronological view of activity and alerts associated with an identity and its linked accounts. It normalizes activity from integrated Microsoft security products, including Microsoft Entra sign-ins, Microsoft Graph audit events, SaaS and cloud activity, and device logons. New fields and filters include Source table, Session ID, and Unique token identifier, with expanded Conditional Access and event context.

Title: Microsoft 365: Entra ID Backup & Recovery
Summary: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. This capability allows customers and ISV apps to do a point in time restore of Entra objects to a last known good state to a rolling historical 30-day point. Advanced recovery features are currently limited to the Entra admin portal, but some user recovery actions will be possible via the M365 Backup native app UX in the M365 Admin center. Note tha...

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls
Summary: Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails, closing tickets, or processing payments, independent of the agent's instructions....

Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Survey Owner role provides access to survey results
Summary: When a new program is being set up in Glint, there is now an option to designate Survey Owners. Those added as Survey Owners will be able to view and manage certain aspects of the program, as well as see the results when a survey in the program closes.

Title: Generally Available: Microsoft Defender for Cloud support for Azure Container Apps (Serverless Containers Posture)
Summary: Customers can now bring Azure Container Apps environments into Microsoft Defender for Cloud’s Serverless Containers Posture experience, helping security teams extend posture management across more of their container estate from a single workflow. This makes it easier to gain visibility into Container Apps resources and assess risks across areas such as identity, networking, and container or image configuration. With this capability, teams can more consistently evaluate risk across container envi...

Title: Generally Available: Windows Server 2025 on AKS
Summary: Organizations running Windows-based workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) face increasing pressure to modernize as support timelines for older Windows Server versions approach retirement. To help customers prepare, AKS now offers GA support for Windows Server 2025, bringing significant improvements such as Stable ABI, Generation 2 VM default, containerd 2.0, and FIPS enablement by default. Learn more.

Title: Generally Available: Artifact Streaming on AKS
Summary: You can now accelerate your containerized workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using Azure Container Registry (ACR) with Artifact streaming. Artifact streaming will allow you to scale your workloads without having to fully wait for images to be pulled into the clusters. Learn more.

Title: Enhanced Slide Navigation with Up and Down Arrow Keys in PPT Live
Summary: PowerPoint Live now allows slide navigation using Up and Down Arrow keys, enhancing presenter control. This update, rolling out globally from mid-August to early September 2026, requires no action but may prompt updates to training materials. Existing navigation methods remain unchanged.

Title: Generally Available: Confidential VMs for Azure Linux
Summary: Confidential Virtual Machines (CVM) offer strong security and confidentiality for tenants. CVM for Azure Linux in AKS is now generally available and enables node pools with CVM to target the migration of highly sensitive container workloads to AKS without any code refactoring while benefiting from the features of AKS. You can create new node pools using supported CVM vm sizes with Azure Linux 3. The nodes in a node pool created with CVM use a customized Azure Linux 3 image specially configured f...

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Microsoft Entra permissions required for community and membership administration
Summary: Starting late September 2026, Microsoft Viva Engage will require Microsoft Entra permissions—Yammer Administrator role or Community Admin assignment—for community and membership management tasks previously allowed to Verified or Network Admins. Administrators should review and update role assignments accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Defender XDR: DLP alerts will be set as behaviors by default
Summary: Microsoft Defender XDR will set Microsoft Purview DLP alerts as behaviors by default starting October 12, 2026, reducing alert volume while keeping DLP data accessible in Advanced Hunting and Purview. Administrators can disable this rule to retain DLP alerts in the Defender XDR incident queue.

Title: General Availability of Power BI developer mode
Summary: Power BI developer mode and the PBIP file format are generally available, making PBIR the default report format in Power BI Desktop and service. This enhances source control, CI/CD, and programmatic development. PBIX remains primary, with no impact on report functionality. No user action is required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of WebRTC-based media optimization for Omnissa Horizon on Windows endpoints
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the WebRTC-based media optimization for Teams on Omnissa Horizon Windows endpoints by September 1, 2027, transitioning users to a new VDI solution with improved meeting quality and diagnostics. Users must update Horizon Client and Teams versions and complete migration by March 31, 2027.

Title: Teams web client users will be redirected to teams.cloud.microsoft
Summary: Teams web users will be redirected from teams.microsoft.com to teams.cloud.microsoft by September 2026. This domain change won't affect features or existing links. Temporary admin control to disable redirect ends December 31, 2026. Organizations should update documentation and ensure network access to *.cloud.microsoft.

Title: Pay-as-you-go consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
Summary: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing model for SharePoint storage overages, allowing admins to pay only for extra storage used beyond the quota. Available from November 2026, it’s opt-in, excludes education tenants, and requires Azure billing permissions. No user impact; manual storage purchase remains an option.

Title: Classic Outlook for Windows: User-initiated insights with Copilot
Summary: User-initiated insights with Copilot in classic Outlook for Windows allow users to highlight email text and prompt Copilot for contextual insights. Rolling out worldwide: Public Preview in May 2026, General Availability in October 2026. Feature is on by default for eligible users and integrates seamlessly without add-ins.

Title: Discussion post previews coming to Viva Engage
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will introduce discussion post previews starting early September 2026, allowing users to review post formatting and presentation before publishing. This feature requires no admin setup, affects all Viva Engage users, and aims to improve communication quality. Organizations should inform users and update training accordingly.

Title: Outlook: Share Word, Excel and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
Summary: The new Outlook for Windows will support sending locally stored Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files as email attachments starting early November 2026 (worldwide) and mid-January 2027 (GCC). This feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and aligns with classic Outlook functionality.

Summary: We are enabling Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source in Copilot Studio, expanding the platform’s ability to ground AI agents in structured enterprise data. This enhancement allows organizations to leverage business-critical information stored in Dataverse—including records, customer data, operational data, and business application content—as a trusted knowledge source for agent experiences.

Title: OneDrive: New Shortcuts folder option when adding shortcuts
Summary: OneDrive makes it easy to add shortcuts to the files and folders you use most. Now you can choose to keep those shortcuts neatly together in one place instead of mixed in with everything else. When you add a shortcut, you can send it to a dedicated "Shortcuts" folder rather than your OneDrive root. The folder is created automatically the first time you use it and is easy to spot, with a distinct color and building icon. The Shortcuts folder behaves like any other folder—move it, rename it, share...

Title: Microsoft Purview: Role groups UI enhancements
Summary: The Role groups page in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal now allows admins to look up permissions by roles and memberships.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Configure data retention policy for Viva Glint
Summary: This feature will introduce the capability for Glint service administrators to configure a data retention policy for their Glint instances based on the organizational policies. Any past survey cycles including engagement surveys, always-on surveys, lifecycle surveys and 360s will be retained/deleted based on this data retention configuration period.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds
Summary: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot can analyze content shared on desktop screen and through mobile camera
Summary: Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot helps you make faster, more informed decisions by understanding context from what you share on screen or camera. Copilot can analyze visual inputs from shared desktop screens and provide detailed insights about the content. You can also use vision on mobile during a real-time voice session to share your device camera, front or back, and ask questions about what is in front of you. Copilot analyzes the live camera feed or desktop screen in real time and provides sp...

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Change in accessing additional agents in Excel
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel now allows access to additional agents via the "…" menu under M365 Copilot. The update, rolling out worldwide through August 2026, affects all licensed Excel users without changing editing behavior or permissions. No admin action is required; update support and documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Policy tuning analysis for priority content only policies
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will support real-time policy tuning analysis for priority content policies starting late June 2025 (worldwide) and December 2026 (GCC/DoD). Admins can enable Analytics to predict user matches, adjust thresholds, and optimize alerts for insider risk policies scoped to priority content.

Title: Announcing: Microsoft Fabric Item Recovery will be enabled by default for tenants without an explicit setting
Summary: Starting August 23, 2026, Microsoft Fabric will enable Item Recovery by default for tenants that have not explicitly configured the setting. Supported item types will have a 3-day recovery window by default. Admins can review or change this setting in the Fabric admin portal under Tenant settings > Item Recovery.

Title: Copilot settings in classic Outlook for Windows
Summary: Copilot settings will be added to classic Outlook for Windows under the File menu, allowing users to manage Copilot directly, including turning it on or off. Rollout begins June 2026 with general availability by August. No changes to licensing or admin controls; no action required.

Title: Viva Learning: Copilot experience transitions to Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: The Viva Learning Copilot experience is transitioning to Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, providing a unified, personalized learning experience. Rollout occurs from late June to August 2026 for all Viva Learning licensed users. Admins should review access, update materials, and manage deployment via Microsoft 365 controls.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: New report on Everyone except external users
Summary: A new SharePoint admin center report launching in August 2026 provides item-level visibility into permissions granted via "Everyone" and "Everyone except external users" groups. It helps administrators identify and remediate overshared content across SharePoint and OneDrive without changing existing permissions.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive scopes add lifecycle status evaluation controls for recipients and site owners
Summary: Microsoft Purview introduces lifecycle status controls for adaptive scopes, evaluating only active recipients and site owners by default. Administrators can include inactive or soft-deleted users as needed. Support for ISO 8601 durations in queries is added. Rollout begins mid-September 2026, with no immediate action required.

Title: Outlook: Language support for Summarize in Classic Outlook
Summary: When the content language and the Outlook language do not match, you will be able to select a different language to view summarize Copilot responses.

Title: OneDrive: Anchored comments in the PDF viewer
Summary: Microsoft is adding anchored comments to the PDF viewer in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. Users can attach a comment to a specific spot on a page, to selected text, and collaborate through replies and @mentions — bringing PDF review to parity with commenting in Office documents. This feature will be on by default and requires no admin action.

Title: OneDrive: Uninstall OneDrive Photos without affecting file sync
Summary: OneDrive is giving people more control over their Windows experience by allowing them to uninstall the OneDrive Photos experience independently. Removing the Photos experience does not uninstall the OneDrive app, interrupt file sync, or delete photos and files. This provides a clear removal option for people who prefer to manage their photos with another app.

Title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: SQL server Support in Microsoft Copilot Studio
Summary: The Azure SQL Knowledge Source capability extends the range of enterprise data sources that makers can leverage when building agents in Copilot Studio. This enables organizations to bring business-critical information stored in Azure SQL into their agent experiences using the same knowledge-centric approach that customers already use across other supported knowledge sources. Azure SQL knowledge support represents another step toward a unified knowledge platform strategy, where customers can conn...

Title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Security Mode Plus
Summary: Enhanced Security Mode Plus adds optional, admin-configurable protections on top of Enhanced Security Mode to further reduce browser attack surface. Admins can configure preset or custom modes to restrict selected network protocols and compression behavior, hardware-access web APIs, WebGL, and external protocol launches when Enhanced Security Mode is enabled.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Migration tool in Unified Catalog to migrate classic glossary terms
Summary: Microsoft Purview planned a built-in migration tool to move classic glossary terms to Unified Catalog, but the general availability rollout has been canceled. Admins could choose to migrate or switch to Unified Catalog terms, with classic terms becoming read-only. Preparation guidance and compliance details were provided.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize Power BI reports
Summary: Microsoft Viva Insights will allow eligible users to create, customize, and save Power BI reports, including adjusting periods, filters, and layouts. Rollout begins early September 2026. Existing security and permissions apply. Admins can control feature access via Viva Feature Access Management. No admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Let customers book appointments directly from your website using the Customer Connect widget
Summary: Microsoft decided not to proceed with enabling appointment booking via the Customer Connect widget in Teams. The feature would have allowed website visitors to schedule appointments automatically added to staff calendars. No changes will occur until admins enable this, affecting Microsoft 365 Business users and Teams admins.

Title: Exchange Online will prevent creation of duplicate Dynamic Distribution Groups
Summary: Exchange Online will block creation of exact duplicate Dynamic Distribution Groups starting late July 2026 to improve reliability and reduce redundancy. Existing DDGs remain unaffected. Administrators should update scripts to handle duplicate errors and review current DDGs. No action is needed for most organizations.

Title: Public Preview: Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard
Summary: Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard is now available in public preview for ExpressRoute virtual network gateways. The new resiliency model property lets you specify whether a gateway is intended for a single-homed or multi-homed configuration, helping align your deployment with the resiliency requirements of your workloads. For multi-homed gateways, resiliency guard guides you to connect either two ExpressRoute circuits in different peering locations or an ExpressRoute Metro circuit. Portal guid...

Summary: Starting on September 2, 2026, the legacy chatbot experience in the Power Automate portal will no longer be available. How does this affect me? Users will be unable to access the legacy chatbot within the Power Automate portal. Access to help, documentation, and support resources is available through the Help (?) menu in the top-right corner of the command bar. This change does not affect existing flows, support channels, or other Power Automate functionality. What action do I need to take? This...

Title: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Places Support to GCCH and DoD
Summary: "Microsoft Places is an AI-powered workplace app for flexible work. Places helps organizations reimagine flexible work with AI, enables employees to connect more easily in person so that they can make the most of in-office days.

Title: Outlook: Enhanced user interface updates for iPhone and iPad
Summary: People using Outlook for iOS on iPhone and iPad will see refreshed interface elements aligned with the latest Liquid Glass iOS visual experience, including modernized app chrome, navigation, and use of screen space. It will be enabled by default with no administrator action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft Teams live chat retirement
Summary: Microsoft Teams live chat will be retired by mid-October 2026. New setups end August 2026, and support stops October 2026, disabling chat message relay. Organizations must remove the chat widget by October 5, 2026, notify users, and find alternative solutions. Historical chat data remains accessible.

Title: Microsoft Edge: Retirement of default unload event support
Summary: Microsoft Edge will stop running unload event handlers by default starting September 2026, requiring sites to explicitly permit them via Permissions Policy. Organizations should migrate to modern lifecycle events like visibilitychange and pagehide, update applications, and use provided policies temporarily during transition.

Title: Outlook: Import support for data files in Outlook
Summary: This feature adds support for importing PST files into Outlook for Mac.

Title: Announcing: Azure Databricks Genie One and Genie Agents Free Usage extended through January 31, 2027
Summary: Free usage of Genie One and Genie Agents in Azure Databricks is now extended through January 31, 2027, from the previous end date of July 31, 2026. Budget controls do not apply to these products during the promotional period. The promotion covers usage by users only - service principals are excluded, and their Genie One and Genie Agents usage continues to be billed. Genie Code is not included in this promotion: each Genie Code user continues to receive 150 free Databricks units (DBUs) per month,...

Title: Public Preview: Migrate from AWS FSx for Windows File Server to Azure Files with Azure Storage Mover
Summary: Azure Storage Mover now supports agentless, cloud-to-cloud migration from AWS FSx for Windows File Server (SMB) to Azure Files (SMB), in preview. You can move your Windows file shares off FSx and into Azure Files without deploying or managing a migration agent — the service handles the transfer for you. File data is copied directly from FSx to your Azure file share over a private connection between Azure and your AWS network. Learn more .

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: AIR Investigation Experience Improvements
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365's AIR experience will add a manual refresh button, replacing auto-refresh, and simplify investigation names by removing email subjects and UPNs. These changes improve performance, reduce network activity, and support data minimization. No admin action is required, but workflow updates are recommended.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Split recordings speaker-wise in closed conversation view (Preview)
Summary: Update: Release of this feature has been updated. We are announcing the ability to split recordings by speaker in the closed conversation view in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to split recordings by speaker in the closed conversation view. This transforms the review process from a linear playback into a targeted, navigable experience. Supervisors can directly go to specific speake...

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Classify emails in predefined taxonomy (categories and subcategories)
Summary: We are announcing the ability to classify emails in predefined taxonomy (categories and subcategories) for support automation with Case Management Agent in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on August 21, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enhancement allows administrators to configure a set of custom taxonomies for email categories and subcategories and uses the Case Management Agent to automatically classify inbound emails as they sync into Dyn...

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Equip voice agents with custom voice
Summary: We are announcing the ability to equip voice agents with custom voice in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will be available in public preview on August 21, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to connect an approved Azure custom neural voice to Dynamics 365 Contact Center and use it for self-service voice channels. Connected custom voices can be selected in the same way as other available voice options. What action do I need to take? To use this feature, users will need to:...

Title: Collect Diagnostics change to Get Diagnostics for Outlook Mobile and Mac
Summary: The Collect Diagnostics feature in Outlook Mobile and Outlook for Mac is renamed to Get Diagnostics, with diagnostic logs now sent to the Microsoft 365 diagnostics service instead of PowerLift. The rollout begins early August 2026, requiring updates to documentation and network allowlists but no user workflow or admin changes.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Replace MemberOf rules by November 3, 2026
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the MemberOf rule operator by November 3, 2026. Organizations using MemberOf in dynamic groups, administrative units, or entitlement policies must replace these rules to avoid stale access, licensing, and policy enforcement issues. Review and update configurations before the deadline.

Title: SharePoint Pages: Command bar menu and page state indicator updates
Summary: SharePoint Pages will update the command bar by reordering the +New menu, changing labels (e.g., Save and Close to Save and Exit), and adding a page status indicator showing Draft or Published states. Rollout starts August 2026, affecting site owners/editors only. No admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Voice tethering
Summary: The voice tethering feature builds on the recent introduction of Sign Language Mode. It ensures that when an interpreter voices for a D/HH signer, captions and transcripts attribute the spoken content to the signer rather than the interpreter. This provides accurate representation in meetings and makes it clear who is contributing to the conversation. It also improves downstream meeting intelligence such as Copilot so that notes, summaries, action items, and insights are attributed to the correc...

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use voice for Q&A during Read Aloud in Word
Summary: Interact in real time with read aloud in Word with Copilot. While your document is being read aloud, you can ask questions with your voice—such as “What does this mean?” or “Summarize this section”—and get answers instantly. No need to pause and search manually. This keeps you in context, reduces interruptions, and helps you understand and act faster.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New SlimCore-based optimization for Microsoft Teams in VDI - support for MacOS on Citrix and Azure Virtual Desktops/Windows 365
Summary: This feature allows MAC endpoints to optimize Microsoft Teams in VDI environments with the new SlimCore-based media engine, providing an expanded feature set and multiple improvements in quality, reliability and performance.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Searchable keyboard shortcuts from the dialog in Teams
Summary: Easily find keyboard shortcuts with a new searchable experience in Microsoft Teams. Search by shortcut name or enter part of a key combination directly in the dialog.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
Summary: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping formatting consistent. Updated June 5, 2026: This feature is still in development and will begin rolling out mid-June 2026. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
Summary: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping formatting consistent. Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
Summary: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping the design consistent. Updated June 5, 2026: This feature is still in development and will begin rolling out mid-June 2026. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app on Teams mobile
Summary: Manage call queues and engage with customers wherever work takes you. The Queues app on Teams mobile enables on the go workers to stay connected and responsive when handling customer calls. Calling representatives and supervisor leads can view assigned queues, opt in or out of a queue's call routing, and review their call history—all from their mobile device. Supervisor leads can also bulk manage queue participation for their teams. With seamless mobile access, the Queues app helps teams respond...

Title: OneDrive: Improved OneDrive experience in iOS Files app
Summary: OneDrive is updating its integration with the iOS Files app to use Apple's Replicated File Provider API. This update provides end-user improvements such as better upload progress. As part of the change, read-only Shared and Libraries locations will no longer appear in the Files app integration. Users can use Add to OneDrive for shared content and libraries they need to access, including write access where permitted.

Title: Microsoft Teams: External presenters can access production controls for Teams events
Summary: Organizations can allow external presenters to manage Teams events by granting them access to production controls. Federated (B2B) and guest users can be specified in the "Who has control of production tools" setting, enabling trusted external presenters to run events and manage what attendees see. This feature supports organizations that work with third-party event producers and vendors.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Entra passwordless resource account support for Teams Rooms on Windows and Android devices
Summary: Teams rooms on Windows and Android, Panels and Teams Phones now supports Entra Resource Accounts for secure, passwordless sign-in that separates device and user identities. IT admins can migrate to Entra accounts easily with the migration wizard, and track progress using a dashboard in the Pro Management portal.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter - Simultaneous mode enhancements
Summary: We’re raising the bar on clarity and control with Interpreter. Admins can fully disable voice simulation via PowerShell when needed. Each speaker is automatically assigned a distinct voice, making multi-speaker conversations easier to follow. We’re reducing distractions by showing shimmer effects only to Interpreter users. We’ve added audio notifications to confirm activation, and we’ve introduced in-product feedback mechanisms so users can easily share their input.

Title: Generally Available: SharePoint Connector for Azure Databricks
Summary: The SharePoint connector for Azure Databricks is now generally available. Organizations can use Lakeflow Connect to ingest files from SharePoint into Azure Databricks, helping unify enterprise content with data and AI workflows on Azure. The connector supports incremental ingestion, Unity Catalog governance, and multiple authentication methods for enterprise-scale deployments. Learn more .

Title: Generally Available: Unity AI Gateway on Azure Databricks
Summary: Unity AI Gateway is now generally available on Azure Databricks. Unity AI Gateway provides centralized governance for AI models, agents, tools, and MCP services, helping organizations monitor usage, manage costs, apply guardrails, and enforce access controls across AI workloads. Built on Unity Catalog, it extends governance capabilities across both Azure Databricks and external AI services. Learn more .

Title: Add and upload your custom skills to OneDrive from within PowerPoint Copilot (Mac)
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot on Mac now lets users create, upload, and manage personal custom skills directly within the app, storing them in their OneDrive. This feature, rolling out worldwide from late July to mid-August 2026, enhances customization without requiring admin action.

Title: Upload or add a custom skill with Copilot in PowerPoint (Web)
Summary: PowerPoint Copilot users can now upload and create personal custom skills directly within PowerPoint on the web, stored in their OneDrive. This feature, rolling out worldwide from late July to mid-August 2026, enhances customization without requiring admin action but recommends updating governance and support materials.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for PowerPoint, Excel, and Word files
Summary: Microsoft Teams will standardize the preview experience for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files by end of August 2026, improving load times and reliability. PowerPoint and Excel previews are on iOS and Android; Word preview is on iOS only. The feature is enabled by default with no admin action needed.

Title: Reminder: Exchange Online moderation approvals – legacy voting buttons support ends September 30, 2026
Summary: Support for legacy Outlook voting buttons in Exchange Online moderation approvals ends September 30, 2026. Afterward, only Actionable Messages adaptive cards will be supported. Organizations must enable Actionable Messages, ensure moderators use Microsoft 365 mailboxes, update documentation, and test workflows before this date.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in Teams meetings
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a meeting" feature starting August 2026, allowing users to report suspicious or malicious activity during meetings. Reports help security teams investigate threats via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center. The feature is enabled by default, with administrative controls and data collection for security investigations.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Users can report security concerns in group calls
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a call" feature for group calls, allowing users to report suspicious calls from call history. Administrators can review reports in Teams admin center and Microsoft Defender. The feature rolls out from August to October 2026 and is enabled by default.

Title: Generally Available: Explicit proxy in Azure Firewall
Summary: Azure Firewall explicit proxy is now generally available. Explicit proxy enables customers to configure applications and browsers to send HTTP and HTTPS traffic directly to Azure Firewall using proxy settings, providing an alternative to route-based traffic steering and enabling more granular control over outbound web traffic. The GA release builds on extensive customer validation during public preview, where explicit proxy was enabled across 300+ Azure subscriptions and adopted by approximately...

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Scheduled Prompts moves to Microsoft 365 Connected Experiences
Summary: Scheduled Prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot will move from the Optional Connected Experiences policy to Microsoft 365 Connected Experiences by late August 2026. This change affects governance and compliance controls but not user functionality. Administrators should review and update policies accordingly; most organizations need no action.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Custom branding for tenant-wide visual identity
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage introduces Custom Branding, allowing admins to apply tenant-wide brand name, logos, and theme color via a Brand Center. This overrides individual user themes and Microsoft 365 org themes within Viva Engage. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with preview and publishing controls for admins.

Title: Retirement: Nested confidential (cc_v5) VMs will be retired on September 1, 2026
Summary: On September 1, 2026, the cc_v5 confidential VM series will be retired and will no longer be available for use or purchase. Any affected VM that has not been resized before that date will deallocated. The impacted VM sizes that will be retired are: DCas_cc_v5, DCads_cc_v5, ECas_cc_v5, and ECads_cc_v5.

Title: Microsoft Entra: Migrate GitHub Actions federated identity credentials to immutable subjects
Summary: GitHub Actions now supports immutable OIDC subject formats with repository and owner IDs to enhance Microsoft Entra federated identity security. Title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
Summary: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

Title: Outlook: Insert Signature Image from OneDrive
Summary: Users can now insert images into their email signature directly from OneDrive, in addition to the device photo library.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot memory in Researcher
Summary: Copilot memory within Researcher brings forward relevant context from your past interactions—helping ground insights, personalize outputs, and reduce repetitive setup as you explore complex topics.

Title: Microsoft Edge: v.151 - Passkey Sync for Enterprise Users
Summary: Microsoft Edge is introducing support for passkey synchronization for enterprise users, enabling secure, passwordless authentication across devices. Passkeys created in Edge can now be synced seamlessly, improving sign-in experience while maintaining strong security standards.

Title: Outlook: Copilot now provides concise summaries with Outlook search results
Summary: Get answers to queries quickly with Copilot's concise AI summaries at the top of Outlook search results. Users can dig deeper by opening Copilot chat directly from the Copilot summary card.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Critique in Researcher
Summary: Responses are generated by GPT and Claude working together, with GPT drafting an initial response and Claude reviewing for increased response accuracy, completeness, and citation integrity.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher Council
Summary: Council in Researcher runs multiple leading AI models from different providers in parallel in one place, so you can quickly compare outputs and see consensus vs. conflict) to make high-stakes decisions with greater confidence—without switching tools.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized Default Mark and Notify Email Template
Summary: Enabling localization for the default Mark and Notify email template used in admin review and automation flows for user reported messages. This ensures end users receive review outcome notifications in their preferred language, improving understanding, trust, and participation in email reporting within Microsoft Defender for Office 365.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams
Summary: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
Summary: A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. This includes updates to the chat home screen, chat response layout, and navigation pane.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updated handling of entity inserts in the Copilot Chat input box
Summary: Starting mid-August 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat will update entity insertion so entity names no longer appear as text in the input box, creating cleaner prompts. This change is default for all tenants, requires no admin action, and affects all commercial cloud users.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: New guided diagnostics experience for DLP
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will introduce a new guided diagnostics experience by October 2026, enhancing visibility into DLP policy evaluation and actions. Eligible tenants get Security Copilot-powered insights for troubleshooting and optimization. Existing policies and enforcement remain unchanged, with no impact on user workflows.

Title: Clearer RSVP selection in Outlook Mobile
Summary: Outlook Mobile will highlight users' selected RSVP (Yes, Maybe, No) for meetings, improving visibility. Rollout starts mid-September 2026 and completes by mid-October 2026, affecting all iOS and Android users worldwide, GCC, and GCC High tenants. No admin action needed; feature enabled by default.

Title: Public Preview: Perimeter link feature in network security perimeter
Summary: Perimeter link (cross-perimeter connectivity) is a network security perimeter capability that allows trusted resources in two different network security perimeters to securely communicate with each other using Managed Identity (MSI), without requiring additional network security perimeter access rules or network configuration changes. It preserves Zero Trust boundaries while enabling controlled service-to-service access across perimeters Learn more .

Title: Public Preview: Azure Private Link support over IPv6
Summary: Azure Private Link over IPv6 enables you to privately access Azure PaaS services, such as Azure Storage and Azure SQL Database, over IPv6-based connectivity. You can now use IPv6 private endpoints to connect from IPv6 clients in an Azure virtual network or from on-premises networks over ExpressRoute. Learn more .

Title: Public Preview: Azure DNS enables DNS-based load balancing through Traffic Manager integration
Summary: Azure DNS now offers a seamless way to integrate with Azure Traffic Manager for DNS-based traffic routing. Customers can now directly associate Azure DNS record set with Traffic Manager profiles without creating CNAME record for trafficmanager.net domain. This improves lookup latency by eliminating a CNAME hop and enables DNSSEC compatibility for load balanced records by removing unsigned trafficmanager.net domain from CNAME lookup chain. Learn more .

Title: Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network routing appliance
Summary: Azure Virtual Network routing appliance is now generally available. Title: Microsoft Teams: Stricter external access controls for federated chats
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new PowerShell controls by late September 2026 to enforce stricter external access and mutual federation policies in federated group chats. These controls, disabled by default, help admins limit chat participation to approved external users and ensure mutual federation compliance, with automatic removal of non-compliant participants.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Restricted content discovery enhancements for Copilot and Microsoft 365 search
Summary: Microsoft is enhancing SharePoint's Restricted Content Discovery (RCD) to limit content visibility in Copilot and Microsoft 365 search, starting late July 2026. Files on RCD-enabled sites won't appear in AI-powered search or Copilot, and AI entry points will be removed, ensuring better compliance and content control.

Title: Microsoft Entra ID SSPR will require registered authentication methods starting November 9, 2026
Summary: Starting November 9, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID SSPR will require explicitly registered authentication methods for password reset verification, disallowing directory-sourced contact info unless registered. A registration campaign begins October 5, 2026. Organizations must ensure users register methods to avoid reset failures.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
Summary: Large file sharing in Teams today introduces blocking behavior, forcing users to wait for uploads to complete and disrupting real-time collaboration. To improve productivity and reduce perceived latency, we are introducing asynchronous file uploads. This allows users to continue sending messages while the file uploads in the background, enabling a more seamless and uninterrupted collaboration experience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
Summary: Call delegation in Teams now includes new controls that give delegators greater privacy and control during active calls. Delegators can lock an ongoing call to prevent delegates from joining or resuming the call and can optionally enable warning tones that notify participants when a delegate joins or resumes a call.

Title: Microsoft Teams: View and manage auto attendant shared voicemails directly in the Queues app
Summary: Calls to an Auto Attendant that are routed to voicemail will now appear directly within Queues app. This enables organizations to manage shared Auto Attendant voicemails in a centralized experience, making it easier for teams to track, triage, and respond to customer messages.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will support real-time Interpreter agent for up to nine languages, enabling multilingual meetings with voice simulation. Available late August 2026, it requires a Teams Rooms Pro license, includes 20 hours of interpretation monthly, and offers admin controls via Teams meeting policies. No action required.

Title: SharePoint Pages: Flexible Section Authoring Improvements
Summary: SharePoint Pages will enhance Flexible Sections with visual and persistent layout guides, easier resizing, and the ability to convert standard sections without losing content. These improvements, rolling out worldwide in August 2026, aim to simplify page authoring and ensure consistent layouts across devices. No admin action is needed.

Users can add notes, and system-generated notes will track investigation events. Expanded user details and integrated Entra ID profiles improve context. Rollout begins late June 2026.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Meeting Insight is retiring
Summary: Microsoft is retiring Outlook's Meeting Insights by early September 2026, replacing it with Microsoft 365 Copilot's meeting preparation features for licensed users. Meeting Insights will be removed across platforms, with no action required but recommended communication, documentation updates, and user training. No compliance issues noted.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
Summary: Microsoft OneDrive will allow administrators to exclude specific folders (e.g., node_modules, PowerShell modules) from syncing, keeping them local to devices. This feature, off by default, rolls out worldwide in August 2026, improves storage efficiency, and is managed via Group Policy with no user control over exclusions.

Title: Teams frontline mobile onboarding guide retirement
Summary: Microsoft is retiring the Frontline Teams Personal Device Onboarding Wizard by late August 2026. Frontline workers will use existing Microsoft Teams, Entra ID, Intune, and Authenticator onboarding methods. No changes to security controls are needed. Organizations should update documentation and training accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced file filtering in channel Shared tabs
Summary: Microsoft Teams now offers enhanced file filtering in the channel Shared tab, allowing users to filter files by type and media content in both All Documents and In Messages views. This update improves file discovery without requiring admin action and is available worldwide.

Title: OneDrive: Block screen capture for sensitivity-labeled PDFs in the OneDrive and SharePoint web viewer
Summary: The OneDrive and SharePoint web PDF viewer will block screen capture in Microsoft Edge when users open PDFs whose sensitivity (MIP) label without Copy (EXTRACT) permission.

Title: Outlook Mobile: Follow a meeting option
Summary: Outlook Mobile will add a "Follow" RSVP option for meetings with two or more participants starting early August 2026. It prompts organizers to record meetings and send updates to followers. The feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and changes the RSVP menu layout.

After this date, Windows Server 2022 will transition to extended support, which includes security updates at no additional cost, and will continue to receive monthly security updates through October 14, 2031. Summary: We are announcing the ability to utilize the Sales Opportunity Agent to research opportunities owned by specific Owner teams in Dynamics 365 Sales. This feature will reach general availability on July 31, 2026. How does this affect me? As a seller, you will be able to see Sales Opportunity Agent research results for opportunities owned by Owner teams.
