Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Debug routing issues with Application Insights dashboard
Summary: We are announcing the ability to debug routing issues with the Application Insights dashboard in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on January 31, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature provides efficient troubleshooting of routing delays and assignment issues via the Application Insights Debug dashboard. Key capabilities of the feature include: Conversation trend analysis: Visualize trends over the last 24 hours or a custom time range, with filters by...

Title: Generally Available: Geo-Replication for Azure Service Bus Premium
Summary: The Geo-Replication feature for Azure Service Bus in the premium tier is now generally available. The Service Bus Geo-Replication feature is one of the options to insulate Azure Service Bus applications against outages and disasters , providing replication of both metadata (entities, configuration, properties) and data (message data and message property / state changes). The Geo-Replication feature ensures that the metadata and data of a namespace are continuously replicated from a primary regio...

Title: Generally Available: Cloud-native apps on Kubernetes pricing calculator scenario
Summary: The new cloud-native apps on Kubernetes pricing calculator scenario allows teams to estimate the total cost of ownership for a production-ready AKS cluster with other key Azure services, including Azure Container Registry, Azure Monitoring, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and more. The calculator scenario provides an architecture diagram and cost estimate with customizable inputs to fit your workload requirements. Whether you are migrating legacy workloads or deploying new applications, including...

Title: Generally Available: Azure Premium SSD v2 Disk is now available in Austria East and in a second Availability Zone in Japan West
Summary: Azure Premium SSD v2 is now available in Austria East and in a second Availability Zone in Japan West. Azure Premium SSD v2 , a next-generation general-purpose block storage solution , offers sub-millisecond latencies and exceptional price performance for IO-intensive workloads at a low cost. Premium SSD v2 is suited for a broad range of enterprise production scenarios, including SQL Server, Oracle, MariaDB, SAP, Cassandra, MongoDB, big data/analytics, and gaming on virtual machines or stateful...

Title: Teams Admin Center: Best Practice dashboard to monitor VDI optimization for meetings
Summary: A new Best Practice Configurations Monitoring Dashboard will roll out in early 2026 in the Teams admin center, helping admins monitor and remediate VDI optimization issues in meetings. It highlights non-conformance, shows impacted locations, and allows export of user data for targeted fixes.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Join town halls and webinars as an attendee from Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android
Summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android can now join Town Halls in Teams as attendees. You can attend directly from the invited Teams Room, with the same features that attendees have for Town Halls on the Teams desktop app. Available in Teams Rooms Pro.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Model Selector in Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: The Model Selector in Microsoft 365 Copilot gives users more control over reasoning depth, enabling automatic reasoning for simple tasks and explicit control when desired. The three modes that are supported as part of GPT-5 are: Auto (default) - system decides how long to think, Quick response - answers right away, Think deeper - Thinks longer for better answers.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] [1.02] Generate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents from agents built in Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: With Agent Builder inside Microsoft 365 Copilot, users can now use Office skills like generating PowerPoint decks, Excel spreadsheets, and Word documents by chatting with the agent. This helps users save time by completing commonly used tasks. These Office skills will come as a part of the "Generate documents, charts, and code" capability in Agent Builder (formerly known as Code Interpreter).

Title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Add a Partner to Viva Glint
Summary: This feature will simplify the process to onboard external resources (Partners) to your Viva Glint instance.

Title: Retirement: Deprecation of Custom Resource Providers
Summary: In 2026, Azure Resource Manager will be deprecating the Custom Resource Provider (CuRP) service. We will retire the feature by October 31, 2026 . We will be performing a scream test on October 27, 2025, as part of this deprecation. On July 31, 2026, creates, updates, patches, and actions to custom resources and resource providers will be blocked. Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service – Simulate AI field prediction capability from Case Management Agent
Summary: We are announcing the ability to test how well the Case Management Agent is performing with field prediction in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on January 23, 2026. How does this affect me? Simulation helps admins understand how Case Management Agent would perform field prediction so that they can evaluate quality checks and make determinations about the enablement of this feature in production. Admins can choose historical case records or upload an Ex...

Title: Microsoft Entra: Conditional Access support for Entra ID Account Recovery
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID Account Recovery is an advanced authentication recovery mechanism that enables users to regain access to their organizational accounts when they've lost access to all registered authentication methods. This feature adds additional support for protecting the account recovery flow by enabling CA policies to be applied. Learn more

Title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: SIEM agents will retire
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps will retire SIEM agents, with no new agents configurable after June 19, 2025. The rollout is paused, and users are advised to transition to unified APIs and SIEM solutions for alerts and activity data to ensure continuity and enhanced capabilities.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot App for Windows: "Update available" button
Summary: Starting January 2026, the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for Windows will show a non-blocking "Update" button in the top-right corner when a new version is available. Users can update immediately or later without interrupting app use. No admin action is needed; communicate this change to users.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Customizable oversharing dialog for DLP in New Outlook
Summary: New Outlook for Windows will offer a customizable oversharing dialog for DLP, allowing admins to tailor messages with multi-language support, business justifications, and dynamic tokens. Rolling out globally from January 2026, the feature is off by default and configurable via the Compliance portal.

Title: Microsoft Teams: In channels, the "Shared" tab (formerly the "Files" tab) will have new capabilities
Summary: The Teams "Files" tab in channels will be renamed "Shared," combining shared post content and document library files. Rolling out Nov 2025–Jan 2026, it offers views by posts and library, file ordering, and filtering. No admin action needed; user notification is recommended.

Title: Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence: Convergence with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel
Summary: Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence is merging with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel by August 1, 2026, offering integrated threat insights and enhanced analytics. Post-transition, MDTI requires an active Defender or Sentinel license. Organizations should prepare by updating licenses, documentation, and transitioning before the deadline.

Title: Teams admin center: Auto‑updates for Teams Android device firmware and apps will be paused during year‑end holidays
Summary: Auto-updates for Teams Android device firmware and apps via Teams admin center will pause from December 20, 2025, to January 12, 2026, to ensure holiday stability. Manual updates remain available. Updates will resume post-holiday with standard rollout logic; no action is needed before the pause.

Title: Teams admin center: Messaging safety defaults changing to "On" by default
Summary: Starting January 12, 2026, Microsoft Teams will enable messaging safety features by default, including weaponizable file type protection, malicious URL protection, and reporting incorrect detections. Existing custom settings remain unchanged. Admins should review and adjust settings before this date and inform helpdesk staff accordingly.

Title: Chat history landing page: Filtering UI refresh
Summary: The Chat History landing page filtering UI will be refreshed by consolidating filters into a single "filter pill" for easier management and clearing. This update, rolling out globally in January 2026, affects all users with no functional changes. No admin action is needed, but communication and documentation updates are recommended.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Recommended Notebooks in Copilot Notebooks
Summary: Users can quickly create new Copilot Notebooks via Recommended Notebooks based on recent user work activity.

Title: Exchange: Message Trace - Custom Retention
Summary: We will be introducing customizable retention options for Message Trace logs. Organizations will be able to choose from a predefined set of retention periods.

Title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent mode in Word enables conversational support to create, edit and refine document content from chat
Summary: Available for M365 users without a M365 Copilot license. From Chat, you can use natural language to generate and direct edits to new and existing documents, when in an Edit mode. In this mode, Copilot will ask clarifying questions if needed, and after making changes will recap actions take and recommended next steps. Changes to the document are supported with controls in the document canvas to review changes made.

Title: Microsoft Exchange Online: New Message Trace will be GA; legacy Message Trace will retire
Summary: The new Message Trace in Exchange Online is generally available, replacing legacy cmdlets and UI starting September 1, 2025. The legacy tools will be supported in parallel for months, with full deprecation by March 18, 2026. Admins should update scripts and begin using the new experience.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Upcoming improvements to the jump list experience on Windows
Summary: Microsoft Teams on Windows will update the jump list by mid-February 2026, adding meeting access, scheduling, and chat actions, while removing the "Quit" option. These changes improve efficiency and require no user action but may need helpdesk and documentation updates.

Title: Learning Activities now available in Microsoft 365 Education and Copilot
Summary: Learning Activities is now available in Microsoft 365 Education and Copilot, enabling educators and students to create interactive practice tools like flashcards from existing content. It rolled out worldwide by December 2025, is enabled by default for eligible licenses, and can be disabled by admins if desired.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Security Investigations – Introducing new purge mitigation action
Summary: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations will add a new purge mitigation action by early 2026, allowing admins to delete sensitive or overshared content during investigations. Enabled by default, it respects existing policies and requires no prior admin action. Security teams should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Teams town halls: Full HD (1080p) video resolution coming to Teams Premium
Summary: Microsoft Teams Premium will support 1080p video resolution for town halls starting targeted release in November 2025 and general availability in January 2026. IT admins must enable it via policy, ensure network support, and use Ultra-Low Latency and Microsoft eCDN for optimal performance.

Title: Take Action: Out-of-band update to address MSMQ service issues leading to queue operations and resource-related errors
Summary: Microsoft has identified an issue affecting Message Queuing (MSMQ) functionality in some enterprise environments after installing the December 2025 Windows security update (released December 9, 2025). Individuals using Windows Home or Pro editions on personal devices are very unlikely to experience this issue, as it primarily affects enterprise or managed IT environments. To address this issue, an out-of-band (OOB) update has been released, today, December 18, 2025, on the Microsoft Update Catal...

Summary: Azure Storage Mover’s new Azure Blob container-to-container migration feature is now in Public Preview, empowering organizations to move data between two Blob containers within the same or different storage accounts, subscriptions or Azure regions securely, reliably, and at scale. With this release, customers can eliminate manual pipelines and tools, automate migrations in the Azure portal, and gain real-time visibility into every job. Key benefits: 1. Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Sharing Word, Excel, and PowerPoint local files through email
Summary: The planned feature to share local Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files via new Outlook for Windows, initially set for mid-September to late October 2025, will not proceed at this time. No admin action is needed, but user notification and documentation updates are advised.

Title: Announcing the new pay-as-you-go experience in Microsoft 365 Admin Center
Summary: Microsoft 365 Admin Center introduces a new pay-as-you-go experience for managing Backup and Copilot billing starting January 15, 2026. Admins can create billing policies, set budgets, and view usage under the Billing node. Migration details for existing Backup customers will be announced later. No immediate action required.

Title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Nine new connectors now generally available
Summary: Nine new Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors are now generally available, enabling integration with GitHub, Freshservice, Guru, Dropbox, Google Drive, Zendesk, and Amazon S3. These connectors allow users to search, retrieve, and interact with external enterprise data across Microsoft 365 apps immediately.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Email customization for site access review from Data Access Governance reports
Summary: SharePoint admins can customize emails sent from Data Access Governance reports for site access reviews starting mid-December 2025. This optional feature aims to improve email engagement and response rates without changing existing policies. Admins should update documentation and notify relevant teams accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Wait on Send for Data loss Prevention
Summary: New Outlook for Windows will support Wait on Send for Data Loss Prevention, blocking email sending until DLP evaluation completes or timeout occurs. This feature is disabled by default and controlled via Exchange mailbox settings, allowing users to multitask during evaluation with configurable override timing. Available early 2026.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Emojis in section names
Summary: Microsoft Teams will support emojis in custom section names starting November 2025 on Desktop and Web, with Mobile support next semester. This feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and helps users visually organize sections. Rollout completes by December 2025 worldwide.

Title: Public Preview: Service Bus SDK type bindings in Azure Functions for Node.js
Summary: Azure Functions triggers and bindings enable you to easily integrate event and data sources with function applications. Now that SDK type bindings support for Azure Blob Storage is available, we’re also introducing support for Service Bus SDK type bindings in your Node.js function apps. This means in JavaScript or TypeScript function apps you can now interact with a ServiceBusMessageContext type offering advanced messaging functionality. Learn more: SDK type bindings for Service Bus in JavaScrip...

Summary: You can now simplify how you diagnose and resolve issues in your applications running on Azure Cosmos DB with the introduction of the Azure Cosmos DB S ite Reli ability Engineering ( SRE ) Agent, built on the Azure SRE Agent platform. This new capability gives you deeper visibility into the health and performance of your database workloads by combining client-side telemetry with server-side diagnostics, allowing you to identify problems faster and understand them more clearly. Title: Generally Avaailable: Azure SQL updates for early December 2025
Summary: In mid-December 2025 , the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: Identify causes that auto-resume serverless workloads using Activity Log in Azure SQL Database to troubleshoot and optimize access patterns. Learn more .

Title: Microsoft Viva : News AI audio briefing in Connections Mobile
Summary: Microsoft Viva Connections mobile will introduce an AI audio briefing feature providing summaries of top news with playback controls. Available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, it rolls out from late September 2025 to mid-February 2026, enabled by default with no configuration needed.

Title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center – Evaluate closed conversations with Quality Evaluation Agent
Summary: We are announcing the ability to evaluate closed conversations, generate quality scores, and provide insights to help supervisors improve interaction quality in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on January 16, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature reviews closed conversations and provides quality scores based on defined evaluation criteria and evaluation plans. Additionally, this feature provides supervisors with full control over score calculations,...

Title: Migrate User Data Across Tenants: Mailboxes, OneDrives, and Teams Chats
Summary: Starting early December 2025, admins can opt-in to a unified interface with new PowerShell Graph commands to migrate Exchange mailboxes, OneDrive files, and Teams chats across Microsoft 365 tenants, simplifying tenant-to-tenant migrations during organizational changes. No action is required unless used.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention - Mac device and device group based policy scoping support for Endpoint DLP

Summary: Starting March 1, 2026, Exchange Online will block devices using Exchange ActiveSync versions below 16.1 for improved security. Organizations must update mobile devices and apps to EAS 16.1 or higher. Outlook Mobile is unaffected. Admins can identify outdated devices using a provided PowerShell command.

Properties are hidden by default and configurable in admin settings.

Summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now offers inline file upload protection in Edge for Business to prevent data leaks to unmanaged GenAI apps. Admins can enforce policies based on file size, type, and sensitivity on Intune-managed Windows devices. Public preview starts late November 2025; general availability begins mid-January 2026.

Public preview starts late November 2025; general availability begins mid-January 2026. This enhances data security and compliance monitoring on Intune-managed Windows devices.

Summary: The Designer bot and Designer banners in Microsoft Teams will be retired between mid-January and February 27, 2026. Users can no longer use these features but can generate images via Copilot in Teams. No admin action is needed; notify users and update documentation accordingly.

Benchmarks use anonymized data, include admin controls, and help improve adoption strategies. Organizations should review access and update training accordingly.

Summary: In new Outlook for Windows and web, single-clicking an empty calendar slot will enable inline appointment creation instead of a quick compose pop-up, aligning with classic Outlook. Summary: You can now receive insights where collaboration happens—in Microsoft Teams—with expanded dashboard subscription capabilities in Azure Databricks. Summary: Viva Engage is updating the Answers tab to require users to select a community when posting questions, improving visibility and response quality. This change will be completed by mid-July 2025, applies to all users, and requires no admin action, though informing users is recommended.

Summary: We are announcing the ability to directly transfer conversations to other representatives within their queue or other queues without the need to consult first in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. Summary: Starting April 15, 2025, messages with multiple From addresses without a Sender header will be rejected in Exchange Online to comply with RFC 5322. The rollout for GCC High and DOD is delayed to October 7, 2025. Tenants sending high volumes of such emails are opted out temporarily.

Summary: Organization Data Types in Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 will retire on July 31, 2025. Users should switch to Power BI or custom Excel add-ins. Existing data types will remain but won't refresh. Bing data types are unaffected. For preparation, connect Excel to Power BI or explore custom add-ins.

Summary: Support for rendering Loop components in Word for the web will be retired on September 1, 2025. Existing Loop components will display as read-only placeholders with links to open them externally. Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a compact toast notification size for Windows users, available from July 2025. Users can enable it via Settings > Notifications > Choose Compact. This feature aims to reduce screen clutter and distractions. No admin action is required.

Summary: Azure Firewall supports the use of Fully Qualified Domain Names (FQDNs) in DNAT (Destination Network Address Translation) rules, allowing inbound traffic to be routed to backend resources using domain names instead of static IP addresses. With L7 policies, customers can define security rules based on application-layer attributes, improving zero-trust security models within AKS. Learn more.

Title: Generally Available: Cilium Endpoint Slices in AKS
Summary: AKS now supports Cilium endpoint slices, improving scalability and efficiency of network endpoint management. By reducing API server load and optimizing service discovery, endpoint slices enhance networking performance for AKS clusters using the Cilium dataplane. Learn more .

Title: Public Preview: Service Allowed IP Ranges in AKS
Summary: AKS now allows you to define both IP ranges and service tags for Service LoadBalancers, providing more flexible traffic control than loadBalancerSourceRanges. This eliminates the need for manual service tag updates and ensures seamless traffic management across on-premises and Azure services. Learn more.

Title: Public Preview: Multiple Load Balancers for AKS
Summary: To address existing SLB rule limits and private link constraints, AKS now supports multiple standard load balancers (SLB) per cluster. This enhancement allows for better scalability, workload distribution, and flexibility in managing network traffic across large deployments. Learn more.

Title: Generally Available: AKS Cost Recommendations in Azure Advisor
Summary: To help you optimize your AKS clusters, Azure Advisor now offers AKS cost recommendations. These advisors are designed to identify cost savings opportunities and provide actionable insights to enforce AKS cost best practices. The recommendations are tailored to your cluster configuration and target rightsizing, autoscaling, visibility, and SKU selection scenarios. Learn more.

Title: Public Preview: maxUnavailable Setting for Upgrades in AKS
Summary: AKS now supports setting a maxUnavailable option for upgrading nodepools to a newer version of both Kubernetes and node images. With maxUnavailable, you no longer need to use surge nodes to begin the upgrade process. AKS will instead simply cordon and drain existing nodes on the nodepool. Learn more.

Title: Public Preview: Standard Load Balancer (SLB) Health Probe Redesign in AKS
Summary: AKS now offers improved load balancing for services using externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster . This enhancement enables the standard load balancer (SLB) to probe kube-proxy directly instead of backend applications. This new capability enhances reliability, reduces misconfigurations, and improves traffic routing. Learn more.

Title: Generally Available: Skip Automatic GPU Driver Installation
Summary: By default, AKS installs NVIDIA GPU drivers when a node pool is created using a VM size that supports NVIDIA GPUs. The ability to skip automatic driver installation on your GPU-enabled node pools is now generally available. This option allows you to self-install custom GPU drivers or use the GPU Operator on Linux and Windows node pools. Learn more.

Title: Public preview: Multi-cluster Workload Rollout Strategies and Runs with Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager
Summary: Operators using Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager’s Cluster Resource Placement for intelligent execution of multi-cluster workload placement can now define reusable staged rollout strategies using ClusterStagedUpdateStrategy custom resource. A ClusterStagedUpdateStrategy specifies the ordering of clusters across stages, supporting soak time and approvals between stages. An Operator can use a strategy to deploy a workload via creating and submitting a ClusterStagedUpdateRun custom resource. Learn mo...

Title: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: Enhanced external recipient determinations
Summary: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android is enhancing the External Recipients MailTips feature for better offline accuracy and performance. The rollout, starting mid-February 2025 and completing by late April 2025, requires no admin action but users should be notified. More details will be updated on Microsoft Learn.

Title: Public Preview: Application Insights auto-instrumentation for AKS
Summary: To provide seamless monitoring for Java and Node deployments, AKS now offers Application Insights integration for Java and Node microservices. This integration, available in public preview, allows customers to easily monitor their deployments without changing any code by leveraging auto-instrumentation that is integrated into the AKS cluster. Learn more.

Title: Public Preview: Default Inference with vLLM with AI Toolchain Operator Add-on
Summary: By default, the AI toolchain operator add-on now deploys model inferencing workloads using the high-throughput vLLM serving engine. vLLM offers a significant speed-up to process incoming requests and flexibility to use OpenAI-compatible APIs, DeepSeek R1 models, and a range of pre-trained HuggingFace models. Alternatively, you can switch from vLLM to HuggingFace Transformers for KAITO inference deployments at any time. Learn more.

Title: Generally Available: Multi-cluster Auto-upgrade in Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager
Summary: Platform administrators managing large number of Kubernetes clusters face the challenge of updating Kubernetes or node images in a way that is safe and predictable. To address this challenge, Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager (Fleet Manager) provides update runs which are used to deploy updates across multiple Kubernetes clusters using safe deployment practices. Fleet Manager is announcing the general availability of Auto-upgrade support, which provides an automated trigger for update runs based on...

Title: Generally Available: AKS Communication Manager
Summary: The AKS communication manager streamlines notifications for all your AKS maintenance tasks by using Azure Resource Notification and Azure Resource Graph frameworks. This tool enables you to monitor your upgrades closely by providing timely alerts on event triggers and outcomes. If maintenance fails, it notifies you with the reasons for the failure, reducing operational hassles related to observability and follow-ups. You can set up notifications for all types of auto upgrades that utilize mainte...

Title: Generally Available: Azure CNI Overlay Dual-stack with Cilium Dataplane Support
Summary: Azure CNI overlay now supports dual-stack networking with Azure CNI powered by Cilium, enabling customers to enforce IPv6 network policies and leverage Advanced Container Networking Services (ACNS) in dual-stack environments. This update allows customers using Cilium with overlay mode to fully utilize IPv4 and IPv6 together, enhancing security, scalability, and networking capabilities in AKS. Learn more .

Title: Generally Available: Azure Linux 3.0 Support in AKS
Summary: Azure Linux 3.0, the next major version release of the Azure Linux container host for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), is now generally available and defaults on Kubernetes version 1.32. Azure Linux 3.0 offers increased package availability and versions, an updated kernel, and improvements to performance, security, and tooling and developer experience. Learn more.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office: "Threat classification" in Mail flow status summary and Threat protection status reports

The rollout began in mid-March 2025 and will complete by late May 2025. No admin action is required, but reviewing current configurations and notifying users is recommended.

Summary: The Policy Sync Status feature in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal allows solution admins to see the sync status of policies directly from the Policies and Reports pages. Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Bulk import of .eml files
Summary: Users will soon be able to bulk import .eml files in the new Microsoft Outlook for Windows, starting mid-March 2025. This feature will be enabled by default and simplifies the process of importing multiple email files. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) will now support scoping policies for devices and device groups in Endpoint. Summary: Starting March 28, 2025, Microsoft SharePoint Online Management Shell will replace the IDCRL authentication protocol with OAuth. Admins should install the updated version from the Microsoft Download Center. No admin action is required, but reviewing current configurations and notifying users is recommended.

Summary: Design Ideas now provides formatting suggestions for the quick links webpart. This includes suggesting icons and images for a given link, as well as showing how the webpart would look with different card sizes, for single quick link webparts in a section.

Title: Microsoft Search in Bing Deprecation
Summary: Microsoft Search in Bing will be deprecated on March 31, 2025. Users should transition to Microsoft Search via Office.com, SharePoint Online, or Microsoft365.com. The rollout will start in late March 2025 for Targeted Release and mid-April 2025 for General Availability. No admin action is required, but user notification and training updates are recommended.

This role, based on customer feedback, allows management of people-related settings and profile photos without requiring high privileges. Summary: Microsoft products are transitioning to the cloud.microsoft domain by October 2024. Services are already available on the new domain, with previous domains redirecting soon. This change should not impact users following Microsoft's network guidance since April 2023. Users and admins need to recognize and prepare for the new domain.

Title: Microsoft Stream: Video reactions
Summary: This feature will allow users to add or remove reactions to specific points of a recorded video via Stream Web App and Embed. Viewers will be able to see how their colleagues feel about a video and show their support towards the video owner. These reactions will be present in the timeline to highlight the most important parts of the video and can be used for navigation. Title: Introducing Meeting Prep for Financial Services (Preview)
Summary: Meeting Prep for Financial Services is now in public preview, offering investment bankers a centralized app for meeting preparation. It integrates data from various sources with AI insights and is available now, with general availability starting early December 2024. Licensing includes Microsoft 365 E3/Business Basic and LSEG Workspace.

Title: Copilot Pages coming to Microsoft Copilot
Summary: Copilot Pages will be available in Microsoft Copilot for users with an Entra account and SharePoint license starting early November 2024. This feature allows for collaborative and persistent workspaces in Copilot chat. It will be enabled by default with admin controls for customization.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Top questions in your communities
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is introducing a 'Top questions' feature to display the most popular questions in a community over the last 90 days, aiding in finding relevant content. It will roll out from mid-November to late December 2024 and will be enabled by default. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Audit: Enable audit log search for content searches that target Microsoft SharePoint Online
Summary: Enable audit log search for SharePoint Online content searches in Microsoft Purview by following the provided instructions. This feature is now generally available and requires enabling 'SearchQueryInitiatedSharePoint' for users. No admin action is needed before the rollout, but reviewing configurations and updating documentation is advised.

Title: (Update) Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Improved Data Loss Prevention policy tips
Summary: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection will update to show consistent Data Loss Prevention policy tips across Word, Excel, PowerPoint for Windows, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive. Rollout starts early June 2024, with general availability by mid-December 2024. No admin action required before rollout. Documentation will be updated accordingly.

Title: Upcoming changes to email service notification recipients
Summary: Message Center is the primary channel to receive updates about your Microsoft services. Occasionally, we will send email service notifications regarding upcoming changes that require customer action, planned maintenance, or other important announcements. To expand access and help you manage recipients in your organization, we will be implementing a new policy for receiving these transactional, email service notifications. How does this affect me? Title: Microsoft Clipchamp: The brand kit feature is rolling out with extended elements to all users
Summary: The message informs about the rollout of the Brand kit feature in Microsoft Clipchamp for certain Microsoft 365 subscriptions. It details the feature's capabilities, such as creating and sharing brand assets, and advises users to update administrative records and documentation accordingly. Brand kit is now a standard feature and requires no admin action before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Community settings for Community Resources and Files tab
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will introduce community settings for the Community Resources module and Files tab, with a rollout starting late October 2024 and completing by mid-November 2024. Community admins will gain control over the visibility of these features with new toggles. Default settings will have both features visible.

Summary: Enterprise and Enterprise Flash tier caches now have the ability to scale up or out without requiring downtime. Scaling up allows a cache to scale to a larger Enterprise SKU with more memory capacity, connections, and compute performance. Scaling out spreads data over additional nodes, which likewise boosts memory and compute performance. Summary: Azure Backup users will now have immutable WORM storage for their backups when immutability is enabled and locked on a Recovery Services Vault. When immutability is enabled, it ensures that a Recovery Point, once created, cannot be deleted or have its retention period reduced before its intended expiry. Summary: Following the announcement on November 10, 2023, we are continuing our transition to requiring TLS 1.2 or later for all connections to Azure services. To minimize disruption to customer workloads, several services will continue supporting TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 versions and complete their transitions by August 31, 2025 when TLS 1.2 or later will be required for all connections to Azure services (unless explicitly indicated in service documentation). Summary: The September 2024 release of the FinOps toolkit (version 0.6) is now available. This month, you’ll find: New: FinOps best practices library. New: Power BI reports for governance and workload optimization Customizable promoted tags in Power BI. Ingest prices, reservation details, reservation recommendations, and reservation transactions in FinOps hubs. Performance and scalability improvements in Power BI reports. New: Consolidated FinOps workbooks template. Azure Optimization Engine security and...

Title: Generally Available: Set fail criteria on server metrics in Azure Load Testing
Summary: You can now set fail criteria on server metrics, thereby defining performance and quality expectations for your application under load. Monitor your applications components and specify the thresholds on server metrics for test failure. Learn more .

Title: Generally Available: Azure App Configuration – Premium pricing plan now generally available
Summary: The Premium tier for Azure App Configuration is now generally available, making it possible to support larger and more complex applications with higher performance and scalability. This new pricing plan is ideal for organizations that need greater capacity, enhanced security, and global availability for configuration management. Key capabilities include: Increased Capacity : Supports higher configuration volumes and increased request throughput for large-scale applications. Included Global Repli...

Title: Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Node.js 22
Summary: Azure Functions now supports Node.js 22 in preview. You can now develop functions using Node.js 22 locally and deploy them to all Azure Functions plans on Linux and Windows. Learn more about upgrading your Function Apps to Node.js 22 .

Title: Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for late-October 2024
Summary: In late-October 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: More than twice as many Azure regions as before now support autoscaling—up to 80 vCores—using serverless in Azure SQL Database.

Title: Microsoft Places will be generally available in Q4 CY24
Summary: Microsoft Places, an AI-powered app for flexible work, will be available in Q4 CY24 with core and premium service plans. Existing Office 365 customers will get the core plan, which includes basic features for workplace coordination. Teams Premium users will get enhanced features. Service plans will roll out in late November.

Title: Microsoft Exchange Online: Support for inbound SMTP DANE with DNSSEC
Summary: Microsoft Exchange Online now supports inbound SMTP DANE with DNSSEC, enhancing email security. It's in General Availability since October 22, 2024. The feature is off by default and can be enabled via Exchange PowerShell, with a new enabling experience coming by end of 2024. Additional information and limitations are detailed in the provided links.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Auto-detect and pre-select room audio in BYOD meeting rooms
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon auto-detect room audio in BYOD meeting rooms when a laptop is connected via USB, suggesting or selecting the room audio option. Rollout begins early October 2024, with full availability expected by late November 2024. This feature will be on by default.

Title: Microsoft Stream: Seek bar thumbnails for Teams meeting recordings
Summary: This feature adds seek bar (preview) thumbnails to Microsoft Stream's video player. The thumbnails provide a preview of the video content when hovering over the player's seek bar at a certain timestamp. Currently, it will only be made available for Teams meeting recordings.

Title: Microsoft Teams apps and Microsoft Copilot extensions: New security and certification information
Summary: New Microsoft Teams apps and Copilot extensions will provide admins with security and certification information for compliance assessment. This feature, available in the Teams and Microsoft 365 admin centers, will include Microsoft 365 certification outcomes and ISV-submitted data. It will roll out worldwide from late October to late November 2024 and is on by default. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Updated handling of Microsoft Office documents in Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android
Summary: The update for Microsoft Outlook on iOS and Android now prioritizes standalone Microsoft Office apps over the Microsoft 365 app for opening document files. Rollout starts mid-September 2024 and ends mid-November 2024. Organizations should adjust app policies and inform users accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Message Recall for encrypted emails in Microsoft Outlook
Summary: Microsoft Purview's Information Protection will soon include Message Recall for encrypted emails in Outlook. Rollout begins early October 2024, completing by late November 2024. Users with Microsoft 365 E5 or Office 365 E5 licenses can recall encrypted emails from the Sent folder. This feature will be enabled by default. No admin action is needed before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview: Minor encrypted message portal design updates, URL to remain the same
Summary: The Microsoft Purview Message Encryption portal will have minor design updates to match Purview branding, with changes including updated fonts, colors, controls, and UI layout. Rollout begins late October 2024 and completes by late December 2024. Organizations should update training and documentation as needed.

Title: Microsoft Intune ending support for Android device administrator on devices with GMS access
Summary: Microsoft Intune will end support for Android device administrator on devices with Google Mobile Services access by December 31, 2024. Users should stop enrolling devices with this method and migrate to alternative management methods. Intune will not update or support these devices after the end date.

Title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service - Use proactive prompts and insights generated by Copilot
Summary: We are announcing the use proactive prompts and insights generated by Copilot feature for Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature enables users to discover and prompt Copilot without the need for manual typing. This feature will reach general availability on November 15, 2024. This feature will be automatically enabled, unless you have previously opted out of Copilot in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. How does this affect me? Title: iOS Build now included in ActiveSyncDeviceAccess rule for Outlook on iOS
Summary: Starting mid-November 2024, Outlook on iOS will support specifying iOS build numbers in ActiveSyncDeviceAccess rules. Organizations can update existing rules to use this feature, but it's not mandatory. Review the 'New-ActiveSyncDeviceAccessRule' documentation for guidance.

Title: SharePoint list and library rules will send from the no-reply@sharepointonline.com email address
Summary: SharePoint list and library rules' automated emails will now be sent from no-reply@sharepointonline.com with the display name "SharePoint Online." This change is effective immediately and requires no action, but email policies and workflows might need updating to include this new address.

Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for October 2024
Summary: The Microsoft Intune Service Update for October 2024 includes new changes, with the service release number soon to be updated in the Tenant Status blade. Users are encouraged to click additional information to learn more and to review the latest features on the Intune What's New page and blogs.

Title: Eligible users can now signup for Teams Exploratory on MOBILE
Summary: Eligible users can sign up for the Teams Exploratory trial on mobile, allowing full Teams features for free for up to 6 months. Rollout begins early/mid-November 2024. Users need a managed domain email and no active Teams license. Post-trial, a 30-day grace period is provided before access is revoked.

Title: Microsoft Lists app: New drag and drop feature
Summary: The Microsoft Lists app is introducing a drag and drop feature to reorder list items, with a rollout starting in August 2024 and completing by late October 2024. This feature will be available by default to all users. No admin action is required for the update.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New collaborative environment in Microsoft Mesh
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new Project Studio environment for immersive meetings and Microsoft Mesh events, optimized for small group collaboration. Rolling out starts in early November 2024, with general availability by late December 2024. No admin action is required for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Exchange: Improved bulk detection and updated bulk complaint level recommendations
Summary: Microsoft Exchange is enhancing bulk email filtering with recalibrated bulk sender distribution across different bulk complaint levels (BCL). New BCL recommendations are 7 for default and standard, and 5 for strict policies. Rollout starts mid-October 2024, with completion by mid-November 2024. Admins should adjust BCL settings accordingly.

Title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New "Support Assistant" feature in Help
Summary: The Microsoft 365 admin center will introduce a new "Support Assistant" feature, starting with a Public Preview in early November 2024, and completing by late May 2025. This AI-driven conversational experience can be toggled on in the Help & Support pane by admins. It will be available to a select group of English locale customers. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Viva Engage: Page header enhancements
Summary: Microsoft Viva Engage is updating its page header to be more streamlined, with relevant content and highlighted key actions. Icon/avatar sizes are reduced to minimize overlap. Rollout begins early November 2024, with new image dimensions provided for community administrators. No admin action required before rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Quality of Experience Report v5.0 for Microsoft Power BI
Summary: The Quality of Experience Report v5.0 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality Dashboard in Power BI is now generally available, featuring new intelligent media quality classifiers and an updated design. IT admins should review the latest documentation and ensure proper setup to utilize the new features.

Title: Project for the Web Email Notification Update
Summary: Project for the Web is updating email notifications. Groups with 50 or fewer members will receive individual emails when a project or roadmap is shared. Groups with over 50 members will not receive these emails. Rollout starts mid-November 2024, with completion by late November 2024. Organizations should update relevant documentation and processes.

Summary: Azure customers can now use the secure and smaller ED25519 SSH keys with their Linux VMs. Previously, customers only had the option of using RSA keys for SSH connections to their Linux VMs on Azure. Now customers can choose between RSA and ED25519 based keys. Azure now allows the creation of ED25519 SSH keys directly within the Azure Portal for a simplified key management process. Summary: Announcing general availability of ExpressRoute Metro, a new private connectivity architecture designed to enhance network resiliency for our customers. Summary: Azure Elastic SAN for Azure VMware Solution (AVS) is now generally available. Summary: Microsoft is announcing the general availability of the new Cobalt 100 Arm-based virtual machines (VMs). The Cobalt 100 VMs consist of our new general purpose Dpsv6-series and Dplsv6-series and our memory optimized Epsv6-series VM series. Title: URLs for deployment configurations will be retired
Summary: Direct URLs for Microsoft 365 Apps deployment configurations will be discontinued. Changes start in late September 2024 and end by mid-November 2024. Affected organizations should prepare by downloading configurations for use with the Office Deployment Tool.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Viva Amplify
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now available in Viva Amplify to improve authoring with AI. It's accessible without a Copilot license if you have a Viva Amplify license. Copilot offers rewriting, length adjustment, and tone setting features but is not available on SharePoint or mobile apps. No admin action is needed for the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Copilot in Edge will support page summarization and user prompt suggestions
Summary: Starting early November 2024, Microsoft Copilot in Edge will reintroduce page summarization and contextual prompt suggestions, available for users signed in with a Microsoft Entra account or using Microsoft 365 Copilot in web mode. Rollout will be automatic, and admins can configure the feature.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Chat contextual info and Search
Summary: Microsoft Teams is updating to include enhanced chat contextual information and search capabilities. Rollout begins late July 2024 for Targeted Release and will be globally available by mid-January 2025. This feature, which is on by default, allows users to access chat info such as People, Pinned messages, Shared files, and links, and search within chats. No admin action is required for the update.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Refreshed view of all your teams and channels page
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a refreshed 'Your teams' and 'Manage Team > Channels' page for better navigation and management of teams and channels. Rollout begins early October 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-October for General Availability, with completion expected by late October 2024. No admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Disable attendee emails for town halls and webinars
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon release a feature to disable attendee email notifications for town halls and webinars, with updated rollout timelines provided. This feature is linked to Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 392826 and requires no admin action prior to rollout. Organizations can prepare by informing users and updating documentation.

Title: Microsoft Purview - Information about schema updates for Microsoft Power Apps activities
Summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal is being updated to introduce a new schema to track Power Apps and Power Platform Connector activities. Beginning in October 2024, both activities will start being logged under the PowerPlatformAdministratorActivity activity type. How does this affect me? Title: Microsoft PowerPoint: QuickStarter feature retires starting October 2024
Summary: The PowerPoint QuickStarter feature will be retired between November 11, 2024, and January 14, 2025, for Office versions 2410 for Windows and 2411 for Mac. Organizations using it should prepare for its discontinuation.

Title: Power Automate - Use your own encryption key for protecting data at-rest for existing environments with flows
Summary: We are announcing the ability to use your own encryption key for encrypting data at-rest for existing environments with flows in Power Automate. This will enable you to meet your data and privacy policy guidelines. This feature will reach general availability on November 15, 2024. How does this affect me? You will be able to use your own encryption key from your Azure Key Vault to encrypt an environment that already has running Power Automate flows. Previously, only environments without prior Po...

Title: Microsoft Viva: Pulse admins can manage Pulse notifications
Summary: Microsoft Viva: Pulse admins will soon manage notification settings, choosing delivery methods for users' Pulse surveys. Rollout begins late October and completes by late November 2024. This feature is on by default and is associated with Roadmap ID 408163. Admins should prepare by installing the Viva Pulse Teams app.

Title: New Outlook for Windows: Multi-account support for add-Ins and apps
Summary: New Outlook for Windows will soon support apps and add-ins for all accounts, with a dynamic interface reflecting the active account. Rollouts start late October 2024 for Targeted Release and late November 2024 for General Availability. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Export content (including Microsoft Loop) stored in SharePoint Embedded (SPE) containers
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint Online will soon allow admins to export content from SharePoint Embedded containers, including Microsoft Loop, using third-party tools with guest app permissions. Rollout begins mid-October 2024, with full availability expected by late October 2024. This update requires no admin action before rollout.

Title: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for macOS – Planned update to compatibility Office add-ins and ODBC drivers
Summary: The message details a planned update for Office on macOS, requiring Office add-ins and ODBC drivers to be codesigned with a valid Apple Developer ID. This change, expected in mid-November 2024, may affect workflows using unsigned dynamic libraries. Developers must ensure compliance, and admins should verify and prepare for this update.

Title: Microsoft 365 apps: Improved resharing experience
Summary: Microsoft 365 apps are introducing an improved resharing experience. Users can now copy view-only links directly from the Share dialog, and request file sharing from the owner if needed. Rollout begins mid-September 2024, with general availability by late October 2024. No admin action is required for this update.

Title: CAPTCHA Verification for Anonymous Meeting Participants
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing CAPTCHA verification for anonymous meeting participants, with rollout starting late October 2024 and completion by mid-November 2024. Tenant Admins must enable this feature in the Teams Admin Center.

Title: Preview new Graph connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot
Summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces an early preview of new Graph connectors, including GitHub, Google Drive, and others, with limited availability starting from October 2024. Sign-ups for the preview are open via a form or email. These connectors allow indexing of third-party content, enhancing search capabilities across Microsoft Search clients.

Title: Microsoft Purview AI Hub: Enhancements to Overview, Recommendations, Reports, and Policies pages
Summary: The Microsoft Purview AI Hub will soon be updated with new sections for Overview, Recommendations, Reports, and Policies, as well as an improved Activity Explorer. These changes will start rolling out in mid-October 2024 and are associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 415451. The update will be on by default with no admin action required.

Title: What's new in Microsoft Entra - September 2024
Summary: The September 2024 Microsoft Entra update includes general availability releases, retirement of Azure AD Graph, security enhancements for Apple devices, MFA enforcement, and more. Details are communicated via blog, email, and release notes, organized by product for easy reference.

Title: Manage web searches in Copilot separately from optional connected experiences with new policy
Summary: In November 2024, Microsoft will introduce the "Allow web search in Copilot" policy, enabling separate management of web searches in Microsoft 365 Copilot from other optional connected experiences. This policy allows for improved Copilot responses using Bing search service and can be configured at the user/group level.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint eSignature: Adobe Acrobat Sign and Docusign integration will roll out globally
Summary: The message details the global rollout of Microsoft SharePoint eSignature integration with Adobe Acrobat Sign and Docusign, eliminating the need for native SharePoint eSignature activation. It will begin in early November 2024 and complete by mid-November. Admins must enable this feature in the Microsoft admin center. The rollout is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 421194.

Title: Support for Office 2016 and Office 2019 will end October 14, 2025: Upgrade recommended
Summary: Office 2016 and Office 2019 support will end on October 14, 2025. It is recommended to upgrade to Microsoft 365 E3 or Office LTSC 2024 for continued updates and support. Resources like upgrade guidance, Microsoft FastTrack, and the Office End of Support Tech Community are available to assist with the transition.

Title: Classic Microsoft Teams: Uninstallation resuming for Windows only
Summary: Automatic uninstallation of classic Microsoft Teams for Windows will resume on October 21, 2024, affecting non-VDI and certain VDI environments. No action is required from users; this is for information only. For manual uninstallation, refer to the provided link. Non-persistent VDI environments are not affected.

Title: Publishing new InfoPath Forms in SharePoint Online will not be allowed for inactive tenants in this December
Summary: Starting December 2024, Microsoft will block new InfoPath Forms publication in SharePoint Online for tenants not using the service, as part of the deprecation process ending July 14, 2026. Tenants should review impact, run assessments, and consider modern alternatives like Power Apps, Power Automate, or Microsoft Forms. Existing forms will remain usable.

Title: Microsoft 365 Mobile: View PDFs with Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels on Microsoft 365 Mobile app
Summary: The Microsoft 365 Mobile app now supports viewing PDFs with Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels in read-only mode, available globally. Organizations should inform users and update training materials accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Outlook for Mac: New reporting buttons integrated with Microsoft Defender for Office 365
Summary: In September 2024, Microsoft Outlook for Mac introduced new reporting buttons for phishing, junk, and not junk emails, controllable by admins via the Microsoft 365 Defender portal. These buttons are now available, with no changes to existing User reported settings. The update does not affect shared and delegate mailboxes and is part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 371393. Users should be informed of these changes.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Tenant Allow/Block List will support IPv6 allow and block entries
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is updating to support IPv6 in Tenant Allow/Block List, with a revised rollout timeline starting early October 2024. This update applies to customers with specific service plans and will allow admins to block or allow IPv6 addresses without submissions. Rollout requires no admin action prior to the update.

Title: High Volume Email for Microsoft 365 Public Preview
Summary: The public preview of High Volume Email (HVE) for Microsoft 365, which allows up to 100,000 recipients per day at no cost, has been extended. HVE is designed for large-scale communications and integrates with business applications. A new page and report for HVE will appear in the Exchange admin center.

Title: (Update) Microsoft SharePoint: Feed for Viva Connections web part and Video news link retires starting September 1, 2024
Summary: Starting September 1, 2024, Microsoft SharePoint will retire the Feed for Viva Connections web part and Video news link, with support ending on November 5, 2024. Site editors should replace these with recommended alternatives before the latter date to avoid content display issues.

Title: Classic Microsoft Outlook for Windows: New reporting buttons integrated with Microsoft Defender for Office 365
Summary: Classic Outlook for Windows will integrate new reporting buttons for phishing/junk emails starting August 2024, with admin-controlled settings via the Microsoft 365 Defender portal. This feature is part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 371388 and will be fully rolled out by mid-November 2024.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: New Microsoft Fabric risk indicators
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management's update to include new risk indicators for Microsoft Fabric in Power BI is postponed. The public preview and general availability rollout, initially planned for April and September 2024 respectively, will not proceed at this time. Organizations are advised to prepare by opting into new indicators via the Microsoft Purview portal.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Drag emails into the Calendar icon in the app bar to create an event
Summary: Outlook's update allows creating events by dragging emails into the Calendar icon. Rollout begins late October 2024 for Targeted Release and late November for General Availability, completing by late December 2024. The feature is available by default with no admin action required.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Bulk upload for priority user groups
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will soon support bulk upload for priority user groups. The rollout for Public Preview is expected to finish by late August 2024, and General Availability will complete by mid-November 2024. This feature will be on by default. No admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Design Ideas is now available
Summary: Design Ideas is now available in Microsoft SharePoint, allowing page authors to enhance sections with new layouts and formatting. It's already released for targeted and general availability, requiring no admin action, but users should be informed about the update.

Title: New Outlook for Windows: Auto-reading emails with Microsoft Windows Narrator
Summary: The new Outlook for Windows will soon feature auto-reading of emails with Windows Narrator, starting early November 2024. This will be on by default for Narrator users, requiring no admin action prior to rollout. Organizations should review configurations and inform users about the update.

Title: Microsoft Outlook: Send updates only to added or removed meeting attendees
Summary: Outlook will soon prompt organizers to send meeting updates only to added or removed attendees. Rollout for General Availability will begin in late August 2024 and complete by late October 2024. No admin action is required for this update associated with Roadmap ID 394687.

Title: Announcing IPv6 Enablement for Accepted Domains
Summary: IPv6 will be enabled for Exchange Online Accepted Domains starting October 16, 2024, to meet local regulations and enhance security. Organizations should update allow-lists and consider IP version matching for email connectors. Opt-out options and management commands are available if needed.

Title: Microsoft Teams: New administrative units (AUs) for Teams administration
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing new administrative units (AUs) to facilitate delegated administration within the Teams admin center. Rollout begins in August 2024 and completes by October 2024. This update allows for granular role-based access control, affecting user and policy management, and requires no pre-rollout admin action.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Channel cards
Summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce Channel cards, providing an overview of a channel, including description, activity, team name, and membership. Rolling out from early July to late October 2024, this feature requires no admin action but user notification is advised. Roadmap ID: 397883.

Title: Teams: Updated developer tools to share content from Teams apps to chats, channels, and meetings
Summary: The message details an update to Teams developer tools, allowing content sharing from Teams apps to chats, channels, and meetings. Users will access Groups via the navigation bar, and the old experience will be unavailable. The update includes a central destination for group activities and additional features like recommended actions and recent files. Preparation involves user notification and documentation updates.

Title: Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams: Respond to meetings with Follow
Summary: Microsoft Outlook and Teams are introducing a new 'Follow' meeting response option. This feature allows attendees to stay informed without attending the meeting. Rollout begins late May 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-June 2024 for General Availability, with completion expected by late August 2024.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Ability to rename General channel
Summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing the ability for team owners to rename the General channel based on feedback. This feature will be rolled out from early August to early September 2024, depending on the release schedule. Organizations are advised to update their documentation accordingly. The feature is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 395931.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Public preview of Global exclusions
Summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management's public preview of Global exclusions begins early May 2024, with general availability starting mid-October 2024. Exclusion features will move to a new Global exclusions tab, enhancing usability and management. Admins should review these features post-rollout.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Add approvals to any SharePoint list
Summary: Microsoft SharePoint is updating to allow approvals in any list, with a revised rollout timeline. Targeted Release will begin mid-May 2024, and General Availability will start mid-July 2024. Users can configure approvals via the Automate dropdown and action them in Teams. Organizations should inform users and update documentation accordingly.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Four override alerts retire in August 2024
Summary: Four legacy override alerts in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will be retired in September 2024 due to redundancy from the Secure by default feature. Affected users with specific subscriptions will not need to take any action as this change will occur automatically.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive for Business: Colored folders in the OneDrive folder in Microsoft Windows File Explorer
Summary: Colored folders introduced on OneDrive web mid-2023 will be available in Windows File Explorer for OneDrive folders starting mid-September 2024. Users can view and manage folder colors directly in File Explorer. The feature will be on by default with no admin action required.

Title: Product transitions to the cloud.microsoft domain - August 2024
Summary: Microsoft products Excel, PowerPoint, and Word are now available on the cloud.microsoft domain, which will soon redirect from previous domains. No user action is needed as links are backwards compatible. Organizations should update references and ensure *.cloud.microsoft is unblocked to prepare for this transition.

Title: Teams copy/paste of messages does not include timestamp and message author name
Summary: Teams has removed timestamps and author names from copied messages to reduce clutter. Users who need detailed message transfer should use the Forward feature or Teams Export API. This change is already in effect, and organizations may need to update training materials accordingly.

Summary: We are announcing the Create and publish UI elements collections in desktop flows feature. This feature allows you to create, share, and import collections of UI elements in Power Automate desktop flows. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2024. Summary: Experience the highest Redis performance on Azure using the E200 and E400 cache instances of Azure Cache for Redis. These options give you hundreds of gigabytes of memory and up to 240 vCPUs of compute power for your largest and most demanding Redis workloads. Learn more .

Summary: In August 2021, Azure announced that the retirement of Cloud Services (classic) would happen on August 31, 2024. As Azure API Management stv1 compute platform runs on Cloud Services (classic), we announced that they would retire on the same date. Now that we have passed that date, decommissioning of the stv1 hardware has begun, and this may affect the availability and performance of your instances hosted on the stv1. Summary: Azure Red Hat OpenShift (ARO) takes a leap forward in scalability, now supporting clusters of up to 250 nodes. This significant increase from the previous limit of 62 nodes opens new possibilities for enterprises running large-scale Kubernetes workloads. Title: Microsoft classic Viva Engage: Inline PDF viewing in external networks and non-connected communities retires Sept 30
Summary: Starting September 30, 2024, classic Viva Engage will retire inline PDF viewing in external networks and non-connected communities, requiring users to download PDFs to view them. User interface changes include a generic preview with a download prompt. No action is needed, but upgrading to Native Mode is advised.

Title: Sensitive meetings to be excluded from Viva Insights metrics
Summary: Viva Insights will exclude meetings marked as 'Private' or 'Confidential' from metrics, starting mid-September 2024, with full rollout by mid-October 2024. No action is required from organizations, but updating training and documentation may be considered.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Manage your organization’s brand in the new Brand center
Summary: The SharePoint Brand center, part of Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 124838, centralizes brand asset management, enabling customization of SharePoint and Viva Connections. It's available in Public Preview, with rollouts continuing until mid-October 2024. Global administrators need to activate the Brand center app, with steps varying based on current tenant configuration.

Title: Microsoft Viva Connections: Manage your organization's brand in the new Brand center
Summary: Microsoft is introducing a new SharePoint Brand center to manage organizational branding across sites and pages. It centralizes brand asset management, enabling brand consistency. The rollout began in April 2024, with general availability expected by mid-October 2024. Global administrators must activate the Brand center app in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Introducing custom fonts for Viva Connections Desktop
Summary: Microsoft Viva introduces custom fonts for Viva Connections Desktop via the SharePoint brand center, now in Preview and soon GA. Custom fonts will be available after admin enables the brand center, allowing brand managers to upload and manage brand assets. Rollout begins April 2024, with GA expected by mid-October 2024. Microsoft provides 8 default font packages. Custom fonts will be on by default and supported in various text elements. No admin action required before rollout.

Title: Microsoft SharePoint: Create themes in Brand center
Summary: Microsoft is updating SharePoint Brand center to allow easy creation and management of themes for sites and experiences. This rollout starts early September 2024 for Targeted Release and mid-September 2024 for General Availability. Users must enable the Brand center in the Microsoft 365 Admin center to use this feature.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Create themes for SharePoint and Viva Connections in brand center
Summary: The new theme creation experience in the SharePoint Brand center allows easy creation and management of themes for SharePoint and Viva Connections sites. Rolling out starts in early September 2024, with general availability by mid-October 2024. Organizations can standardize colors and themes, enhancing customization. Preparation requires enabling the SharePoint Brand center.

Title: Remove Custom Script setting in OneDrive and SharePoint
Summary: The Custom Script setting in SharePoint and OneDrive will be removed by early May 2024, with enforcement changes starting late April. A new PowerShell command is available to delay these changes until mid-November 2024. Existing scripts will not be affected, but the ability to add new custom scripts will be restricted.

Title: Microsoft OneDrive: Find files faster with the improved search experience in OneDrive for the web
Summary: An improved search experience is coming to OneDrive for the web, enabling users to find files more efficiently with new filters and a clickable location column. Rollout starts late September 2024, completing by late October 2024, and requires no admin action.

Title: (Update) Outlook for Windows display name change
Summary: The Outlook for Windows app name will change to "Outlook (classic)" starting July 2024, affecting version 2407 and higher. Some users may not see the updated name due to a known issue. This change aligns with support documentation and does not affect the app's status or support. Rollout will complete by January 2025. No action is required from administrators.

Title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: New recommendations for Microsoft Secure Score
Summary: Microsoft Defender for Identity will soon add new recommendations to Microsoft Secure Score, automatically updating scores to better reflect security posture. Public Preview and General Availability rollouts will begin mid-September 2024. Organizations should review Microsoft Secure Score improvement actions to prepare.

The AIP popup will deprecate in CY24. Users are advised to migrate to DLP policy tips and Oversharing popups. Roadmap ID 367053.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Required approval for Viva Amplify
Summary: The new 'Required approval' feature in Microsoft Viva Amplify ensures content undergoes review before publishing. It's an optional setting found under 'Campaign settings'. Rollout begins late August 2024, with no admin action needed but users should be informed. Viva Amplify on mobile is excluded.

Title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Microsoft Purview AI Hub prompts and responses
Summary: The Microsoft Purview AI Hub will display prompts and responses from Copilot for Microsoft 365 in Activity explorer. Public Preview begins in late August, with full rollout in November 2024. Users need the Content Explorer Content Viewer role to access this feature, and some known issues are documented. Preparation involves role assignment and reviewing documentation.

Title: What’s new in the Microsoft Intune Service Update for August 2024
Summary: The Microsoft Intune Service Update for August 2024 has been applied to your account. Check the Tenant Status blade for the new service release number and explore the changes. Prepare by reviewing the "What's new" page and related blogs for detailed feature information.

Title: [Reminder] Microsoft Team: Review and update Tenant Federation setting to block external access with trial-only tenants
Summary: Microsoft Teams has introduced a new admin control to block external access with Teams trial-only tenants. This setting, which defaults to 'Blocked', aims to protect against malicious activities. Admins can review and update this setting using PowerShell commands. General availability of this feature started on August 15, 2024.

Title: Plan for Change: New design for Intune Company Portal app for Windows
Summary: In late September 2024, the Intune Company Portal app for Windows will receive a new design, enhancing user experience without altering functionality. Organizations should review the blog and update documentation as needed. A preview is available for testing.

Title: Microsoft Viva: Stream Playlist card on Viva Connections Dashboard
Summary: The update allows adding a Stream Playlist card to the Viva Connections Dashboard, displaying videos for users to view. It's linked with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 402190 and will be generally available worldwide from mid to late August 2024. No admin action is required for rollout.

Title: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Enhancements to potential high-impact user detections

Title: New Microsoft Outlook: New Get diagnostics feature for users to submit logs to Microsoft Support during an interaction
Summary: The new Microsoft Outlook will feature a 'Get diagnostics' option to submit logs to Microsoft Support. Rolling out late August to late September 2024, it will be available in the Help tab and is initially off by default. Admins can enable it using Cloud Policy. No action is required before the rollout.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Expanded search options for 1:1 chats
Summary: Microsoft Teams will soon introduce expanded search options for 1:1 chats, allowing users to search content related to a person across Teams. This feature will be available on Windows, Mac, and the web, starting mid-August 2024 and completing by late August 2024. It will be enabled by default.

Title: New Microsoft Outlook for Windows: Automatically configure accounts with new policy
Summary: A new Microsoft Outlook for Windows policy will automatically configure accounts using the Active Directory Primary SMTP address. This feature, detailed on the Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 396729, will start rolling out in mid-September 2024 and is expected to complete by early October 2024. Admins can manage this policy through the Microsoft Intune admin center. The default policy state is off, and no admin action is required before the rollout.

Title: (Update) Microsoft Outlook: Scheduling Assistant updates
Summary: The Scheduling Assistant in Microsoft Outlook is being updated for better readability, with improved grid lines, an Availability view, a combined Availability bar, updated time zone behavior, and the addition of a Send button. Rollout begins late August 2024, completing by late September 2024. No admin action is required.

Summary: Azure Storage strives to provide you with effective disaster recovery offerings, and we are excited to introduce our new feature, planned failover (in preview) for Azure Storage. Title: Update to Viva Learning - SAP SuccessFactors integration configuration process
Summary: The Viva Learning - SAP SuccessFactors integration process is being updated to improve the admin setup experience. The rollout will begin in late August 2024 and is expected to complete by mid-September 2024. The update consolidates configuration steps, automates data collection and updates, and requires no immediate action but suggests preparing updated training and documentation.

Title: Microsoft Teams | Shifts app: Users must enable reminders for upcoming shifts and clocking in/out (Android users)
Summary: Android users of Microsoft Teams Shifts app must enable reminders for shifts and clocking in/out immediately due to API changes. A pop-up will guide users to enable this in the OS settings, with an alternative option available in the Shifts settings page.

Title: Unlock success with our New Campaign Goals Feature: Set, Track, Achieve!
Summary: The new Campaign Goals feature in Viva Amplify allows users to set, track, and achieve specific goals for campaigns, integrated with the unique viewer metric.
